title: Steward  - InterContinental Indianapolis
description:
Steward

About IHG and the InterContinental Indianapolis

InterContinental Indianapolis brings refined luxury to Indy’s iconic Monument Circle.

This opening is not just a hotel launch, it’s an event for the city and we’re looking for the right team to shape its future. The landmarked Illinois Building showcases a $110 M restoration to feature 170
Modern Guestrooms, 17 Luxurious Suites, Serliana Café and Astrea Rooftop Bar with stunning views of Monument Circle.

This will be a masterclass in #Hospitality; an invitation for you to pursue your passion for service and inspire incredible things for our guests, our team members and yourself.

Explore our very own InterContinental® Hotels & Resorts – a truly international brand. Discover a modern, globally-focused culture where world travelers feel at home. Live the InterContinental life. You’ll find us in beautifully restored buildings and many exciting new developments. With 60 properties in the pipeline, our extraordinary world is set to expand.

We cultivate engaging environments for our colleagues and guests by enlivening our IHG Core Values:

  • Do the right thing
  • Show we care
  • Aim higher
  • Celebrate difference
  • Work better together

At IHG we promise to give colleagues:

  • Room to Belong: Enable
  • Room to Grow: Enrich
  • Room to Make a Difference: Empower

The InterContinental creates exceptional experiences through our Brand Values by being:

  • Thoughtful
  • Cultured
  • Remarkable

The pillars of our InterContinental brand culture lay the foundation for inspiring incredible experiences:

  • We Invite Discovery
  • We Embrace Empowerment
  • We Champion Possibility

About this position

This position is responsible for cleaning the entire kitchen area, cook ware, plates, glass ware and silverware and cutlery.

A little taste of your day-to-day

  • Every day is different, but you’ll mostly be:
  • Use correct cleaning chemicals for designated items, according to OSHA regulations.
  • Set up and organize work station with designated supplies and equipment; report shortages to supervisor. Replenish as needed throughout the shift.
  • Clean the total kitchen including food service carts, walk-in coolers, freezers, service elevators, and loading dock area.
  • Maintain complete knowledge of correct maintenance and use of equipment. Use equipment only as intended.
  • Perform ware-washing tasks on soiled dishes from the restaurant, banquet, and room service outlets, through the use of the dish machine.
  • Perform the tasks required for washing pots, pans, and other equipment which must be washed by hand in the pot sinks.
  • Perform routine daily maintenance of kitchen.
  • Clean and polish silver and copper chafing dishes, trays, etc.; burnish all silver as necessary.
  • Sweep and mop the kitchen floor as necessary to maintain a sanitary environment for food preparation.

What we need from you

  • Minimum formal education of some high school and a minimum one year job-related experience preferred.
  • Must be able to abide by the company appearance standards and compliance with the designated uniform.
  • Dedicated to exceeding service standards and providing services and standards to the highest caliber.
  • Must be able to work any shift, weekends, holidays, and special events, as needed.

What you can expect from us

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life – including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well – both inside and outside of work – and through our well-being framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you’ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

The hourly pay rate for this role is $15.
We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k, and many other benefits to eligible employees.

title: Power Systems Project Manager, Data Center Focus
description:
Your new role

As our new Power Systems Project Manager, Data Center Focus, you will take full ownership of project planning, execution, and delivery for a growing portfolio of data center, mission-critical, and pre-investment infrastructure clients. You will manage scope, schedule, and budget across multi-disciplinary engagements spanning substation design, generation and load interconnection, and early-stage site feasibility, serving as the primary point of contact for clients who often have limited in-house experience navigating energy infrastructure development.

You will work closely with our technical leads across substation engineering, protection and control, and interconnection to keep integrated, constructible designs on track, while also representing Ramboll directly with investors, property developers, and economic development agencies evaluating pre-investment opportunities.

Your key responsibilities will be:

Own project plans, schedules, and budgets for data center and mission-critical power engagements, tracking performance against milestones and financial targets and driving corrective action when needed

Serve as the primary client contact for data center developers, investors, property developers, and economic development agencies, translating client objectives into actionable project scope and guiding clients with limited energy-infrastructure experience through the development pathway

Lead multi-disciplinary coordination across substation design, protection and control, civil/structural, power generation, and interconnection disciplines to ensure integrated, constructible project delivery

Manage subconsultants, vendors, and contract administration in support of assigned projects

Support early-stage feasibility studies, power availability assessments, and preliminary master planning for pre-investment and greenfield data center site opportunities

Identify and manage project risks, developing and tracking mitigation strategies in coordination with technical leads

Lead preparation of proposals, fee estimates, and client presentations, contributing to business development for the data center and mission-critical client segment

Ensure compliance with Ramboll QA/QC procedures and applicable industry standards throughout project execution

Mentor Assistant Project Managers and early-career staff supporting your projects

Coordinate with our Interconnection and Substation Engineering teams to ensure client-facing commitments are technically grounded and deliverable

Your new team

You will be part of an elite team of power system engineers and play a pivotal role in delivering advanced solutions for a wide variety of clients, including energy-intensive industries like semiconductor manufacturing, municipal entities, data center mega campuses, and pioneers in renewable energy. With our substantial growth, seize the opportunity to shape our strategy and contribute to our agile team's rich pipeline of projects.

With growth horizons in cutting-edge domains like HVDC, solar photovoltaics, and offshore wind, our energetic and inventive team, bolstered by global specialists, is committed to advancing Ramboll's reach across the US, notably in states championing progressive climate objectives and sustainability measures. At the heart of our mission is the conviction that electricity is the cornerstone of the green transition toward a carbon-neutral future. Join us in our unwavering pursuit to realize this vision.

About you

From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. While we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, and capabilities that will set you up for success.

These include:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a closely related field

7+ years of experience in power systems or electrical infrastructure project delivery, with demonstrated ownership of project scope, schedule, and budget

Experience supporting data center, mission-critical, or large-load client engagements is strongly preferred

Working knowledge of substation design, power generation, generation/load interconnection processes, and transmission planning fundamentals

Familiarity with ISO/RTO interconnection queue processes (e.g., ISO-NE, NYISO, PJM) and their implications for project schedule and risk is a plus

Demonstrated ability to manage multi-disciplinary teams and subconsultants on complex infrastructure projects

PMP certification, or active pursuit of PMP, is a plus

Professional Engineering (PE) license is a plus but not required

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to advise clients who have limited energy-infrastructure development experience

Proven track record contributing to proposals, fee estimation, and business development

What we can offer you

Flexible work environment

Investment in your development

Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles

Be valued for the unique person you are

Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects

The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Direct exposure to Ramboll's fastest-growing client segment: data centers, mission-critical power, and pre-investment infrastructure development

Ready to join us?

​Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV, cover letter, etc.

Work at the heart of sustainable change

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realize their full potential.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $95,000 to $140,000 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

​ Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.​

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Mental Health Clinician/Therapist
description:
Join the Mindfully Team – Where Compassion Meets Purpose


At Mindfully, diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the heart of everything we do. As a minority woman-owned company, we are dedicated to creating a supportive environment where every team member feels valued, respected, and empowered.

Our mission is simple yet powerful: to make high-quality mental health care accessible, affordable, and personalized for every individual we serve. We match clients with providers who specialize in their unique needs, ensuring better outcomes for clients and deeper professional satisfaction for our clinicians.


As a mental health professional, you chose this path to make a difference, not to spend your time juggling billing, insurance contracts, credentialing, and administrative work. That’s where we come in. At Mindfully, we handle the business side of things so you can focus on what matters most—your clients.


Why Work With Mindfully?

When you join our team, you gain the freedom of private practice with the support of a strong, collaborative community. Our goal is to help you grow, thrive, and maintain a healthy work-life balance while providing exceptional care to your clients.


Here’s what we offer:

  • Competitive Compensation – Attractive rates for part-time 1099 contractors ($35–$47/hour, based on license and caseload).
  • Full Administrative Support – We take care of scheduling, billing, insurance, and other behind-the-scenes work.
  • Training & Growth Opportunities – Access to our Mindfully Academy, with paid CEUs and specialized trainings such as DBT, EMDR, trauma, eating disorders, couples counseling, and more.
  • Flexible Schedules – Design a schedule that fits your lifestyle and client needs.
  • Client Matching Technology – Build a caseload aligned with your passions and expertise.
  • Peer Support & Collaboration – Participate in regular peer-to-peer consultations and small pods for connection and professional growth.
  • Wellness Perks – HealthiestYou by Teladoc, Crunch Fitness discounts, and voluntary pet insurance.
  • Autonomy in Practice – Choose the insurance panels you want to work with.
  • Stipends & Incentives – Tenure stipends for maintaining a full caseload, plus monthly stipends for supervisors.

Qualifications:

  • Current, valid license to practice as a clinician in the state of Ohio.
  • Ability to work in-office at our Fairfield, OH location.
  • Comfortable with a part-time 1099 contractor role.

Compensation:

  • Hourly Pay: $35–$47/hour (based on license type and caseload).
  • Additional Stipends:
    • Tenure stipend for full caseload maintenance.
    • Monthly supervisor stipend (for eligible clinicians).

You can learn more on our website: https://mindfully.com/join-our-team


Mindfully Behavioral Health is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.


This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and internship. Mindfully Behavioral Health makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. title: Leasing Consultant - Harmony on Main - Hendersonville, TN
description:

Valiant Residential is seeking a Leasing Consultant who is responsible for duties related to leasing, retention, and occupancy for the community while promoting resident satisfaction. Create a lasting influence on visitors, prospects, and residents through a customer service focus.


We Are Valiant

With over 37 years of experience, Valiant Residential is a next-generation property management leader, uniquely attuned to the needs of property owners and residents. We are driven by a Valiant Spirit—bold, innovative, and committed to excellence—fostering prosperous partnerships and long-term success. Our team thrives on collaboration, integrity, and strategic thinking, making a meaningful impact in the industry.


Why Work at Valiant?

At Valiant Residential, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers. Consistently ranked as a "Top Place to Work," we are a leader in the property management industry, driven by bold, innovative professionals who make an impact.

We believe in rewarding great work with competitive total compensation and time off with comprehensive benefits, including free health insurance options and 401(k) matching. Growth isn’t just encouraged—it’s expected. With career development opportunities, a collaborative culture, and a commitment to innovation, we empower our employees to thrive.

title: Leeville - Underground Drill & Blast Frontline Supervisor
description:
Position Description:

Would you like to have a career with a collaborative, diverse, and dynamic mining company? We have an exciting opportunity for you!

Our people division is growing, and we are looking for an Underground Drill & Blast Supervisor with our underground team at Leeville. The successful candidate will safely and effectively coordinate and manage drill and blast programs for underground operations. Apply strong leadership to execute the mine plan and improve performance by leading an operations team to deliver safe, environmentally sound, and efficient gold production.

At Nevada Gold Mines, our vision is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and operating the best assets with the best people. We are committed to a safe work environment, sending every person home safe and healthy every day and leaving a sustainable legacy on our host communities.

Responsibilities:

  • Comply with State and Federal legal regulations, Barrick Safety and Environmental policies and procedures. Corporate with supervisors, coordinators and managers on management of safety and environmental issues, including complying with any instruction

    • Intervene, as necessary, to ensure the health and safety of others in the workplace and to protect the environment

    • Attend scheduled or unscheduled safety meetings.

    • Complete regular safety inspections of the workplace and audit work practices Inspect work for loose material and any hazardous conditions that can pose a risk to personnel or equipment

    • Coordination and supervision of drill and blast daily work requirements

    • Conduct daily line out meetings and monthly safety meetings

    • Positive and effective working relationship with Production, Maintenance, and Technical teams. Ensure that Production has manpower available to meet the production plan by managing manpower effectively.

    • Excellent and demonstrated personal commitment to safety & health – completing one FLRA (field level risk assessment) per week and ensuring any findings are documented and actioned

    • Provide support to Safety Division through participation in incident investigations and follow up on action plans.

    • Support regulatory requirements in the area of safety, health, environment and the community.

    • Continually drive process improvements through effective budgeting, monitoring and scheduling.

    • Focus on “visible felt leadership” by interacting with personnel “in the field”

    • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years mining or industrial-type environment in a leadership role required

    • Minimum 3 years’ experience in drill and blast activities required

    • Ability to use Microsoft Office Suite software required

    • Excellent written and oral communication skills preferred

    • Minimum 5 years supervisory experience or lead person required

    • Planning, problem-solving, decision-making, decision making and organizational/interpersonal skills preferred

What We Can Offer You

  • A comprehensive compensation package including a competitive medical, dental, and vision plan with national provider networks, a 401k retirement plan with employer contribution AND employer match, paid time off, company-sponsored medical clinics, company match share purchase program, and much more!
  • Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team.
  • Endless opportunities to grow and learn with industry colleagues.
  • Access to a variety of career opportunities across the organization.
  • Nevada Gold Mines is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

1. Other duties as assigned.

title: Vice President | Applications
description:

CBIZ Benefits and Insurance is separating from CBIZ and building its own technology organization. title: Brimingham - American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor/ Instructor Trainer
description:
About Us

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.

  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.

  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.

title: Project Manager - Enterprise
description:
At Sunflower Bank, N.A., we’re experiencing great growth. Since our founding in 1892, we've been committed to serving our communities and supporting the team members who make it all possible. As a full-service financial institution, we offer a full range of relationship-focused services to meet personal, business, and wealth-management financial objectives. Creating Possibility is not just our mission, it’s what we do every day for clients and associates. Learn more about Sunflower Bank, N.A. at sunflowerbank.com.


Sunflower Bank, N.A. is looking for an energetic, highly motivated individual to fill the position of a full-time Project Manager - Enterprise.


Hybrid/Remote Opportunity

**MUST live and be based out of AZ, CA, CO, FL, KS, MI, NM, and TX ONLY

Great Compensation Plan with Amazing Benefits!


Description:


This Project Manager - Enterprise position is responsible for managing enterprise projects. This includes tracking projects to be on-time, within scope, and within budget. Position has responsibility for developing and managing project plans, communication plans, project resources, and other project documentation for variety of enterprise projects. Position requires familiarity with PMI principles, Scrum, and Kanban.


Responsibilities:

  • Plan and coordinate all aspects of assigned projects from initiation through delivery.
  • Manage project initiation activities that include identifying contractual obligations, client needs and goals, existing situation, necessary contacts, and access to existing information as needed.
  • Ensure requirements for projects align to Sunflower Bank standards. Develop alternate requirements or document exceptions as appropriate.
  • Develop and manage integrated project plans, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, dependencies, and deliverables, across multiple enterprise projects.
  • Identify the best methodology and documentation requirements based on project classification and Sunflower Bank PMO processes.
  • Organize and facilitate project planning, daily stand-up meetings, reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, demos and other Scrum-related meetings.
  • Ensure the development teams are practicing the core agile principles of collaboration, prioritization, team accountability, and visibility.
  • Identify and remove impediments and prevent distractions.
  • Coordinate activities and tasks among project team members, other internal departments, or vendor/subcontractor as needed to meet project goals.
  • Assign and monitor work of project team.
  • Manage project risks, issues, and action items to ensure project goals are achieved.
  • Assist with problem resolution or risk mitigation as needed.
  • Serve as a liaison between internal and external technical and non-technical teams.
  • Deliver informational and decision-seeking presentations to technical and business groups.
  • Conduct project closure activities to formalize and communicate the project acceptance and complete a post implementation review.
  • Identify project management process gaps or areas for improvements and assist in recommending and implementing solutions.
  • Provide business analysis and quality assurance support as needed to ensure requirements are clear and deliverables meet acceptance criteria.
  • Ensure projects comply with SBNA security controls and standards for protecting sensitive data, including requirements related to the Gramm Leach Bliley Act (GLBA).
  • Ensure project teams follow applicable Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) policies, standards, and processes.


Education / Experience Preferred:

  • Working knowledge of SDLC and agile delivery methods (Scrum, Kanban) and familiarity with PMI framework concepts.
  • Proficiency with common project tools (e.g., Microsoft Office, Visio, PowerPoint, Jira, Smartsheet).
  • 5+ years of project management experience.
  • Detail-oriented and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Strong communication skills with internal and external customers.
  • Business & IT strategy experience.
  • Customer-focused mindset.
  • One of the following certifications is preferred:
  • o PMP: Project Management Professional
  • o CAPM: Certified Associate in Project Management
  • o CSM: Certified ScrumMaster
  • o PMI-ACP: PMI Agile Certified Practitioner

Pay is dependent on knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, and location.


Working Conditions


The physical demands of this position require the ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation. Employees may spend extended periods sitting or standing, using hands to operate computers or other equipment, and reaching for work-related tasks. Regular walking may be required, along with occasional bending, stooping, kneeling, or climbing. The role may involve lifting or moving items weighing up to 10 pounds. Vision requirements include close and distance vision, color and peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.


Sunflower Bank Benefits


People choose to “bank” with us, but for those we serve, we’re more than a bank. We strive to be the financial backbone of their lives, and we know that starts with our team.


Our supportive culture empowers team members to grow and seize new opportunities. Like our namesake, the sunflower, we are:

  • Rooted in Strength
  • Propelled by Growth
  • Individuals in a Great Whole
  • Creating Possibility
  • Community Focused


Associates enjoy outstanding benefits, including:

  • 401(k) Plan with 6% Match
  • Health/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • Company-paid Life Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Fitness Reimbursement
  • Paid Time Off
  • Volunteer Leave
  • Paid Holidays
  • Plus many more associate perks & incentives!


If you qualify, apply online at www.sunflowerbank.com/careers.


You’ve never worked anyplace like Sunflower Bank!


EOE/AA: Minorities/Females/Disabled/Vets


Sunflower Bank, N.A. is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Open until filled; early application encouraged. This vacancy announcement may be used to fill similar positions within 90 days.

title: Sr Mgr, External Affairs USH
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Manager, External Affairs is responsible for shaping and executing strategies that strengthen Universal Studios Hollywood operations and reputation in California. This role serves as the Theme Parks primary on-the-ground external affairs leader by driving proactive engagement with key stakeholders including local and state elected officials, government agencies (City, County and State) and industry associations. This role collaborates cross-functionally and works in partnership with Universal Destinations and Experiences (UDX), Comcast and NBCUniversal State & Local Government Affairs, Corporate Communications and Global Real Estate departments to support initiatives that drive growth strategies for the destination. This position will own the development and delivery of local government relations strategies that impact park operations by building and maintaining relationships with industry peers and associations to advocate theme park priorities and position the company as a trusted regional partner and employer of choice. This leader protects and advances the corporate brand in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment.

Major Responsibilities

  • Research, track and provide briefing papers to internal stakeholders on local ordinances and state legislation on issues supporting or impacting tourism, transportation, park operations and business regulation. Leverages information to align, navigate, and execute Universal’s relationship strategy in accordance with government proceedings.
  • Partners with business units on local issues and response efforts for USH, including analysis, monitoring, escalation and on-the-ground coordination to support the Theme Park.
  • Manages business and industry association relationships throughout Los Angeles and California including board membership, sponsorship, and issues management. Positions USH as a business leader and partner by building and maintaining relationships with key community stakeholders and leaders. Ensures compliance with all government laws for hosting events following Comcast Political Affairs Guidelines.
  • Support business unit strategic plans that support park initiatives, including community impact, neighborhood engagement, and USH corporate communications.
  • Engages with numerous regulatory agencies at the local and state level with key internal stakeholders to ensure operational efficiencies and compliance
  • Bachelor’s degree in Political Science, Public Relations, Communications, Business Administration or related field is required.
  • 10+ years of legislative, community relations, government, or external affairs experience is required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to identify, assess and remediate and execute external affairs strategies
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize issues management
  • Effective verbal, written communication, and presentation skills
  • Ability to interact with and influence all levels of the organization, community organizations and elected officials effectively
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $90,000-$115,000 (bonus eligible)

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

title: Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Description

Montshire Pediatric Dentistry is seeking a Scheduling Coordinator to join our team at our Lebanon office. We are a family-owned practice serving nearly 30,000 children across New Hampshire, Vermont, Maine, and Massachusetts. Our work centers on eliminating barriers to care so families can access the dental services they need.


Our mission is to empower our team to use education, prevention, and compassion to deliver the highest quality of care in as many communities as possible. We accept all insurance, including Medicaid, and focus on preventing problems before they become serious, so children need fewer appointments and families get support without added stress.


Our values shape how we work each day. We aim to Create Raving Fans through excellent care, Change the Game through innovation, Own It by taking responsibility, bring our Best Version Today, and maintain Playful Professionalism in every interaction.

This is an opportunity to apply your skills in a meaningful way and be part of work that is genuinely changing outcomes for children. If you’re looking for a position where you can make a real difference in access to care, we’d like to hear from you.


How You’ll Bring Our Values to Life Each Day

• Keeps the daily schedule full; fills openings in the schedule same day and within the next 48 hours.

• Ensures that all new patients entering the practice have completed paperwork to include insurance details on file prior to their appointment.

• Uses software reporting to find and schedule patients who need an appointment.

• Reaches out to leadership for guidance or help when needed.

• Is a calm and positive presence in an often very busy and ever-changing environment.

• Delivers great customer service with a positive attitude.

• Works well with other team members.


How We Invest in You

• The salary range for this position is $23/hr - $27.50/hr. Final compensation is determined during the selection process and considers experience, education, and internal equity.

• Benefits include paid time off, health, dental, vision, and profit sharing.

• Training, mentorship, and a team culture where every person’s contribution matters.

• A supportive and fun environment that encourages collaboration, growth, and fresh ideas.

Schedule: Monday- Friday 7:30-4:30


Requirements

What Makes You a Great Fit

• Ethics - Treats patients and coworkers with kindness and respect; keeps commitment Inspires the trust of others; works with integrity and ethically; demonstrates and upholds organizational values.

• Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; manages competing demands; changes approach or method to best fit the situation; able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events with calmness and positivity.

• Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions and suggestions; participates in meetings. Writes clearly & with accuracy.

• Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; uses time efficiently, plans for additional resources; asks for help when needed to assure all tasks are completed well and on time

title: Admissions Counselor
description:
Living Resources is a non-profit agency dedicated to empowering individuals with disabilities or other life-altering conditions to live with dignity, independence, and purpose. We work with, and for, families by providing peace of mind. All employees are to be respectful and supportive of families. We are working with them as partners, providing support and services.


To work for Living Resources is to make a difference in the lives of others. Living Resources employees provide individuals with disabilities and other life-altering conditions the support they need to thrive and lead active, full lives. For many employees, their work becomes an experience where they find fulfillment and develop both personally and professionally.


Our Values

Advocacy, Collaboration, Empowerment, Excellence, Inclusivity, Integrity, and Kindness are at the heart of everything we do. These values guide how we support those we serve, work together, and create a culture where everyone can thrive.


The Admissions Counselor is responsible for managing all aspects of the admissions process for The College Experience at Russell Sage College and the CareerNext Programs. This role also supports recruitment efforts and vendor events across both programs, ensuring a smooth, informed, and professional admissions experience for prospective students and their families. The Admissions Counselor plays a key role in driving program growth by establishing, tracking, and achieving enrollment benchmarks. This position requires the ability to independently organize and manage multiple projects, prioritize competing responsibilities, and ensure timely execution of admissions and recruitment activities aligned with program goals.


  • Serve as a key representative of The College Experience and CareerNext programs by conducting outreach and educating prospective students, families, educators, educational consultants, guidance counselors, care coordinators, and transition specialists through individual phone and Zoom meetings, in-person and virtual open houses, webinars, SEPTA meetings, high school transition fairs, college nights, private presentations, and conferences.
  • Maintain an up-to-date availability calendar on the CareerNext & College Experience website to allow prospective families to schedule phone consultations.
  • Review and assess student applications and supporting documentation, including academic records, Psychological, clinical history, IEP/504 accommodations, Life Plans and current support service needs, to evaluate student readiness and program fit for College Experience and CareerNext.
  • Coordinate all aspects of the admissions process, including student overnight trials and student/parent interviews for prospective College Experience candidates.
  • Organize Classroom Experience Day for all OPWDD waiver applicants for College Experience as part of the admissions process.
  • Establish and manage enrollment timelines, track deposits, and monitor admitted student status through to confirmed enrollment for both programs and communicate program deposits and family contact information to finance.
  • Present qualified applicants to the Director of College Programs for acceptance consideration. Upon approval, draft and send official acceptance letters for College Experience and CareerNext. Prepare and distribute onboarding materials to all accepted students.
  • Oversee all aspects of intake for OPWDD Waiver applicants and private tuition students for College Experience. Responsibilities include development of intake packets, updating documentation with finance and nursing, meeting with families to review documents as needed, collecting accurate submissions for dissemination to relevant departments (finance, nursing, residential, Netsmart).
  • Maintain timely and proactive communication with prospective and current applicants via email and phone, while establishing enrollment timelines, tracking deposit payments, and monitoring applicant status through enrollment.
  • Communicate with OPWDD as directed by Director of College Programs for any onboarding regulations.
  • Manage the service authorization process for group day habilitation (WOW), Self-Direction budget closures, ensuring proper documentation and filing for College Experience enrollees is prepared for move-in.
  • Create OPWDD residential binders for incoming waiver students. Track and organize medical documents for development of nursing binders.
  • Assist with social media content postings to Facebook and Instagram

title: Senior Project Controls Analyst
description:
We have multiple openings for Project Controls Analysts. This work will take place within the Extreme Light, Matter and Fusion (LMF) Directorate, home to the world’s most energetic laser. It is an exciting time to join the team that achieved fusion ignition in December 2022, a historic moment in science, opening new physics regimes and setting the stage for new fusion energy possibilities.

You will be responsible for contributing to the development of current and future project controls scheduling guidance, work processes, tools, and procedures to support multiple high-priority Directorate projects including the National Ignition Facility (NIF) Enhanced Yield Capability and NIF Sustainment, valued at $750M and $600M, respectively. This work will be completed in collaboration with an existing team that is responsible for resource loading, cost estimates, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and corrective action planning. You will utilize Project Management and Earned Value Management methodologies to provide in-depth review, analysis, and reporting of project cost, schedule, and risk throughout the project lifecycle. These positions are in the Extreme Light, Matter and Fusion (LMF) Directorate.

These positions will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You will have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

You will

  • Coordinate with integrated project teams, project managers and control account managers to assess schedule impacts, validate scope, sequencing, durations, resource requirements, and milestone commitments and provide schedule guidance as needed.
  • Prepare and develop schedule analytics, including critical path, float, variance, slippage trends, milestone health and key driver analysis.
  • Oversee and implement dashboards that communicate project health, forecast trends, and key risk drivers to stakeholders at multiple levels.
  • Monitor and develop complex analyses, reviews, and documentation of program performance measurement and cost variances according to established process, procedures, and monthly business rhythm.
  • Prepare and present accurate program reporting deliverables, including performance data that supports sponsor reporting requirements and cost, schedule, and earned value information for review meetings.
  • Develop project controls work, apply earned value management techniques, and support training of project personnel on project controls processes and tools.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional job responsibilities, at the Q01.5 level

  • Lead, develop and manage enterprise and integrated schedules for large scale, highly complex interrelated work across multiple organizations.
  • Develop and lead highly complex metrics and alerts to identify activity slippage and emerging risks, enabling proactive management action before milestones are impacted.
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert leading the effective execution of the project controls system within the LMF organization by interpreting requirements and implementing advanced earned value management systems.
  • Lead the development and implementation of project controls work processes, tools and procedures.
  • Oversee the development of training classes for project controls processes and practices.
  • Mentor and support project controls staff, fostering professional growth and effective performance.
  • Regularly interfaces with senior management in the development of project controls initiatives by preparing and delivering briefings.
  • Ensure integrity of project controls data and compliance with processes and procedures.
  • Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. Citizenship.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, finance, construction management, information systems or a related field, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
  • Expert level knowledge of earned value management and experience interpreting, executing and applying project management theories, principles, and techniques for project schedule systems.
  • Advanced knowledge and extensive experience using project controls and project management software systems for scheduling and reporting such as MS Project, Primavera P6 and Deltek Cobra.
  • Advanced experience in Microsoft Office and Excel functions.
  • Expert level experience designing dashboards and data visualizations that communicate cost and schedule performance, using tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Excel.
  • Expert level experience evaluating project performance, conducting trend and forecast analyses; calculation and analysis of cost and schedule variances; and root cause analysis, including preparation of recovery or corrective action plans.
  • Significant experience as a self-motivated problem solver with excellent analytical skills and ability to work independently in an environment where things may not be well defined.
  • Experience in independently and successfully clarifying issues, analyzing concerns, and resolving complex problems of an unusual nature; making and implementing sound decisions.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism and accuracy while managing interruptions in a dynamic working environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills necessary to communicate with multidisciplinary team members, and using negotiation skills to influence.

Additional qualifications at the Q01.5 level

  • Expert level experience independently and successfully clarifying issues, analyzing concerns and resolving highly complex problems; making and implementing sound decisions.
  • Expert level knowledge and experience of project controls disciplines and the integration of all components of an earned value management system, including processes and procedures.
  • Expert level knowledge and experience using schedule software tools such as Primavera P6 and advanced knowledge of cost processors and EVMS tools.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a subject matter expert and interfacing regularly with senior management on the development of project controls initiatives.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Project Management Professional (PMP), PMI Scheduling Professional (PMI-SP) or AACE Earned Value Professional (EVP) certification.
  • Familiarity with technical processes, engineering drawings, quantity determinations, and mathematical and financial reports.
  • Familiarity with schedule health assessment methods such as the DCMA 14-Point Assessment.
  • Experience with DOE Order 413.3B line-item project reporting requirements and EIA-748 certified EVMS.

Pay Range

$137,910 - $202,632 Annually

$137,910 - $168,852 Annually for the Q01.4 level

$165,480 - $202,632 Annually for the Q01.5 level

This is the lowest to highest salary in good faith we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

title: Fire Sprinkler Apprentice
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The responsibility of a Fire Sprinkler Apprentice is to assist in the laying out, fabricating, assembling, installing, and maintaining piping and piping systems, fixtures, sprinkling, and industrial processing systems. Ideal candidate will be coachable and mechanically inclined.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:

  • Assist and learn under the direction of Sprinkler Technician Journeymen in the following:
    • Install pipe systems and valves
    • Cut, thread, assemble and bond pipes and tubes according to specifications
    • Modify, clean and maintain pipe systems, units and fittings
    • Remove and replace worn components.
  • Learn to follow blueprints to meet product specifications.
  • Learn how to calculate material measurements to verify specifications.
  • Learn proper installation techniques.
  • Other duties may be assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

The qualifications listed below are representative of the elements required to perform the job successfully, however in some cases, an equivalent combination of Education, Training, Certifications and Experience may meet the job qualifications.

Education, Training, Certifications:

  • HS Diploma or equivalent, required.
  • Must be able to enroll and obtain current Fire Sprinkler License.

Experience, Knowledge, Skill Requirements:

  • Mechanical ability and basic hand tool knowledge
  • Work efficiently with minimal supervision under direction of Sprinkler Technicians
  • Basic math skills, mechanical aptitude, problem solving skills, customer service skills, decision making skills, ability to multitask, ability to meet project schedules, ability to plan and organize, troubleshooting skills, and the ability to train other is required.

Communication Skills:

  • Must have the ability to effectively read, write and communicate in English with employees and customers.

Systems and Software Skills:

  • Ability to read electronic blueprints, strongly preferred.

Other Qualifications:

  • Valid driver’s license with acceptable driving record required.
  • Must be able to comply with SFS’s Drug and Alcohol policy and Background screening requirements, which may also include customer specific requirements based on contractual agreement.

PHYSICAL & WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform Essential Job Duties.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to bend, ascend and descend step stools, ladders and stairs, kneel, lift <75lbs, reach above and below shoulders, stand and walk for extended periods of time. Employee is required to see in color, close and far distances, peripheral, depth, and adjust focus. Employee will occasional be required to balance, crouch, drive, kneel, lift <75lbs, sit, stoop, twist, and work at heights.

Work Environment:

Frequent local travel and occasional regional and non-regional travel is required. Employee will frequently be required to work inside and outside in hot/cold temperatures and be exposed to loud noises, cramped quarters, dust, fumes and odors, standing on hard surfaces, and electrical hazards frequently. Employees will occasionally be exposed to chemicals, moving machinery, uneven and slippery surfaces. Employee must consistently wear all appropriate personal protective equipment, as required by company safety policies.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Company Overview

Founded in 2014, and listed on the ASX since 2015, Superloop’s purpose is to enable better internet for Australian homes and businesses through reimagining how telco should be delivered. We enable challenger retail brands (including Superloop and Exetel brands) to take a larger share of the market, leveraging Superloop’s Infrastructure-on-Demand platform. Superloop provides connectivity and services to customers in three segments of the market: Consumer, Business and Wholesale. Through Smart Communities, we own and operate extensive fibre to the premises (FTTP) and managed Wi-Fi networks that service residential and commercial communities including multi-unit dwellings. Through Neoloop we offer open access to our FTTP networks to other Retail Service Providers. Our offerings leverage Superloop’s investments in physical infrastructure assets that include fibre, subsea cables and fixed wireless, as well as Superloop’s software platforms. Hundreds of thousands of homes and businesses rely on Superloop and Exetel every day for their connectivity needs.

Visit to learn more.


Business Unit Overview

Our Product unit guides every stage of the product lifecycle. The team is responsible for the development and positioning of our products, balancing our internal capabilities with market demand. Ultimately, the unit is focused on building the best possible products through customer advocacy, insight from the market, and the optimisation of our capabilities.

Role Purpose

The Senior Business Analyst will provide senior analysis leadership across complex transformational initiatives spanning multiple business units. The role will work with business and technology stakeholders to understand strategic objectives, clarify scope, elicit and prioritise requirements, and translate complex needs into practical business, process, data and system outcomes.

An initial priority of the role will be to document and map Neoloop’s existing business processes and design clear, scalable future-state processes as the business evolves. Working across product, commercial, customer, operations, finance, people and technology functions, the role will identify process gaps, dependencies, controls and improvement opportunities; define ownership and hand-offs; and support solution design, testing, implementation, business readiness, and the transition into sustainable business-as-usual operations.

As these priorities are delivered, the role will evolve to support broader strategic transformation, integration and continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead business analysis for transformational projects across product, commercial, customer, process, data and technology workstreams.

  • Partner with senior stakeholders and stream owners to define scope, outcomes, priorities, decision points and acceptance criteria.

  • Plan and facilitate complex discovery, requirements gathering, process design and decision-making workshops across multiple business units.

  • Own the end-to-end requirements lifecycle, including elicitation, analysis, documentation, validation, prioritisation, traceability and change control.

  • Translate strategic and commercial objectives into clear business, functional, non-functional, data, integration and reporting requirements.

  • Develop current-state and target-state process models, customer journeys, capability maps, gap assessments and operating model impacts.

  • Analyse product, pricing, contract, customer, network and system dependencies to support rationalisation and migration decisions.

  • Define data mapping, interface requirements, reconciliation controls and transition rules for customer and system migrations.

  • Maintain analysis artefacts and provide clear visibility of assumptions, dependencies, issues, risks, decisions and benefits.

  • Support solution design, test strategy, acceptance criteria, defect triage, cutover planning and business readiness activities.

  • Assess change impacts and work with product, commercial, operations, technology and customer teams to embed target-state processes.

  • Provide evidence-based recommendations and concise executive-level insights to enable timely decision-making.

  • Support the transition of completed transformational project activities into sustainable business-as-usual ownership and governance.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Information Technology or a related field; relevant business analysis certification is desirable.

  • Typically 7+ years’ experience as a Business Analyst, including substantial experience leading analysis on complex transformation, integration or migration programs.

  • Demonstrated experience working with senior executives, product leaders, commercial teams, technology teams and cross-functional delivery stakeholders.

  • Strong capability in requirements engineering, process modelling, operating model design, gap analysis, business case development and benefits definition.

  • Proven experience with product and service integration, customer migration, system rationalisation, data mapping and interface analysis.

  • Experience translating commercial objectives, pricing or contractual considerations into implementable business and system requirements.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise applications, APIs, data flows, controls, reporting and end-to-end operational processes.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting test planning, user acceptance testing, cutover, readiness activities and transition to business as usual.

  • Excellent facilitation, negotiation, critical thinking and written communication skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence decisions.

  • Ability to produce high-quality executive papers, requirements specifications, process models, decision records and implementation artefacts.

  • Telecommunications, product management, commercial transformation or merger integration experience is highly desirable.

On Offer

  • Free Home Broadband

  • Free Mobile SIM plan

  • Flexibility – 3 days/week in the office

  • Lunch on Wednesdays, snacks, donuts and more!

  • Diverse and inclusive culture

  • Gain skills and build relationships to succeed in the telco and tech industries, at Superloop and beyond.


At Superloop, we’re dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be who they are. We actively embrace diversity and celebrate the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds to apply, regardless of gender, age, faith, ethnicity, nationality, sexuality, neurodiversity, or physical ability. We’re committed to ensuring that our hiring processes are accessible and inclusive for everyone interested in joining Superloop.

title: **INTERNAL APPLICANTS ONLY** Data Engineer
description:
**INTERNAL APPLICANTS ONLY**

Organisation: London Borough of Waltham Forest

Salary: £54,267 - 56,058

Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working hours per week: 36 hours, hybrid, with a minimum of two days per week on site in Waltham Forest and required to work from different Council locations within the borough.

Application Deadline: 21/10/2026

Proposed Interview Date(s): TBC

Reference: 2390

About Us:

Bursting with culture, energy, and opportunity, the London Borough of Waltham Forest is a fantastic and exciting place to work.

We are a highly ambitious borough. Driven by culture and the innate creativity of our residents, we have developed new and innovative ways to build our communities. Our Council is relentlessly resident-focused, insight-led, digitally driven and commercially minded; a Council focused on meeting the needs of our existing and future residents.

London Borough of Waltham Forest is one of the Mayor of London’s Good Work Standard employers. This accreditation is a proof of our commitment to creating a healthy, fair and inclusive workplace. This includes fair pay and conditions, workplace well-being, skills and progression and diversity and recruitment.

The Council’s preference is for online application. However, if you have a disability and are unable to complete an online application, please email recruitment@walthamforest.gov.uk so we can arrange an alternative application method.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced and ambitious Data Engineer to join our Business Intelligence service at an exciting point in the Council's data journey.

This is an opportunity to do much more than maintain existing data processes. We are modernising how we manage, connect and use data across the Council, moving away from fragmented and siloed datasets towards modern, trusted and reusable data products that help our services make better decisions.

You will play a key role in designing and building the data infrastructure that supports this ambition, using technologies including Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL, Python and R. You will develop data pipelines, models, semantic models and reporting solutions that bring together information from multiple systems and make it easier for analysts and services to understand demand, performance, outcomes and the journeys of our residents.

This is a great opportunity for somebody who enjoys solving complex problems but also wants to see the real-world impact of their work. The data we manage supports services used every day by Waltham Forest residents, and you will help turn that data into something that is trusted, accessible and genuinely useful.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain data pipelines, data models and reporting solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL, Python and related technologies.
  • Develop trusted datasets, semantic models and reusable data products to support business intelligence and analytics.
  • Integrate data from multiple systems to provide joined-up insight into service delivery, performance and resident outcomes.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver innovative data and reporting solutions.
  • Identify and resolve data quality, integrity and consistency issues across source systems.
  • Support data migration, modernisation and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Develop dashboards, reports and visualisations that enable evidence-based decision making.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, standards and best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with UK GDPR, Data Protection Act 2018 and information governance requirements.
  • Mentor colleagues and contribute to the development of Business Intelligence capabilities across the organisation.

Job Requirements

  • Significant experience in data engineering, business intelligence, analytics or data development environments.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL, ETL processes, relational databases and modern data architectures.
  • Strong experience with Power BI, Power Query, DAX and data visualisation techniques.
  • Experience designing, building and maintaining data pipelines, dataflows and semantic models.
  • Knowledge of cloud-based data platforms, preferably Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience managing data quality, governance and information security requirements.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience delivering projects and driving continuous service improvement.

Qualifications and Requirements

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Evidence of continuing professional development.
  • Strong practical experience with SQL and at least one programming language such as Python or R.
  • Proven experience developing data solutions, reporting products and business intelligence tools.

Desirable

  • Microsoft certifications or other relevant ICT professional qualifications.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services and modern cloud-based analytics platforms.
  • Experience working within public sector or local government environments.

Additional Requirements

  • Commitment to maintaining up-to-date professional, technical and leadership skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with senior stakeholders, partners and multidisciplinary teams.

  • Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing practices.

  • Understanding of data governance, cyber security, UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018 requirements.

  • Ability to work in a hybrid environment, attending the office a minimum of two days per week or as required by service needs.

  • Willingness to support organisational change, innovation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Interested?

If you are an experienced data professional who wants the opportunity to build rather than simply maintain, to help shape a modern data environment and to use your skills on challenges that directly affect public services and residents, we would be really interested in hearing from you.

We are particularly interested in people who combine strong technical skills with curiosity, pragmatism and the confidence to ask: “Is there a better way of doing this?”

This means that they must have a command of spoken English, with confidence and accuracy, sufficient for the effective performance of their role. This requirement does not refer to any particular English language qualifications, regional or international accents, dialects, speech impediments or the tone of conversations. We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

If you have any technical issues when trying to apply for this post, please contact our Recruitment Team via email at recruitment@walthamforest.gov.uk.

title: Digital Strategist
description:
The Opportunity

The Digital Strategist helps Adobe's customers translate ambitious customer-experience and digital-transformation objectives into practical strategies that create measurable business value.


Operating as a senior individual contributor within Professional Services, the role works directly with customer executives and cross-functional Adobe teams to understand business priorities, identify high-value opportunities, shape transformation initiatives and connect Adobe capabilities to customer outcomes.


The role bridges strategy and execution. It does not replace delivery, account management or Sales accountability. Instead, it creates clarity around what outcomes matter, where value exists, what should be prioritised and how Adobe can help the customer realise that value.


What You'll Own

Growth & Commercial Influence

  • Identify unmet customer needs and opportunities where Adobe capabilities or Professional Services can create additional value.
  • Shape strategic opportunities with Sales, Services Sales and account teams so customer demand is grounded in a genuine business problem and credible value case.
  • Influence Services pipeline, expansion and broader Adobe growth through strategic customer engagement.
  • Contribute to renewal and retention outcomes by helping customers demonstrate realised and prospective value from their Adobe investment.
  • Balance commercial opportunity with customer trust; recommendations must be driven by customer outcomes rather than short-term product or Services sales.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Orchestrate the right Adobe expertise across Professional Services, Sales, Customer Success, Product and other functions to address complex customer priorities.
  • Create clarity on the strategic problem, intended outcome and respective roles of participating teams.
  • Connect strategy with downstream delivery so recommendations are actionable rather than theoretical.
  • Surface dependencies, risks and organisational barriers early and engage the right leaders to resolve them.
  • Influence without relying on formal authority.

Practice & Capability

  • Contribute reusable approaches, frameworks, insights and lessons from customer engagements to strengthen Digital Strategy capability across ANZ.
  • Help evolve how Professional Services demonstrates and communicates customer value.
  • Bring emerging practices, including AI-enabled transformation where relevant, into customer strategy conversations in a practical and credible way.
  • Coach colleagues informally through strategic engagements and contribute expertise across the wider Professional Services organisation.

What Success Looks Like

Success in the role is demonstrated when:

  • Customers have greater clarity on the business outcomes they are trying to achieve and the priorities required to achieve them.
  • Strategic engagements result in actionable recommendations, investment decisions or transformation initiatives.
  • Customer executives view Adobe as a credible strategic partner, not simply a technology vendor.
  • Adobe adoption is increasingly connected to measurable customer value.
  • Strategic engagement creates or materially advances appropriate Services and Adobe growth opportunities.
  • Customer value work contributes positively to retention, renewal or expansion discussions where relevant.
  • Cross-functional Adobe teams are aligned around the customer's strategic priorities and intended outcomes.
  • Strategic methods, insights and reusable capability improve across ANZ Professional Services.

What You'll Bring

Essential

  • Demonstrated experience advising senior executives on digital transformation, customer experience, marketing, business strategy or comparable enterprise change.
  • Strong consulting capability: discovery, structured problem solving, hypothesis development, synthesis and executive recommendation.
  • Experience converting ambiguous business problems into clear strategies, priorities and actions.

Valuable
