title: Critical Facilities Electrical Technician — Night Shift
description:
The Critical Facilities Technician- Electrician - Second Shift is responsible for providing after-hours electrical operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair support for a mission-critical data center. This role supports electrical system reliability, safety, and performance during second-shift operations, including scheduled maintenance windows, alarm response, and shift turnover with day-shift teams.

The position requires strong technical expertise, independent judgment, clear documentation, and strict adherence to mission-critical procedures.

Benefit Information: ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM Employee Benefits | Front Line Team Members

A good job for someone just entering the workforce or returning to the workforce with limited experience and education. ABM is a military and veteran friendly employer, veterans and candidates with military experience encouraged to apply. Military Occupational Specialty Code: 91E, 91C, EM, HT, MK, DC, 1161, 1341, 3E1X1

  • Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on electrical systems, including switchgear, panels, breakers, transformers, lighting systems, receptacles, and power distribution equipment.
  • Support electrical infrastructure associated with critical systems, including UPS systems, generators, ATS/STS equipment, and emergency power distribution, within contract scope and qualifications.
  • Monitor electrical systems and respond to alarms, alerts, and service requests during second shift.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose electrical issues using appropriate testing equipment and approved procedures.
  • Execute all work in accordance with approved SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, lockout/tagout, arc-flash requirements, and change-control processes.
  • Support planned maintenance activities and minor electrical work scheduled during second-shift maintenance windows.
  • Coordinate with Mechanical, HVAC, Controls, and Chiller teams to support integrated system operations.
  • Escort and oversee third-party electrical contractors, OEM technicians, or vendors performing after-hours work.
  • Provide clear and accurate shift turnover documentation to ensure continuity of operations.
  • Accurately record all work performed, findings, and corrective actions in the CMMS.
  • Maintain strict adherence to safety requirements, applicable codes, environmental policies, and company standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 4-6 years of commercial or industrial electrical experience; mission-critical or data center experience preferred.
  • Strong understanding of electrical distribution systems and critical power infrastructure.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, one-line diagrams, schematics, and technical documentation.
  • Proficient in the use of electrical testing and diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to work independently during off-peak hours with minimal supervision while following escalation procedures.
  • Strong communication skills, especially for shift handoffs, escalation, and written documentation.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; technical or trade school preferred.

Preferred Certifications / Training

  • Journeyman Electrician license or state-recognized equivalent preferred
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 preferred
  • NFPA 70E training preferred
  • Data center or critical facilities training preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to stand, walk, kneel, bend, and work in electrical and mechanical rooms for extended periods.
  • Ability to climb ladders and work at heights as required.

Work Environment

  • Mission-critical data center environment requiring high attention to detail, procedural discipline, safety awareness, and reliable shift documentation.
  • Second-shift coverage; occasional extended hours or emergency response may be required.

Why ABM

ABM Mission Critical Solutions supports highly reliable data center environments where precision, safety, and uptime are essential. Our electricians work with advanced electrical systems in a structured, safety-first culture with opportunities for long-term growth and advancement.

title: Security Officer,Temple (Full time) - Los Angeles CA Temple

description:
Ensures the temple ordinances are kept pure, recorded accurately and made available to worthy Church members by:

  • Maintaining and operating temples at standards established by the First Presidency.

20% Makes required number of reviews of buildings and grounds during assigned shift.

description:
Gateway Rehab Center (GRC) is hiring a PRN Outpatient Therapist for our Monroeville, PA location! In this rewarding role, you will provide evidence-based therapy and support individuals throughout their recovery journey, helping them build the skills, resilience, and confidence needed for lasting change.


If you're passionate about helping others, skilled in therapeutic interventions, and committed to making a meaningful impact in the lives of those affected by addiction, keep reading!


Why You'll Love Working at GRC

  • Mission-driven work supporting individuals and families impacted by addiction.
  • Opportunity to provide life-changing therapeutic services in an outpatient treatment setting.
  • Collaborative multidisciplinary team dedicated to recovery and wellness.
  • Meaningful work that empowers patients to build healthier, more fulfilling lives.


Why This Role is Important to SUD Treatment

GRC's Outpatient team is changing lives, and as an Outpatient Therapist, you'll be at the forefront of this mission. Through individual, group, and family counseling, you'll help patients develop healthy coping skills, overcome barriers to recovery, and create lasting change. Your work expands access to quality treatment and provides the support individuals need to achieve long-term recovery and sustained wellness. This is more than a job. It's an opportunity to make a lasting impact every single day.


Responsibilities:

  • Utilize and promote trauma-informed treatment through evidence-based practices.
  • Participate in developing patient treatment plans and outcomes in collaboration with the treatment team.
  • Provide direct therapeutic services, including individual, group, and family therapy based on patient needs.
  • Conduct ongoing assessments of patient progress and revise treatment plans as appropriate.
  • Complete clinical documentation accurately and within required timeframes.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with referral sources associated with assigned caseloads.
  • Coordinate continuing care planning and make appropriate referrals.
  • Monitor and complete insurance authorizations for assigned patients.
  • Provide referrals for additional care and support services as needed.
  • Maintain expected productivity standards.
  • Participate in regular supervision and seek additional clinical guidance when appropriate.
  • Adhere to all HIPAA requirements and confidentiality standards.
  • Comply with OMHSAS, DPW, and DDAP regulations and requirements.
  • Complete required orientation, annual trainings, and attendance documentation.
  • Provide coverage for other programs as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


What You Bring

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Understanding of the psychological, physiological, and social aspects of addiction.
  • Ability to conduct comprehensive assessments and identify substance use and co-occurring disorders.
  • Experience facilitating individual and group counseling sessions.
  • Strong critical thinking and clinical decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage stress and maintain professionalism in challenging situations.
  • Commitment to patient confidentiality and ethical practice.
  • Passion for helping individuals achieve recovery and wellness.

title: Senior Salesforce Engineer
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Salesforce Engineer to join our team full-time in Romania.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Salesforce Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

The company is on an incredible journey to become the universal symbol of trust. As the world's largest independent consumer review platform, they bring consumers and businesses together to foster transparency and improvement. With over 300 million reviews and 64 million monthly active users, the work we do together has a massive global impact, helping millions of people make better choices every day. In this role, you will join the Go To Market department within the Technology organization. You will be pivotal in delivering large strategic projects and change requests across the Salesforce platform, supporting commercial, marketing, ops, and customer service teams. You will work as a key link with the business-wide team responsible for the entire company’s Salesforce ecosystem, working with a proactive approach to operational excellence, system architecture, code quality, and process automation.

Responsibilities:

  • Salesforce Development & Architecture: Design, develop, and implement custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and platform automation (Flows)
  • Integrations & APIs: Build and maintain secure integrations between Salesforce and internal/external systems using REST, SOAP, and various API integration patterns
  • Declarative & Automated Solutions: Develop and maintain complex Salesforce Flows and process automations, balancing programmatic capabilities with declarative best practices for optimal performance and scalable architecture
  • Collaborative Engineering & Peer Review: Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, unit testing, and quality assurance alongside the cross-functional GTM Tech team and broader Salesforce engineering ecosystem
  • DevOps & Delivery: Apply change management via standard CI/CD pipelines, using version control tools (e.g., GitHub) and deployment workflows for smooth project delivery
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, system auditing evidence, and integration/customization processes
  • Team Growth & Support: Collaborate closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders, provide support and guidance to junior team members/administrators, and contribute to an inclusive knowledge-sharing environment

Requirements:

  • We are looking for engineers with a strong background in Salesforce development and apassion for high-quality, scalable code
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Developer & Administrator, specifically with Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Core Declarative & Programmatic Skills: Expert proficiency in Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and platform automation tools (Salesforce Flows)
  • Web Fundamentals: Solid understanding of web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Integrations & Security: Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP, Bulk) and understanding of Salesforce security models (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, roles)
  • Quality & QA: Strong focus on unit testing, debugging, and familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Provar)
  • DevOps & Developer Tools: Salesforce CLI, version control (GitHub), and CI/CD tools

Desirable:

  • Certifications: Advanced Administrator or Platform Developer, or System/Application Architect certifications are a strong plus
  • Exposure to Salesforce Community Cloud (Experience Cloud) or other collaboration platforms
  • Hands-on experience or familiarity with Agentforce
  • Knowledge of highly distributed system architectures and integration architecture patterns

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Enjoy radical flexibility – work remotely or from an office, your choice
  • Care: Medical subscription to Regina Maria, meal tickets of 40 ron net/day worked

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

In Romania, we welcome top-tier tech talent — whether from our Bucharest office or fully remotely. Tap into deep industry knowledge, grow your career, and make an impact in an empowering environment.

title: Special Inspector - Construction Materials Testing
description:
Special Inspector - Construction - Miami, Florida

Intertek, a Nationally Recognized Testing Lab (NRTL) and leading provider of quality and safety solutions to many of the world’s leading brands and companies, is actively seeking a Special Inspector to join our Building & Construction team in Miami, FL. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow a versatile career in the architectural, engineering, and construction (A/E/C) industry.

About the Building & Construction Team

Intertek's Building & Construction division is a suite of Intertek brands that are industry leaders across multiple architecture, engineering, and construction disciplines, developing the most innovative product and project solutions. Intertek's project-related assurance, testing, inspection, and consulting services are the risk management and quality assurance partner you need to ensure the reliability, safety, and performance of your new developments, existing assets, and facilities.

Professional Service Industries, Inc. (Intertek-PSI) is a leading US based provider of assurance, testing, inspection, and consulting solutions in civil and commercial construction. Our broad service offering includes construction materials testing, geotechnical engineering, environmental consulting, industrial hygiene, and specialty testing.

What are we looking for?

The Special Inspector is responsible for performing field inspections and construction materials testing as needed to ensure conformance with construction plans and specifications. The inspector is also responsible for preparing inspection daily reports and testing data sheets.

What you’ll do:

  • Performs a variety of testing, project-specific observations, and inspection duties under general supervision.
  • Operates testing equipment and conducts testing, (example: Soil, concrete, or other) and provides an assessment of data through reporting
  • Works utilizing drawings, specifications, and diagrams
  • Uses specific methods to observe site activities and perform tasks
  • Reads and Interprets Plans and Specifications
  • Maintains and calibrates standard equipment
  • Performs complex assignments
  • Attends project meetings
  • Makes detailed observations and gives the interpretation of results
  • Maintains detailed documentation and data from test results
  • Operates a calculator to calculate mathematical test results
  • Communicates effectively with client and project teams
  • Must be aware of, and adhere to, safety practices and policies to ensure your own safety, as well as the safety of others who may be affected by your actions at work


Minimum Requirements & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of special inspection and/or construction materials testing experience is required
  • External (or task related) certifications may be required based on region and state.
  • Must have Basic Math, Calculator and Computer Skills
  • Ability to communicate and interact effectively in verbal & written communication
  • Must be able to read and understand work plans
  • Must be able to work off shifts and overtime
  • Valid Driver’s License and reliable driving record (required)


Preferred Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering preferred
  • ACI/ICC/PTI Certifications are highly desired
    • ACI level I
    • ACI Concrete Construction Special Inspector
    • ICC Reinforcing Steel inspector
    • ICC Reinforced Concrete Masonry Inspector
    • ICC Soil Inspector

title: Superintendent
description:
Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.

This position is in our Food Enterprise where we are committed to serving food manufacturers, food service customers, and retailers with a complete range of innovative ingredients and branded products. Our portfolio includes poultry, beef, egg, alternative protein, salt, oils, starches, sweeteners, cocoa and chocolate.

Job Purpose and Impact

The Superintendent is accountable for strategic leadership, execution, and continuous improvement of facility‑wide sanitation programs, ensuring compliance with food safety, quality, regulatory, cost, delivery, safety, and training requirements. This role owns the development, implementation, evaluation, and optimization of sanitation systems and processes, proactively preventing product contamination while strengthening the partnership between Operations, Quality, Safety, and Sanitation functions.

The Superintendent provides strategic leadership and oversight for plant sanitation programs, ensuring sanitation activities are effectively planned, executed, and aligned with broader business, operational, safety, and quality objectives. This role manages complex schedules by establishing priorities, assigning resources, and maintaining frequent communication with staff and key stakeholders to ensure work is completed efficiently and on time. The Superintendent actively plans, coordinates, and provides direction across sanitation‑related programs, including quality assurance, food safety, employee relations, health and safety, operations, and maintenance, while maintaining a forward‑thinking perspective on the operational and business impacts of sanitation decisions. Through strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and disciplined follow‑through, the role oversees the cleaning and sanitization of equipment, surfaces, utensils, and the plant environment, providing leadership, motivation, and technical support to teams. The Sanitation Superintendent models integrity, accountability, and a one‑team mindset, effectively giving and receiving feedback to develop leaders and strengthen team performance, while partnering with contractors, suppliers, and technical experts to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes of non‑conformities, and drive sustainable corrective actions that uphold safety and quality standards.

Key Accountabilities

  • Provide senior‑level leadership and technical oversight for the cleaning and sanitization of processing equipment, utensils, food contact and non‑food contact surfaces, and the full plant environment, supporting sanitation teams and cross‑functional partners as operational needs arise.
  • Strategically plan sanitation requirements and activities by establishing priorities, budgets, and schedules; assigning work; and communicating expectations clearly and consistently across departments and shifts.
  • Own the sanitation program lifecycle, including development, implementation, execution, evaluation, and continuous improvement, ensuring compliance with company policies and governmental regulations.
  • Monitor, update, and enforce sanitation standard operating procedures (SSOPs) and actively participate in internal and external audits, leading corrective and preventive action plans based on audit findings.
  • Manage the ordering, inventory, storage, and safe handling of sanitation agents and cleaning chemicals, ensuring compliance with safety, regulatory, and environmental requirements.
  • Partner with contractors, suppliers, and technical experts to troubleshoot sanitation issues, analyze root causes, and eliminate non‑conformities through sustainable solutions.
  • Support and execute company safety programs at the facility level and provide input into sanitation excellence initiatives across the broader organization.
  • Lead, coach, and develop sanitation leadership and frontline teams, making sound decisions related to hiring, performance management, feedback, and disciplinary actions while modeling integrity and accountability.
  • Demonstrate strong business acumen by balancing food safety, quality, cost, labor, and operational priorities without compromising compliance or safety standards.
  • Other duties as assigned

#LIAC6

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
  • Minimum requirement of 4 years of relevant work experience (sanitation or food manufacturing experience). Typically reflects 5 years or more of relevant experience
  • Knowledge of the sanitation process, cleaning chemistry, chemical storage, handling and dispensing systems and sanitary design principles
  • Knowledge of industry related quality systems and inspection programs, cleaning systems and chemicals

Preferred Qualifications

  • Two years of supervisory experience
  • Knowledge of good manufacturing process, safety, lock out and tag out and health and safety regulations
  • Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), lockout/tagout, environmental health and safety, and occupational safety regulations.
  • Prior experience leading sanitation operations in a multi‑shift, high‑complexity manufacturing environment.

Posting Details

  • Location: Timberville, VA; relocation support may be provided
  • Open to US based candidates; visa sponsorship will not be provided
  • If selected for an interview, you will be required to submit signed copies of your last two performance reviews. (A completed e-PMP is considered a signed copy.)
  • The expected salary for this position is $110,000 - $130,000. Compensation varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific location, certifications, education, and level of experience. The disclosed range estimate may be adjusted for any applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. This position is eligible for a discretionary incentive award. The incentive award amount is dependent upon company performance and your personal performance.​ At Cargill we put people first. As part of your overall rewards, we offer a comprehensive benefit program including medical and/or other benefits dependent on the position offered and hours worked. Visit: health/mh-health-and-wellness to learn more (subject to certain collective bargaining agreements for Union positions).​​

Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Vet

Please know that Cargill will never ask you for money during the hiring process, and in most cases, we only accept applications through our official careers site, with the exception of some roles in our production plants. title: Overland Park - American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor/ Trainer
description:
About Us

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

Note: The Instructor Trainer's teaching methods and content must comply with American Red Cross requirements.

License / Certification

  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Certification, r.25 — Required if you are looking for an instructor role
  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Trainer Certification, r.25 — Required﻿ ﻿if you are looking for an instructor trainer role
  • American Red Cross BLS Instructor Trainer Certification — Preferred
  • American Heart Association BLS Instructor Certification — Preferred
  • Other equivalent Instructor Trainer certifications may be considered where an approved bridging pathway is available; we can provide bridging guidance.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.
  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.
  • Monitor and evaluate candidate progress to ensure proficiency.
  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with CPR and AED training best practices.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

  • Current American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor certification.
  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to demonstrate proper CPR and AED techniques.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.
  • Work may be performed primarily during weekends.

Salary and Benefits

Salary: $30.00 - $40.00 per teaching hour, commensurate with experience and length of working relationship with ALLCPR.

Additional Compensation: $10.00 per enrolled student. (Only for instructor trainer role)

Job Classification: 1099 Contractor or Part-Time Employee (Certain States).

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule.

Schedule

  • Day shift.
  • Weekend/Weekday availability.

Ability to Commute / Relocate

Location: Local area as per job post

Reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (Required).

Experience

  • Teaching: 2+ years (Preferred).

Job Type

  • Part-time
  • Contract

Work Location: In person

title: Visionær og ambitiøs direktør for Kooperationen
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for en værdibåret arbejdsgiver- og interesseorganisation, og kan du omsætte vores stærke fundament til medlemsvækst og udvikling til gavn for både medlemmer og samfund?

Kooperationen søger en engageret, ambitiøs og kommercielt orienteret direktør, som vil stå i spidsen for en helt særlig organisation, hvor målet er at understøtte og styrke fællesskabet mellem virksomheder, der driver forretning på et demokratisk, ansvarligt og værdibåret grundlag. Du skal stå i spidsen for at omsætte Kooperationens potentiale til større synlighed, mere gennemslagskraft, stærkere medlemsværdi og nye fællesskaber. Det skal ske med respekt for de kooperative værdier og med blik for, at medlemsvækst både handler om at tiltrække nye virksomheder og om at passe godt på dem, der allerede er en del af fællesskabet.

Velkommen til Kooperationen – vi er en helt særlig arbejdsgiverorganisation

Kooperationen er nemlig en arbejdsgiver- og interesseorganisation for kooperative, socialøkonomiske og værdibårne virksomheder, der vil mere end bundlinjen alene. Vi bygger på fællesskab, demokratisk indflydelse og ansvarlig virksomhedsdrift, og samler alt fra større virksomheder og fonde til håndværksvirksomheder, faglige organisationer og mindre værdibårne aktører.

Vi skaber værdi gennem rådgivning om bl.a. jura, overenskomster og medarbejderforhold samt gennem politisk interessevaretagelse, netværk og viden. Kooperationen lever i medlemsvirksomhederne, de lokale Fællesråd og de fællesskaber, der skabes på tværs. Som direktør skal du styrke forbindelsen mellem de lokale og nationale kræfter og sikre, at Kooperationen opleves som en nærværende og handlekraftig organisation.

"Vi er lykkedes med mange tiltag i de senere år, og vi er nu klar til næste ryk. Vi ønsker at styrke vores synlighed og vores medlemstilbud og øge værdien for både nuværende og nye medlemmer. Vores ambition er at få endnu flere med i det kooperative fællesskab, vi tilbyder, for vi kan noget særligt som arbejdsgiver- og interesseorganisation. Det skal du som direktør stå i spidsen for," fortæller forperson Frederik Petersen.

Kooperationen står i dag stærkere end for få år siden. Økonomien og organisationen er stabiliseret, den politiske opmærksomhed på kooperative virksomheder og medarbejdereje er voksende, og der er igangsat en række spændende udviklingsinitiativer. Med et styrket fundament er Kooperationen klar til at samle flere virksomheder om det kooperative fællesskab, styrke værdien for de nuværende medlemmer og stå endnu tydeligere som en relevant stemme for demokratisk og værdibåret virksomhedsdrift.

Du sætter retningen – strategisk, kommercielt og organisatorisk

Som direktør får du det overordnede ansvar for Kooperationens strategi, drift, økonomi og organisation. Det betyder, at du både skal sætte retningen, holde overblikket og omsætte ambitioner til handling. Du skal gå forrest i at engagere vores omverden i Kooperationen bl.a. via fortællingen om, hvad vi er, hvem vi er til for, og hvordan det skaber værdi for og styrker både samfundet og den enkelte virksomhed, så flere får lyst til at være en del af fællesskabet. Du står naturligvis ikke alene, men leder et engageret sekretariat med 11 medarbejdere og arbejder tæt sammen med en aktiv bestyrelse, medlemmerne og centrale samarbejdspartnere.

Som direktør bliver dine væsentligste opgaver at:

  • Udarbejde og sikre eksekveringen af en ambitiøs og realistisk forretningsstrategi med fokus på medlemsvækst, kontingentindtægter og økonomisk balance.

  • Gøre Kooperationens særlige værdigrundlag og medlemsfællesskab tydeligt for eksisterende og nye medlemmer.

  • Sikre, at medlemmerne møder kompetent rådgivning, får hurtig adgang til den rette hjælp og oplever, at Kooperationen forstår deres situation. Det indebærer bl.a. at udvikle medlemsydelserne, så de skaber værdi i medlemmernes hverdag.

  • Sikre klar prioritering, hensigtsmæssig organisering og fremdrift i sekretariatets opgaver og indsatser.

  • Varetage den daglige ledelse af sekretariatet, herunder sikre en sund og solid økonomi og drift og en kompetent medarbejderstab i fortsat god trivsel.

  • Udvikle og vedligeholde strategiske partnerskaber med fx fagbevægelsen, tænketanke, fonde, uddannelsesinstitutioner og andre relevante aktører.

  • Være Kooperationens tydelige ansigt udadtil over for medlemmer, potentielle medlemmer, politikere, medier, samarbejdspartnere, fonde og foreninger.

  • Betjene bestyrelsen professionelt og sikre et konstruktivt samspil mellem bestyrelse, medlemmer og sekretariat.

  • Repræsentere Kooperationen i relevante bestyrelser, fonde og samarbejdsfora.

Er du en synlig og forretningsdrevet leder med værdier, der matcher Kooperationens?

Vi søger en direktør med erfaring som fx direktør, kommerciel direktør, medlemsdirektør eller tilsvarende. Vi tror, du kan komme fra en arbejdsgiver-, faglig-, medlems-, interesse- eller brancheorganisation eller en anden værdibåren og medlemsdrevet virksomhed eller organisation, hvor du er vant til at stå i spidsen for og balancere kommercielle ambitioner med stærke samfundsværdier. Kendskab til arbejdsmarkeds- og erhvervsforhold er absolut et plus.

Vores direktør skal kunne lede en organisation, hvor forretning, værdier og fællesskab går hånd i hånd. Vi lægger således vægt på, at du bl.a. har

  • Solid erfaring med strategisk ledelse, personaleledelse, forretningsudvikling og organisationsudvikling.

  • Stærk kommerciel erfaring og forståelse, og kan omsætte strategi til konkrete indsatser og resultater.

  • Dokumenteret erfaring med at skabe vækst og udvikling i en sammenlignelig – og gerne værdidrevet – organisation.

  • Arbejdet med økonomisk ledelse, herunder budgettering og likviditetsstyring, og vant til at balancere udvikling med sikker drift og økonomisk disciplin.

  • Erfaring med bestyrelsesbetjening og samarbejde.

  • Stærke relationelle kompetencer, og kan skabe følgeskab blandt medarbejdere, medlemmer, bestyrelse og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

title: Lead Maintenance - The Place at Briarcrest - Carrollton, TX
description:
Position Overview

Valiant Residential is seeking Lead Maintenance who is responsible for the overall maintenance of the property under the direction of the Community Manager. The lead maintenance is also responsible for performing repairs in resident apartments and assisting in preparing units for rent (make-ready).


We Are Valiant

With over 37 years of experience, Valiant Residential is a?next-generation property management leader, uniquely attuned to the needs of property owners and residents. We are driven by a Valiant Spirit—bold, innovative, and committed to excellence—fostering prosperous partnerships and long-term success. Our team thrives on collaboration, integrity, and strategic thinking, making a meaningful impact in the industry.


Why Work at Valiant?

At Valiant Residential, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers. Consistently ranked as a "Top Place to Work," we are a leader in the property management industry, driven by bold, innovative professionals who make an impact.

We believe in rewarding great work with competitive total compensation and time off with comprehensive benefits, including free health insurance options and 401(k) matching. Growth isn’t just encouraged—it’s expected. With career development opportunities, a collaborative culture, and a commitment to innovation, we empower our employees to thrive.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Service requests made by residents should be completed within 24 hours.
  • Assist in the distribution of flyers and other materials.
  • Replace filters and clean air conditioning vents as needed.
  • Maintain sprinkler systems.
  • Perform HVAC repairs as needed.
  • Perform light electrical repairs on appliances, fixtures, switches, outlets, circuits, etc.
  • Perform light plumbing work, such as clearing stoppages, replacing, fitting, etc.
  • Replace broken glass, tile, carpet, screens, garbage disposals, fixtures, appliances, blinds, locks, bulbs, etc.
  • Paint interior and exterior when necessary.
  • Perform carpentry work, such as fitting doors, freeing windows, replacing and building shelves, sanding, and refinishing floors.
  • Assist in custodial work, including sweeping, mopping, vacuuming, emptying trash, cleaning windows, etc., in common areas.
  • Assist in groundwork, including picking up litter and “trashing out” vacancies.
  • Maintain pool chemical levels and cleanliness.
  • Repair concrete, masonry, roof, and fencing when required.
  • Perform limited extermination services when required.
  • Be responsible for refurbishing apartments prior to resident occupancy (make-ready).
  • Conduct exterior and interior preventive maintenance as outlined by the property or regional manager.
  • Periodically inspect all units, buildings, and common areas, performing repairs and janitorial assistance as needed.
  • Assist in apartment move-in and move-out inspections.
  • Knowledgeable about water and gas meter cutoffs, all apartment and fixture cutoffs, and sewer cleanouts, and post a map of same.
  • Supervise sub-contractors working at the property.
  • Immediately report to the manager any dangerous conditions or issues of liability.
  • Keep accurate records regarding preventive maintenance, pool chemicals levels, work orders, apartment make-ready, inventories, and purchase orders.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance on all equipment based on the manufacturer’s recommendations and operating manuals.
  • Order supplies and communicate with vendors.
  • Be responsible for stock control and utilization of maintenance materials.
  • Ensure shops, storage areas, and entrances are kept clean and locked, adequate lighting and ventilation in those areas is maintained, and hazardous materials are correctly stored and labeled.
  • Train and supervise subordinate employees.
  • Schedule subordinate maintenance personnel and work order requests; adhere to maintenance priorities.
  • Handle “on-call” duties whenever needed.
  • Participate in standby emergency schedules for evening, weekend, and holiday coverage.
  • Assist in preparing the property for various inspections.

title: Community Service Representative I
description:
SUMMARY

The CSR I will administer Coastal Villages Region Fund’s (CVRF) economic development programs in their community, in alignment with organizational strategy, policies, and procedures. The CSR I will also represent CVRF through communication, outreach, and customer service. The CSR I supports the effective operation of the Community Service Center (CSC) through additional responsibilities including accounting, recruitment, purchasing, mechanic, and inventory management activities. Moderate to frequent overnight travel is required. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct local implementation-planning and delivery of assigned programs/initiatives within given timelines, on budget, and in alignment with departmental strategy, policies, and procedures
  • Hire, onboard, train, supervise, and evaluate temporary seasonal employees (up to 120)
  • Generate community-wide awareness of CVRF programs/services/initiatives, and distribute outreach materials under the direction of the CSMs and program leadership
  • Liaise with local governments and other community institutions to keep them informed about CVRF operations, and monitor community and government trends to help CVRF understand and meet community needs
  • Provide customer service and respond in a timely manner to requests for services from community members
  • Develop and maintain community-level data and quality insight at the individual, household, and community level
  • Produce accurate reports on assigned programs
  • Conduct facility maintenance and manage office inventory
  • Work directly with in-region staff and other staff members at our Anchorage office over phone, email, web chat, video-conference, and in-person; participate in team problem solving and identification of solutions
  • Set an example for others to follow such as peers, community members, and outside organizations
  • Ensure necessary paperwork for quotes, receiving, billing, and collections are accurately recorded
  • Part time CSR I is expected to provide coverage to operate the CSC during normal business hours as needed (e.g., if the full time CSR I is unavailable; if staffing needs increase during intensive programs like Youth to Work).

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to implement CVRF’s strategy for economic development, including the ability to set appropriate performance targets in alignment with a realistic understanding of local opportunities
  • Ability to become a Notary Public within 6 months of hire
  • Strong understanding of cultural and social dynamics in the CVRF region
  • Ability to develop proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite, CVRF’s Microsoft Dynamics Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool, Smartsheet, and SmartVAN
  • Dedicated to achieving program goals and objectives in a timely manner; willing to contribute enough time and effort so that programs can be carried out excellently, in desired timeframes
  • Ability to show composure in the face of stressful events or situations that arise during work; should be able to handle situations like this in a calm and respectful manner
  • Willing to travel and attend trainings or meetings when assigned to further develop skills and knowledge; should be responsible and reliable to achieve the necessary knowledge and skills when attending trainings or sessions
  • Determined, devoted, self-motivated, and diligent; able to multi-task, especially during busy times
  • Ability to plan and produce local events, including community-based board meetings, and staff-led open houses
  • Ability to conduct effective grassroots organization, including for example, bi-annual Get Out the Vote efforts
  • Ability to gather community feedback through formal survey administration
  • Good listening skills, explanation skills, and the ability to reply to questions with nuanced answers and/or solutions; able to understand how others feel and assess situations for ways to use best practices sourced from around the CVRF region
  • Ability to overcome barriers associated with isolated geographic environment, lack of built infrastructure, poor transportation network, and inconsistent telecommunications to ensure quality results in CVRF communities on a consistent basis

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position requires the ability to sit, be able to effectively use hands and fingers, and talk and listen. Will be occasionally required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; stoop; kneel; and crouch. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Work environment is usually quiet. Frequent overnight travel, and occasional long-term travel is required.

I certify that I am able to perform the essential job functions listed above, with or without reasonable accommodations.

description:

ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM Employee Benefits | Staff & Management.

Oversee Market Operations & Daily Task Execution

Client Relationship

Facilities Operations, Budget Management, and Resource Planning

  • Own facilities budget planning, forecasting, tracking, and cost management; identify opportunities to optimize spend, improve service levels, and support capital and operating expense planning.

  • Strong ability to lead complex workplace initiatives, capital projects, renovations, office moves, and operational improvement efforts from planning through execution.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate business needs, operational risks, and workplace service metrics.

  • Ability to influence, advise, and drive alignment with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.

  • Ability to successfully manage multiple priorities, competing deadlines, and complex projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to manage, coach, develop, and mentor direct reports and project team members while fostering accountability, collaboration, and professional growth.

The successful candidate is:

  • Detail-oriented and process driven.

  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a broader team.

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in an evolving environment.

  • Visible and connected to employees and customers, and consistent about following issues through verified resolution.

Working Environment & Role Requirements

Operating within a fast-paced, professional account environment, this role may support personnel across multiple locations or functional teams. Depending on business demands and priorities, occasional travel and schedule flexibility will be expected.

Account "Integrity Pillars" & Core Commitments:

  • Integration

  • Safety

  • Accountability

  • Cost-Consciousness

  • Operational Rigor

  • Courage

We maintain an elevated, progressive standard and reach our operational targets by integrating these eight core pillars into everyday activities—ranging from strategic planning and team check-ins to individual task execution. title: Information Security Engineer - SOC and Incident Response
description:
About the Team

You will be part of the Enterprise Cyber Security organization responsible for protecting WSI associates, customers, systems, and data. The Security Operations Center (SOC) monitors enterprise security events, investigates suspicious activity, and coordinates response with Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, and technology partners.

About the Role

As an Information Security Engineer - SOC / Incident Response, you will provide Level 2 security operations support through alert triage, event investigation, and coordinated incident response. You will participate in a 24x7 SOC rotation, including weekends, holidays, and on-call coverage as assigned, and use established playbooks and escalation procedures to protect enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Triage, investigate, and document security alerts and events from Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, and other security monitoring platforms.

  • Analyze endpoint, network, identity, and application evidence to distinguish malicious activity from benign events.

  • Execute approved investigation and response playbooks through Cortex XSOAR and/or Google SecOps SOAR.

  • Perform authorized containment actions under established procedures and approval requirements; promptly escalate actions outside delegated authority.

  • Support incident investigations, evidence collection, timeline development, remediation coordination, and post-incident follow-up.

  • Use CrowdStrike, Tanium, MISP, and related tools to enrich investigations and coordinate endpoint response.

  • Escalate significant incidents and complex technical issues to senior responders, Incident Response leadership, and designated incident command roles.

  • Partner with Cyber Threat Intelligence and Detection Engineering on threat hunts, detection feedback, and alert-quality improvements.

  • Maintain accurate case notes, handoff documentation, and operational runbooks for continuous coverage.

  • Participate in 24x7 shift operations, including weekends, holidays, and on-call responsibilities, as assigned.

  • Identify opportunities for safe automation and AI-assisted investigative efficiency while validating results and following response controls.

Criteria

  • 3 years of experience in security operations, incident response, IT security, or a related technical field.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience

  • Foundational knowledge of security monitoring, endpoint security, operating systems, networking, and common attack techniques.

  • Experience triaging alerts, investigating security events, and documenting findings.

  • Familiarity with SIEM, EDR, case management, and escalation procedures.

  • Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 operational environment and communicate clearly during time-sensitive events.

  • Experience with Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, Cortex XSOAR, Google SecOps SOAR, Tanium, or MISP preferred.

  • Experience supporting endpoint containment, evidence handling, threat hunting, or response playbooks preferred.

  • Basic scripting, automation, or AI-assisted analysis experience preferred.

  • This role requires being onsite in the Rocklin, CA, San Jose, CA or Brooklyn, NY office Monday through Thursday.

Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits

  • A generous discount on all WSI brands

  • A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities

  • Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer

  • Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits

  • Tax-free commuter benefits

  • A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health

Continued Learning

  • In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University

  • Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities

  • Resources for self-development

  • Advisor (Mentor) program

  • Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series

title: Laredo - American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor/ Instructor Trainer
description:
About Us

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

Note: The Instructor Trainer's teaching methods and content must comply with American Red Cross requirements.

License / Certification

  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Certification, r.25 — Required if you are looking for an instructor role
  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Trainer Certification, r.25 — Required﻿ ﻿if you are looking for an instructor trainer role
  • American Red Cross BLS Instructor Trainer Certification — Preferred
  • American Heart Association BLS Instructor Certification — Preferred
  • Other equivalent Instructor Trainer certifications may be considered where an approved bridging pathway is available; we can provide bridging guidance.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.
  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.
  • Monitor and evaluate candidate progress to ensure proficiency.
  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with CPR and AED training best practices.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

  • Current American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor certification.
  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to demonstrate proper CPR and AED techniques.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.
  • Work may be performed primarily during weekends.

Salary and Benefits

Salary: $30.00 - $40.00 per teaching hour, commensurate with experience and length of working relationship with ALLCPR.

Additional Compensation: $10.00 per enrolled student. (Only for instructor trainer role)

Job Classification: 1099 Contractor or Part-Time Employee (Certain States).

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule.

Schedule

  • Day shift.
  • Weekend/Weekday availability.

Ability to Commute / Relocate

Location: Local area as per job post

Reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (Required).

Experience

  • Teaching: 2+ years (Preferred).

Job Type

  • Part-time
  • Contract

Work Location: In person

title: Practice Nurses
description:
Join our friendly and supportive team at UFS Healthcare and make a real difference to the health and wellbeing of your community.

UFS Healthcare is a profit-for-purpose organisation with a strong social purpose. With more than 145 years of trusted healthcare service delivery, we are a mutual organisation that reinvests profits to benefit our members, patients and the wider community. Today, we operate 19 pharmacies, four medical centres, an urgent care clinic, optical services and dental services across western Victoria.


We are seeking experienced and motivated Practice Nurses to join our UFS Medical team across our Ballarat medical sites.


As a Practice Nurse, you will provide clinical services to practice patients in collaboration with GPs and other healthcare professionals. You will support patient care through clinical and administrative activities, including triage, care planning, chronic disease management, wound management, health screening, preventative procedures, patient education, recall and register systems, and health promotion. You will also contribute to quality improvement, compliance and efficient daily practice operations.


We currently have the following permanent part-time shift vacancies across our medical sites:

Doveton Street

Monday 9 – 5:30pm

Tuesday 9 – 5:30pm

Thursday 9 – 5:30pm

Friday 9 – 5:30pm (x 2 shifts)

To succeed in this role, you will be a qualified Division 1 Registered Nurse with current AHPRA registration, professional indemnity cover and relevant experience in a primary healthcare or general practice environment. You will also bring:

  • A minimum of one year post-graduate nursing experience.
  • Competence in clinical duties such as triage, wound management, ECG, chronic disease management, aged care assessment, health screening and assisting with clinical procedures.
  • Sound understanding of the general practice sector, Medical Benefits Schedule requirements and the broader health system.
  • Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work as part of a high-functioning team.
  • A patient-focused approach, including a commitment to confidentiality, infection control, accreditation, compliance and safe clinical practice.
  • A commitment to ongoing professional development and UFS Healthcare’s guiding principles.

What We Offer:

  • Learning & Development opportunities to support your professional growth.
  • Staff member discounts on pharmacy, dental and eyecare services.
  • Friendly and supportive team environment with annual celebrations, recognition and reward for a job well done.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a purpose-driven organisation that reinvests in the health of local communities.


Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are looking for an opportunity to use your nursing experience in a values-driven healthcare organisation, we would love to hear from you.

For more information and to view the full position description, visit ufs.com.au.


For a confidential discussion, please contact Megan Vila Pouca on (03) 5327 7729 or via email at peopleandculture@ufs.com.au.

We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We encourage applications from candidates of all cultures, identities and abilities. If you require adjustments during the recruitment process, we are here to support you.

Applications close 5.00pm Wednesday 4th November 2026.

Please note that interviews may commence before the closing date once a suitable pool of applicants has been identified.

title: CSA - Billing Officer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Billing Officer to join the team at CSA Specialised Services (CSA), part of Waste Services Group (WSG), based in Dandenong South.

This is a full-time, office-based position, with standard working hours of 9:00am to 5:00pm, paying $37.59 an hour + Super.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with numbers, solving problems, and managing competing priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. You will need to be comfortable working independently, making informed decisions and communicating confidently with stakeholders at all levels. You will play an important role in ensuring accurate and timely customer billing while working closely with internal teams across the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare, process and distribute high volumes of customer invoices accurately and within required timeframes.

  • Review billing information, customer rates, quotes and supporting documentation to ensure invoice accuracy.

  • Use Microsoft Excel to analyse data, check pricing and support billing activities, including pivot tables and VLOOKUPs.

  • Manage customer enquiries, investigate billing discrepancies and resolve invoicing issues in a timely and professional manner.

  • Work closely with Sales, Accounts Payable, Operations and Credit teams to ensure accurate billing outcomes.

  • Monitor and respond to enquiries received through the billing email inbox.

  • Maintain accurate, organised and confidential billing records.

  • Assist with ad hoc reporting and other accounts-related tasks as required.

  • Manage fluctuating workloads and competing priorities while meeting month-end deadlines.

  • Identify opportunities to improve billing processes and operational efficiency.

About You

  • Approximately 3–5 years of experience in billing, accounts receivable or a similar finance-related role.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including practical experience with pivot tables and VLOOKUPs.

  • A sound understanding of billing principles, invoice calculations and GST.

  • Strong numerical skills and exceptional attention to detail.

  • The ability to analyse information, solve problems and make independent decisions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to liaise with stakeholders across different levels of the business.

  • Strong organisation and time management skills, with the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

  • A positive, adaptable attitude and the ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

  • A collaborative mindset and a willingness to support other accounts team activities when required.

  • Experience with accounts receivable systems, customer billing portals or project-based billing will be highly regarded.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to join an established organisation within the waste services industry.

  • A varied and hands-on role with direct involvement in business operations.

  • Ongoing training and support to help you learn the company's billing systems and processes.

  • The opportunity to collaborate with a range of internal stakeholders and contribute to continuous improvement.

  • A temporary assignment with an initial commitment of at least three months and no confirmed end date.

If you are an experienced Billing Officer who takes pride in accuracy, enjoys problem-solving and thrives in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you - submit your resume today to be considered for this opportunity!

description:

To support this strategic ambition, they are looking for an AI Integration Analyst who will play a central role in identifying, implementing, and driving the adoption of AI-powered solutions throughout the organization.


Jobomschrijving

As AI Integration Analyst, you will act as the link between business teams, project management, IT stakeholders, and international AI communities.

Your mission will be to accelerate the practical adoption of AI by identifying high-value opportunities, supporting implementation projects, delivering training and workshops, and helping employees integrate AI tools into their day-to-day activities: AI Opportunity Identification & Business Engagement

  • Facilitate workshops with business and IT stakeholders to identify AI use cases.
  • Assess and prioritize opportunities according to business value, feasibility, and organizational impact.Translate business challenges into practical AI and automation solutions.
  • Support departments in identifying productivity and efficiency gains through AI.



AI Implementation & Project Support

  • Coordinate and follow up on AI implementation projects across different business functions.
  • Work closely with project managers, data analysts, IT teams, and external partners.
  • Monitor project progress, adoption levels, and business outcomes.
  • Ensure AI initiatives are aligned with governance, compliance, and security requirements.



Training, Adoption & Change Management

  • Develop and deliver AI training sessions, awareness programs, and workshops.
  • Promote best practices for the use of AI technologies throughout the organization.
  • Drive user adoption through communication, coaching, and continuous support.
  • Contribute to the development of the organization's overall AI capabilities and maturity.



International Collaboration

  • Collaborate with colleagues and AI specialists from international entities.
  • Share knowledge, use cases, and implementation experiences.
  • Support the rollout of international AI initiatives at a local level.
  • Act as an ambassador for AI-driven transformation within the business.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Technology, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in AI implementation, digital transformation, innovation, business analysis, project management, process improvement, or technology consulting.
  • Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and emerging AI technologies.
  • Experience working within the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Copilot, Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure AI, or similar technologies).
  • Understanding of APIs, system integrations, data flows, and enterprise technology environments.
  • Experience supporting change management, training initiatives, and technology adoption.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on technical or programming experience is considered an asset but is not required.
  • Good command of Dutch and excellent English communication skills. French would be an advantage but is not required.

title: Patent Agent
description:
Our legal team protects Nielsen’s business, products, intellectual property and reputation. The team places a focus on developing excellence and agility while we minimize risk and move the business forward. Whether we’re solving a problem or helping a client achieve their goals, we're creating the best environment possible to advance Nielsen’s reputation, preserve opportunities, and help the business flourish.

Nielsen is seeking a non-attorney patent agent to join its Intellectual Property Team on a permanent basis. The Patent Agent will work alongside Nielsen’s engineers, data scientists, and other innovators to continue developing a world class patent portfolio to propel Nielsen’s business goals.

The Patent Agent will draft patents protecting technologies related to: design and operation of audience measurement metering devices; approaches for media recognition and classification leveraging digital signal processing, machine learning, and artificial intelligence; approaches for scaling and deduplicating audience measurement estimates via fusion of multiple data sets leveraging a variety of data science methodologies; and approaches for assessing audience engagement and advertising impact.

This fully flexible role is fully remote/work from home (Midwest or Eastern time zones preferred).

Responsibilities:

  • Drafting provisional and non-provisional utility patent applications in-house.
  • Working directly with inventors and colleagues to evaluate invention disclosures.
  • Prosecuting patent applications in-house under supervision of IP portfolio managers both in the United States and in certain foreign jurisdictions by providing direct instructions to outside counsel foreign associates, including interviewing patent examiners, drafting and reviewing office action responses, drafting and reviewing appeal briefs, and all other phases of patent prosecution.
  • Assisting in developing patent strategies that focus patent protection on competitively differentiated features of Nielsen’s products, including working with IP portfolio managers and Nielsen’s product owners to ensure alignment between Nielsen’s business stakeholders and patent strategy.
  • Providing intellectual property support to Nielsen’s engineering and product teams related to its tech portfolio, including invention mining, patent training, and conducting patent audits of Nielsen’s products to identify existing and planned patent coverage and also identify patent whitespace for further IP development.
  • At least 2 years of experience as a patent agent, including drafting patent applications, drafting responses to office actions, and conducting examiner interviews.
  • Degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, electrical engineering, computer engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or related industry experience, and/or in-depth knowledge of media content distribution, including but not limited to broadcast networks, cloud networking, wireless networks, end-user devices used to access and playback media content, artificial intelligence and machine learning, data science methodologies, and identity resolution.
  • Registered to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office.
  • Previous in-house patent preparation and prosecution experience valued.
  • Experience with AI-drafting tools valued.

Enabling your best to power a better media future.

Holistic Rewards: We are committed to an inclusive benefits package that supports our employees and their families. This includes comprehensive health and wellness plans, a 401(k) with a Nielsen company match, and a generous paid time off policy. Depending on the role, additional benefits may include a company-provided vehicle and/or discretionary incentive/bonus eligibility.

Compensation Transparency: The posted base salary range is a reasonable estimate that may be adjusted based on the final work location of the selected employee. Individual pay within the range is determined by factors such as experience, training, geography, certifications, and business needs. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other incentives.

Nielsen makes hiring decisions without regard to disability status, protected veteran status, or membership in any other protected class.

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @ address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

title: Senior Project Manager - Pharmacy
description:
The Senior Project Manager (PM) works independently, assuming primary responsibility for planning, directing, coordinating, and delivering project activities through the entire project life cycle (from initiation through handoff to customer) that are major, complex, and business critical. The Senior PM is responsible for leading project objectives and completion on time, on budget, and in conformance with Mayo Clinic project management methodologies and standards.

The Senior Project Manager serves as the portfolio execution leader for Pharmacy Intelligence & Automation. This role is responsible for coordinating and driving strategic initiatives involving pharmacy analytics, automation, artificial intelligence (AI), reporting, operational transformation, and technology optimization across Mayo Clinic pharmacy practice.

The position provides program leadership for a growing portfolio of initiatives and supports enterprise-wide deployment of innovative solutions that improve medication safety, operational efficiency, workforce productivity, regulatory compliance, and financial stewardship. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to manage a complex portfolio of strategic initiatives, work effectively with executive leaders and frontline staff, establish governance processes, translate strategy into execution, develop roadmaps and executive-level communications, track value realization and return on investment, lead organizational change efforts, and coordinate analytics, automation, AI, and innovation initiatives across pharmacy.

In addition to managing complex individual projects, this role provides oversight and coordination for an enterprise portfolio of strategic initiatives, ensuring work is appropriately prioritized, governed, resourced, measured, and successfully adopted.

The Senior PM will lead large projects that have site- or enterprise-level strategic importance. Project work has high to very high risk and risk interdependencies, multiple interrelationships, and may have major costs associated. Responsible for managing established budgets, the Senior PM leads and provides direction in the development and tracking of project budgets. The position requires strict adherence to budget management practices and guidelines of both the assigned department and the institution.

The Senior PM independently leads problem-solving and decision-making activities within the scope of the project and change management process, taking reasonable and prudent actions to accomplish agreed-upon project objectives. This individual leverages extensive experience to manage large-scale initiatives and is highly competent in the implementation and sustainment of project outcomes. Advanced negotiation skills, strategic thinking, and innovative problem-solving are essential to this role.

In addition to traditional project management responsibilities, this role is expected to support portfolio governance, strategic planning, executive reporting, stakeholder engagement, organizational change management, resource coordination, and benefits realization activities for enterprise pharmacy initiatives.

The use and application of Agile, Lean, and continuous improvement methodologies is important to this role. The successful candidate must be comfortable leading both technology-focused and operational transformation initiatives while adapting project approaches to meet organizational needs.

Many of the items important to an Agile process are not unique to Agile. This individual may be responsible for monitoring scrum processes and scrum meetings. They may work to increase efficiency, motivate teams, and advocate for changes that ensure quality and timeliness. Responsibilities may include:

  • Guiding teams on Agile practices and values to implement critical projects.
  • Assessing team and organizational maturity and coaching teams to higher levels of performance and effectiveness.
  • Removing impediments and blockers or guiding teams to do so; escalating appropriately when necessary.
  • Building a trusting and collaborative environment where issues can be openly raised and resolved.
  • Facilitating completion of work without coercion, assignment, or directive management approaches.
  • Facilitating discussion, decision making, and conflict resolution.
  • Supporting and educating Product Owners, particularly regarding backlog development and backlog refinement.

May have direct and indirect reports and may be responsible for leading and developing project staff in a goal-oriented manner. The Senior Project Manager leads and demonstrates a project-focused culture at Mayo Clinic and serves as a mentor and advisor to others regarding project management practices, methods, and standards.

This role will frequently interact with executive leaders, pharmacy operational leaders, informatics professionals, analysts, technology teams, and clinical stakeholders. Success requires strong executive communication skills, strategic thinking, influence without authority, and the ability to translate organizational priorities into executable plans while managing multiple concurrent initiatives.

Examples of work may include:

  • Medication management reporting and business intelligence.
  • Pharmacy analytics and dashboard modernization.
  • Automation and workflow optimization initiatives.
  • AI and advanced analytics programs.
  • Epic-related pharmacy transformation efforts.
  • Drug shortage and inventory analytics.
  • Medication safety and diversion surveillance initiatives.
  • Operational excellence and continuous improvement programs.
  • Pharmacy technology and digital transformation initiatives.

Performs additional job-related functions as detailed by immediate supervisor.

Preferred Experience

  • Healthcare PMO leadership.
  • Enterprise digital transformation programs.
  • Clinical or pharmacy informatics.
  • Healthcare analytics, business intelligence, or data governance programs.
  • Operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • AI, automation, or emerging technology implementations.

  • Experience working with executive governance structures, steering committees, and enterprise portfolios.

This position is a hybrid role, and the candidate must live within 100 miles of Rochester, Minnesota. On-site days will be purpose-driven and may include activities such as collaboration with colleagues, practice shadowing, and workflow observation. On-site requirements are estimated to be approximately two days per quarter.

This vacancy is not eligible for sponsorship/ we will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position. Also, Mayo Clinic DOES NOT participate in the F-1 STEM OPT extension program.

Bachelor's degree with 10 years’ experience in Project Management and business related activities or Master's degree with 7 years’ experience in Project Management. Education preference: project management, business administration, agile/scrum, management. Active (unexpired) Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required.

Candidates should also include any certifications they have, which do not supersede the PMP certification, which may include but are not necessarily limited to Certified Product Management, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Advanced Certified Scrum Master (A-CSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner, Risk Management Professional (RMP) and/or Certified Scrum Professional (CSP).

title: Madison - American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor/ Instructor Trainer
description:
About Us

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

Note: The Instructor Trainer's teaching methods and content must comply with American Red Cross requirements.
