title: Senior Data Engineer (Analytics Engineering)
description:
We're building the future of mobility.

At hlpy, we're building much more than a company.

We're building the technology platform that is transforming how mobility services are delivered across Europe.

Every month, our platform orchestrates tens of thousands of real-world operations, connecting drivers, insurers, fleets, OEMs, service providers and business partners through technology.

As we continue to expand internationally, broaden our product offering and integrate new businesses, the complexity of what we do grows with us.

Scaling hlpy isn't simply about increasing revenues.

It's about building an organization capable of executing consistently across countries, products and teams.

To get there, strategy alone isn't enough.

Execution is what makes the difference.

That's why we're looking for a genuinely senior, hands-on Data Engineer to join our AI & Data team as a peer to our current engineers — someone who owns definitions, not just deliverables.

Our analytics platform — dbt on Snowflake, fed by CDC replication from our operational PostgreSQL estate, by our ERP, and by partner files and webhooks — is what tells hlpy and its enterprise customers what actually happened on every roadside assistance mission across four countries. Those numbers are not decoration: they settle SLAs, they drive invoices, and they land in our customers' inboxes every morning.

You will own models end to end, from raw source to the extraction files our contracts depend on, and you will be expected to push back when a number is wrong.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and own models across the full stack — staging, intermediate, the entity-pure silver layer, marts, and the customer-facing outbound extractions — in a dbt project of roughly 200 models and growing.
  • Build models that stand up to scrutiny. There are cases where the same business event is captured by more than one system, and the right answer is not obvious from the data alone: we expect you to investigate, connect with the people who produce and use that data, agree on a rule, publish it with its provenance, and make it testable.
  • Take genuine end-to-end responsibility: scoping, modelling, testing, review, release — and what happens in production the morning after.
  • Migrate legacy business logic out of hand-written database views and ad-hoc scripts into dbt, without silently changing a number a customer is already reading.

Semantics, Data Quality & Governance

  • Treat definitions as a deliverable. A metric is not done until it is named, documented, tested, and impossible to compute a second way somewhere else in the estate.
  • Build the test layer that catches real defects — grain, referential integrity, reconciliation against source, negative durations, silent timezone reinterpretation — rather than decorative tests that always pass.
  • Measure the impact of every definition change before it ships, and communicate it clearly to the teams that rely on the number.
  • Help maintain and extend our house conventions, which live in the repository, are graded by a linter in CI, and are changed by merge request like any other code.
  • Contribute to the shared vocabulary: one name, one meaning, written down, for every event and metric the business argues about.

Pipelines, Sources & Platform

  • Work hands-on with the ingestion layer that feeds the warehouse: CDC replication from PostgreSQL (Airbyte), API extraction from NetSuite via SuiteQL, partner file drops over S3 and SFTP, and inbound webhooks.
  • Keep it healthy and affordable: replication slot health and WAL budgets, incremental strategies, warehouse and connector cost, and the honest trade-offs between CDC and cheaper capture methods.
  • Contribute to our orchestration migration (Airflow to Astronomer) and to retiring the legacy reporting jobs that still live outside dbt.

Customer-Facing Data Products

  • Build and operate the daily extractions, SLA reports and KPI files that our enterprise fleet, leasing and rental customers receive — contractual deliverables with a recipient, not dashboards.
  • Model contractual logic — thresholds, exclusions, effective dates, per-partner exceptions — so it lives in one governed place instead of in a folder of spreadsheets.
  • Work directly with other business units and the customer-facing teams to agree what a number means before building it, and to explain it afterwards.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a dashboard-building or BI-reporting role.
  • Not a pure ingestion or plumbing role — the modelling and the semantics are the job.
  • Not a ticket-taking role: we are not looking for someone who writes SQL to someone else's spec.
  • Not a data science or ML role.

Required Skills & Experience

This is a real senior role. We are hiring for judgement as much as for tooling.

  • 5+ years building and operating production data platforms, with several of those years spent doing analytics engineering on a modern cloud warehouse.
  • Deep, hands‑on dbt: incremental models, snapshots and SCD2, macros, generic and singular tests, packages, selectors, exposures, CI runs — plus firm opinions on project structure and layering, and the ability to defend them.
  • Expert SQL on a cloud warehouse (Snowflake strongly preferred): window functions, query profiling, clustering, and cost and performance tuning.
  • Comfortable with an orchestrator (Airflow, Astronomer, Dagster or similar) and with Git-based delivery: branches, merge requests, peer review, CI.
  • Reliable on commitments: you plan realistically, flag risks early, and hit the deadlines you agree to — our customer-facing deliverables run on a daily schedule and cannot slip.
  • Fluent working alongside AI coding agents as part of your day‑to‑day delivery.
  • Experience modelling from source systems you do not control, where the upstream data is incomplete, contradictory or occasionally wrong.
  • The seniority signal we care about most: you can take a vague business question, investigate how the data is actually produced upstream, and come back with a model, a number, and the caveats that belong with it.
  • Professional working English, written and spoken. Italian is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience modelling ERP, billing or invoicing data (NetSuite a strong plus).
  • Semantic layer or metrics layer experience.
  • Experience with contractual, regulated or externally audited reporting, where a wrong number has consequences.
  • Data contracts, lineage or data observability tooling.

What We Offer

  • Salary package ranging from € 55.000 to € 60.000 and MBO.
  • Fresh fruit and good snacks to share with your nice colleagues
  • Training budget
  • Remote Working

Why hlpy

Because we're building something meaningful.

Because we move fast.

Because responsibility grows faster than hierarchy.

Because we believe the best ideas can come from anyone.

Because we value ownership over politics and execution over bureaucracy.

And because if we do our job well, millions of people across Europe will experience mobility in a smarter, faster and more reliable way.

If building rather than maintaining excites you, we'd love to meet you.

title: Fellowship Program Manager
description:
Job Function Summary

Involves designing, conducting, promoting, evaluating and supporting health professions education programs in compliance with organizational objectives and nationally accepted accreditation standards and requirements. Supports learners (including but not limited to faculty, residents, clinical fellows, graduate or undergraduate learners, practicing or licensed professionals) in areas such as curriculum, teaching and learning activities, scheduling, core competencies, assessment and evaluations. Coordinates all activities associated with ongoing administration of health professions education programs.

Generic Scope

Experienced professional who knows how to apply theory and put it into practice with in-depth understanding of the professional field; independently performs the full range of responsibilities within the function; possesses broad job knowledge; analyzes problems / issues of diverse scope and determines solutions.

Custom Scope

Applies knowledge about curriculum, requirements and educational activities to coordinate professional health education programs. Coordinates and maintains program operations, which may include teaching and learning activities, program curriculum, learner scheduling, maintaining databases, tracking learner compliance, and program accreditation.

The position is responsible for coordinating a full range of administrative, oversight, and management aspects of division fellowship programs. The incumbent oversees and coordinates (both electronically and paper) record keeping and processing of all required documents for fellows and other postdoctoral trainees and scholars. Must have excellent organizational skills, analytical, and demonstrated attention to detail, in addition to proficiency in working with internal databases and systems, including specialized web based applications. Skills include entering, maintaining, extracting, and analyzing data in electronic systems. The ability to complete work and meet established deadlines in an accurate and timely manner, and to manage short and competing deadlines is essential. Demonstrated organizational skills, including the ability to maintain accurate files and records, and document processes is a position requirement.

The incumbent supports the fellowship recruitment process, including scheduling fellowship candidates for interviews with faculty. Incumbent must have strong interpersonal and problem solving skills, and is often the initial point of phone or email contact for prospective incoming fellowship candidates. Demonstrated experience and documented excellence in oral and written communications skills are essential, including a professional, pleasant, and resourceful attitude. As UCSF competes with other nationally ranked academic institutions in recruiting for its fellowship programs, these skills are a key requirement.

Provides administrative and other support to fellows, postdoctoral, and other trainees, including processing reimbursements and purchasing requests. Must have demonstrated experience and proficient computer skills using a full range of business applications within the Microsoft Office suite.

Incumbent will also be responsible for leading, coordinating, and serving as a subject matter expert in a department-wide activity related to the fellowship program. This position is responsible for being the subject matter expert on ACGME accreditation requirements and plays a key role in designing, implementing, and maintaining systems for ensuring the full and continued accreditation of the ACGME accredited residency and clinical fellowship programs. The incumbent will be a liaison and consultant to Pediatric programs with regard to interpretation and execution of accreditation requirements and processes and is responsible for analyzing and presenting complex program and institutional data for continuous quality improvement of pediatric programs.

The program manager oversees all aspects of Graduate Medical Education (GME) program administration, accreditation, and operations. This role ensures compliance with ACGME Common, Program-Specific, and Institutional Requirements while supporting the strategic growth and continuous improvement of residency and fellowship programs. Responsibilities include managing accreditation activities (CCC, PEC, APE, and GMEC), coordinating recruitment and onboarding processes, maintaining work hour and evaluation systems (MedHub, ADS, NRMP), and overseeing program finances, agreements, and policy implementation.

The program manager also leads data reporting and quality improvement initiatives, facilitates educational events, and provides faculty, trainee, and stakeholder support across multiple training sites. Demonstrating deep expertise in GME operations, this position contributes to scholarly and institutional efforts through research, committee participation, and collaboration to sustain program excellence and accreditation.

Department Overview

The Department of Pediatrics is one of the largest and most complex departments in the School of Medicine. The department is comprised of 20 fellowship programs, with over 200 fellows and residents.

Fellowship Program Coordination and Learner Support

Works with program managers and / or faculty to meet the educational needs of program learners through collaborative development and implementation of programmatic activities, which may include program competencies, curriculum, and exams.

  • Provides ongoing support to 30-35 fellows and 5-6 programs throughout their appointment.
  • Responsible for maintaining timely and accurate clinical rotation schedules in an online MedHub database.
  • Ensures that duty hour reporting is completed in an accurate and timely manner, which may require monthly contact with fellows to ensure that they have entered and reported their duty hours as required by the GME Office.
  • Work with faculty and fellows (~60-80) to ensure that required on-line evaluations are completed in a timely manner to meet compliance requirements.

Program Files, Data and Systems Management

  • Manages program files and data, which may include individual learner files as well as program accreditation documentation in accordance with relevant regulatory and University policies.
  • Creates reports to ensure accuracy and completeness of data.
  • Use all required fellowship systems to provide support to fellows and program directors (i.e. ERAS, MedHub, AMION, etc.).

Accreditation and Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensures administrative, financial and other program operations are compliant with accreditation standards, University policy, and other regulatory requirements.
  • Prepares reports and follows up as necessary.
  • Prepares all documents (online) and paper for ACGME accreditation site visits and The New Accreditation System (NAS).
  • During site visits, takes notes, provides all documents as needed and schedules rooms, refreshments and prep meetings prior to site visits.
  • Provides administrative support to Directors as needed after site visit.
  • Monitors learner files as well as program documentation and policy to ensure compliance with established and evolving standards.
  • Develops and maintains program processes for documentation to meet regulatory requirements.

Learner Advising, Wellness and Stakeholder Support

Serves as point person for learners, which may include prospective health professions education program candidates; current health professions education learners; and all other stakeholders.

  • Answers questions and disseminates program information.
  • Resolves ad hoc issues relative to program learners.
  • Advises learners on planning, initiation, and completion of their studies.
  • Communicates clinical learning opportunities and curriculum requirements and effectively communicates information about learners' program choices.
  • As program manager will provide training, teaching and guidance to all trainees on wellbeing initiatives and will be responsible for orienting new staff and providing the required trainings for wellness projects.
  • Will serve as the wellness advisor and work with all 20 fellowship programs in pediatrics to develop best practices for wellbeing.

Educational Events and Program Activities

  • Plans, executes the logistics, and monitors budgets for program social events and / or educational activities, which may include recruitment; orientation; graduation; conferences; and simulation and / or other assessment activities.
  • May lead workshops and / or information sessions for learners, faculty, and staff.

Program and Curriculum Evaluation

  • Collaborates with program faculty and leadership to develop program and curricular evaluation documentation; including evaluation tools and strategies / timelines.
  • Implements program evaluation strategies and ensures compliance with deadlines.
  • Analyzes program performance, curriculum effectiveness, and impact of rotation experience and other educational activities.
  • Provides summary reports of evaluations to program leadership.

Budget and Financial Management

  • Participates in budget development and tracks expenses for the program and / or relevant health professions educational activities.
  • Generates reports and recommends methods to reduce costs.
  • Collaborates with program management on financial issues within the program.

Required Qualifications

  • Thorough knowledge of relevant policies and regulatory requirements. Solid knowledge of health professions education program requirements. Thorough knowledge of health professions education industry.
  • Thorough knowledge of administrative analysis and operations research. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement processes and systems. Thorough knowledge of the administrative and operational implications in a program.
  • Demonstrated experience and documented excellence in oral and written communications skills; includes active listening and critical thinking.
  • Strong interpersonal skills. Actively cooperates and supports the work of others. Ability to work productively with anyone regardless of background. Empathetic and aware of impact on others. Strong problem solving skills to assist learners and resolve issues.
  • Excellent organizational skills, analytical, and demonstrated attention to detail. Ability to complete work and meet established deadlines in an accurate and timely manner, and to manage short and competing deadlines.
  • Thorough knowledge of educational software and platforms. Demonstrated ability to analyze and seek solutions to enhance the user experience.
  • Thorough knowledge of data management, documentation methods used in investigating and presenting findings about the program. Skills include statistical analysis of data across databases and systems.
  • Experience in ACGME Common, Program-Specific, and Institutional Requirements.
  • Knowledge of Clinical Competency Committee, Program Evaluation Committee, Annual Program Evaluation process, policies, and continuous quality improvement processes.
  • Experience with ACGME Accreditation Data System data entry, reporting, and site visit preparation.
  • Collaboration with GMEC and institutional stakeholders to maintain accreditation standards.
  • Experience in scholarly work, research, and academic program initiatives within GME.
  • Data management, reporting, and metrics tracking using GME systems: MedHub, ADS, and NRMP systems.
  • Demonstrated expertise in GME, ACGME and ABP requirements.
  • Minimum 3 years of related experience.
  • Must report on site at Mission Hall five days a week.

Required Education

Preferred Education

Our platform gives hardware engineering teams a single place to ingest data, analyze performance, automate test execution, and collaborate across every phase of development, so they can move faster without sacrificing safety or precision. Our team draws from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence.


The role
We’re looking for designers graduating in 2027 or sooner with solid visual and product design fundamentals to join Nominal full time.

You’ll own design work for defined features and product improvements, with support from experienced designers and close collaboration with engineering and product. You’ll help bring new capabilities to life, learn directly from customers, and grow your judgment as a product designer. Your work will support engineers testing and validating complex hardware systems, including nuclear reactors, rockets, and supersonic aircraft.

🚀 What you’ll do

  • Turn complexity into clarity. Dive into high-frequency, high-volume hardware and data workflows and translate them into intuitive product experiences.
  • Design alongside real users. Partner with engineers and customers to understand their workflows, identify pain points, and test potential solutions.
  • Partner with design, engineering, and product to research, prototype with AI, and contribute directly to product improvements and features.
  • Own the design of defined features from initial exploration through implementation, working with your team to clarify scope and make tradeoffs.
  • Collaborate with engineers throughout development to refine interactions and deliver thoughtful, usable experiences.
  • Evolve our design system. Contribute reusable patterns and components that improve consistency and usability across the platform.
  • Help shape our design culture by sharing work early, giving constructive feedback, and using customer insights to inform product decisions.

🎯 Reach out if…

  • You’re graduating in 2027 (or sooner) and seeking a full-time product design role as a new graduate or early-career designer.
  • You have a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual design fundamentals and product thinking through academic work, personal projects, internships, or professional experience.
  • You can translate a user problem into clear flows, detailed interface designs, and prototypes.

🌟 Bonus, not required

  • You’ve collaborated with engineers to bring a design into a working product.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

We offer you the opportunity to join a team of professionals who work together to achieve the best results for our customers. You will collaborate with people who combine technical excellence, innovation, and a passion for solving complex engineering challenges.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, provision, and manage resilient cloud environments in Microsoft Azure, leveraging automation to ensure the highest standards of security, performance, scalability, and availability.
  • Lead the implementation and evolution of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using Bicep, developing reusable, modular, and maintainable infrastructure solutions for Garmin cloud platforms.
  • Design and maintain cloud platform services, ensuring consistency, governance, compliance, and operational excellence across Azure environments.
  • Architect and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines that enable engineering teams to deploy infrastructure and software with confidence, consistency, and minimal manual intervention.
  • Design, operate, and optimize containerized applications and Kubernetes-based workloads, supporting cloud-native architectures and services.
  • Drive the adoption of engineering best practices for automation, observability, monitoring, alerting, and operational reliability.
  • Lead and contribute to architectural reviews, providing recommendations for cloud adoption, infrastructure modernization, scalability, performance optimization, and cost efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure and platform issues through deep root cause analysis, ensuring long-term platform stability and resilience.
  • Partner with Developers, QA Engineers, Architects, and Product teams to deliver scalable technical solutions that support business objectives.
  • Mentor engineers and promote a culture of continuous improvement, automation, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in technical discipline plus at least 5 years of experience in DevOps or related infrastructure-focused roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with the Microsoft Azure Cloud Platform, including networking, identity management, governance, security, monitoring, and scalability best practices.
  • Strong experience developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Bicep.
  • Proven experience designing, deploying, and operating production-grade Azure environments at scale.
  • Experience building and maintaining enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Proficiency with scripting and automation languages such as PowerShell, Python, and Bash.
  • Strong understanding of Git-based development workflows and DevOps practices.
  • Thorough understanding of networking, security, Linux, and Windows operating systems.
  • Ability to drive technical decisions and influence cloud architecture, automation strategy, and operational best practices.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership within cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Team-oriented attitude, excellent collaboration skills, and a passion for continuous improvement.
  • Fluent in English.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO)
  • Experience designing and operating large-scale Kubernetes platforms.
  • Knowledge of AWS cloud services and experience with CloudFormation.
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL database technologies.
  • Experience in leading technical teams.
  • Familiarity with marine technologies, navigation systems, and connected devices.
  • A true "geek" mindset: if you believe that any task performed more than twice deserves automation, you'll fit right in.

Pay Range: €40.000 – €56.000

In accordance with the Directive (EU) 2023/970 on Pay Transparency, our organization is committed to ensuring equal pay for men and women for equal work or work of equal value.

Collective Bargaining Agreement applied: Collective Bargaining Agreement Metalworking Industry (CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria)

Contract Level: B2

Our home: you can find us in via Fondacci 269 in Massarosa (LU), Italy.

Workplace type: on-site

Company:

Garmin® Italy Technologies produces electronic charts for the leisure boating market. Our mission is to delight our customer by producing market leading intuitive and innovative marine cartography content and features through the use of creativity, engineering excellence through market knowledge and efficient production procedures. Our cartography is available to boaters for use in GPS chartplotters, and within our app for Apple® and Android™ devices.

It’s not about the things we make. It’s about the things we make possible.

title: Projektleder med digital forståelse til Dagblaget Børsen
description:
Projektleder med digital forståelse til Dagbladet Børsen

13 måneders barselsvikariat

Vil du drive strategiske og digitale projekter hos Børsen?

Vi søger en struktureret og engageret projektleder, der kan omsætte idéer og forretningsbehov til konkrete løsninger og sikre, at beslutninger bliver fulgt til dørs.

Du bliver en del af Brand Lead-teamet, som driver strategiske projekter på tværs af Børsen. Vi er en central enhed på fire, som arbejder for at gøre kundens oplevelse med Børsen bedst mulig på alle vores platforme.
Vi arbejder datadrevet og alle projekter laver vi i tæt samarbejde med redaktionen, kommercielle stakeholders og Digital Udvikling.
Vores projekter skal give mening på tværs af forretningen og kan være alt fra lyd- og video-initiativer til arbejde med nyhedsbreve og dashboards. Vi hjælper hinanden i teamet, deler vores viden og lægger vægt på, at det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • En alsidig rolle med ansvar og mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på projekterne.
  • Tæt samarbejde med teamet og dygtige kolleger på tværs af organisationen.
  • En varieret hverdag med både strategiske og operationelle opgaver.
  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for projektledelse og digital udvikling.
  • Et 13 måneders barselsvikariat med forventet opstart 1. december.
  • Pension og sundhedssikring.
  • Kantineordning.

Dine vigtigste opgaver:

  • Planlægge og drive projekter fra opstart til implementering
  • Skabe overblik over deadlines, leverancer, ressourcer og risici
  • Følge op på beslutninger og sikre, at de bliver omsat til handling
  • Kvalificere forretningsbehov og udarbejde beslutningsgrundlag og produktbeskrivelser
  • Koordinere input og materiale fra organisationen til Digital Udvikling
  • Samarbejde tæt med udviklere og deltage i relevante stand-ups
  • Facilitere projektmøder og workshops
  • Kommunikere projektstatus, resultater og udfordringer til interessenter og direktion
  • Sikre, at nye løsninger bliver forankret i organisationen.

Hvem er du?

Du har erfaring med projektledelse, gerne fra digitale projekter, og er vant til at samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder og interesser. Du arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar og følger vedholdende op.

Du behøver ikke være teknisk specialist, men du skal have digital og teknisk forståelse og være nysgerrig på, hvordan systemer og digitale løsninger bliver udviklet.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • Kan omsætte forretningsbehov til konkrete projekt- og produktbeskrivelser
  • Skaber struktur, fremdrift og fælles retning
  • Trives i samarbejdet med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske kolleger
  • Kommunikerer komplekse problemstillinger klart og enkelt
  • Er selvstændig, løsningsorienteret og god til at få mennesker med

title: Tacoma - American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor/ Instructor Trainer
description:
About Us

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

Note: The Instructor Trainer's teaching methods and content must comply with American Red Cross requirements.

License / Certification

  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Certification, r.25 — Required if you are looking for an instructor role
  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Trainer Certification, r.25 — Required﻿ ﻿if you are looking for an instructor trainer role
  • American Red Cross BLS Instructor Trainer Certification — Preferred
  • American Heart Association BLS Instructor Certification — Preferred
  • Other equivalent Instructor Trainer certifications may be considered where an approved bridging pathway is available; we can provide bridging guidance.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.
  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.
  • Monitor and evaluate candidate progress to ensure proficiency.
  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with CPR and AED training best practices.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

  • Current American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor certification.
  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to demonstrate proper CPR and AED techniques.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.
  • Work may be performed primarily during weekends.

Salary and Benefits

Salary: $30.00 - $40.00 per teaching hour, commensurate with experience and length of working relationship with ALLCPR.

Additional Compensation: $10.00 per enrolled student. (Only for instructor trainer role)

Job Classification: 1099 Contractor or Part-Time Employee (Certain States).

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule.

Schedule

  • Day shift.
  • Weekend/Weekday availability.

Ability to Commute / Relocate

Location: Local area as per job post

Reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (Required).

Experience

  • Teaching: 2+ years (Preferred).

Job Type

  • Part-time
  • Contract

Work Location: In person

title: Assistant Superintendent - WA
description:
Summary
Under the guidance of the Project Superintendent and in partnership with the Project Manager, assists with the management of field operations for the delivery of a project through final completion and closeout. The Assistant Superintendent is responsible for supporting direction in the field, in alignment with Abbott’s core values, in terms that are clearly established on a job-by-job basis.

Duties

  • Champions “The Abbott Way” by delivering predictable outcomes for internal teams, external teams, and customers.

  • Review Prime Contract & Subcontract plans and specifications to have a comprehensive knowledge of job requirements.

  • Assist with development of project plan, including schedule, access, resources, building requirements, etc.

  • Procure tools, labor and some materials.

  • Interact with trade partners, architects and owners to resolve issues as they occur.

  • Construction issues and progress to supervisory personnel engaged in coordinating various phases of construction

  • Craft personnel to update and gather input

  • Subcontractors prior to mobilization to review scope of work and schedule, and prior to each phase of work for schedule and phasing requirements

  • Clients to update them on project’s progress

  • Superintendent for input, guidance and direction

  • Inspect work in progress to ensure that work conforms to specifications and construction schedules and be a champion of Abbott’s Quality360 program.

  • Actively manage the subcontractor team onsite as a primary point of contact.

  • Drive the project schedule in collaboration with the subcontractor team.

  • Manage the project based on progress reports, materials used, costs and adjust work schedules accordingly.

  • Work with Project Manager to prepare the Project Management Plan, and to review and submit RFI’s and submittal information.

  • May track and price extra work tickets, change requests and back charges to cover extra expenses.

  • Understand and enforce all safety policies, practices and procedures. Is empowered as first line supervision to interrupt and engage in any observed unsafe acts. Report unsafe activities to supervisor and/or Safety Manager.
  • Be proficient with CMiC and knowledgeable on the PSMP (Project Safety Management Plan) and associated planning standards and record data input.
  • Demonstrate integrity; maintain professional standards of conduct and ethics; and follow company policies and procedures.
  • Participate actively in team environment and contributes to successful completion of team goals.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in related construction sector.

  • A demonstrated knowledge of construction processes.

  • Knowledge of building codes and blueprints.

  • Knowledge of subcontractors’ scopes of work and quality requirements.

  • Good written and oral communication skills.

  • Has strong problem-solving skills, showing the ability to deal with a variety of variables given general construction, moderate structure and direction, and interprets a variety of complex instructions.

  • The ability to process information quickly and follow through with a course of action.

  • Has experience using project management software and ability to learn new technological programs.

  • Two to three year’s prior field experience in commercial construction preferred.

The full salary range for this position is $85,000 to $115,000. This position is eligible for a target bonus.

Benefits: Abbott Construction offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, Life & AD&D Insurance, Long-term Disability Insurance, Short-term Disability Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance, Family Support, Pre-tax Paid Parking/Public Transportation, Paid time off, Time Away Benefits, Paid Holidays, Group Legal, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Identity Theft Protection, Group Legal, Pet Insurance, Employee Assistance Program.

title: Concrete and Drainage Supervisor
description:
Live and work in a culture rich location minutes from the Murray River, just a short drive to one of Victoria’s best wine regions and with the ski fields so close you will be zooming down the mountains in under two hours.

Our employee benefits include professional development and flexible working conditions. Our conditions of employment support equal opportunities and an ethical, diverse, and inclusive workplace.

AlburyCity is committed to being a child safe organisation by creating cultures, adopting strategies and taking action to empower children. We work hard to keep them safe from harm because child safety is everyone’s responsibility.

DIRECTORATE:
Infrastructure, Planning & Environment

CLASSIFICATION:
Grade H

SALARY:
A base salary of $101,528 with competency-based increments up to $117,773 pa + 12% employer contribution to superannuation

REPORTING TO:
Team Leader City Works

EMPLOYMENT TYPE:
Permanent Full Time

THE POSITION:
Provide leadership, supervision, and coordination of Concrete and Drainage crews to ensure the safe, efficient, and cost-effective delivery of construction and maintenance programs, meeting required quality standards, project timeframes, and budget objectives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Supervise City Works Crews as required. These crews undertake civil construction and maintenance works, including but not limited to concreting and drainage works.
  • Supervise and lead an effective and efficient team capable of delivering services to agreed levels and standards.
  • Provide effective staff management, including timesheets and rostering, recruitment, performance management and employee development, employee motivation and foster team harmony.

External

The use of relevant work method statements and appropriate WHS standards are an integral part of the role. A full functional and medical assessment is required for this position.

title: Medication Aide (Part-time Evenings) – Sloan Estates Assisted Living

title: Principal Business Insights Analyst
description:
The Principal Business Insights Analyst is a highly analytical and influential business partner responsible for turning complex performance data into clear insights and actionable recommendations that improve sales performance, productivity, and execution across the retail branch network. Reporting to the Principal Business Insights Director, this role works closely with Sales Leadership, Product teams, Field Execution leaders, and enterprise data and analytics partners to identify opportunities, diagnose performance gaps, and help leaders make informed business decisions.

This individual will connect data to business outcomes, moving beyond reporting what happened to helping the organization understand why it happened, where opportunities exist, and what actions can improve performance. Through analysis of branch, regional, and national performance, the Principal Business Insights Analyst will provide recommendations that strengthen sales effectiveness, lead conversion, product penetration, and colleague productivity.

The role requires strong analytical capability, business acumen, and the ability to translate complex information into clear, compelling insights for both senior leaders and frontline business partners. The analyst will also help establish meaningful performance measures, evaluate the effectiveness of business initiatives, and continuously improve how insights are used to drive decisions and execution.

Primary responsibilities include

Performance Insights and Opportunity Identification

  • Analyze branch, regional, and national performance across key sales, conversion, productivity, and related business metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and performance gaps.
  • Diagnose underlying drivers and root causes behind performance results and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve sales effectiveness, including sales per lead, conversion rates, product penetration, and colleague productivity.
  • Proactively surface emerging trends and performance opportunities to help leaders focus resources and actions where they can have the greatest business impact.

Sales and Initiative Effectiveness

  • Evaluate the effectiveness of sales initiatives, campaigns, and lead-management strategies and identify opportunities to strengthen performance.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators for priority initiatives, assessing results and recommending adjustments or optimizations based on performance.
  • Connect business results with underlying activities and execution to help leaders understand what is driving performance and where changes may be needed.

Executive Insights and Decision Support

  • Develop executive-level reporting, presentations, and data stories that translate complex analysis into clear business implications and recommended actions.
  • Communicate insights in a concise and compelling manner that enables both technical and non-technical audiences to understand the business opportunity and determine appropriate action.
  • Serve as a trusted analytical partner to business leaders, bringing an informed, data-driven perspective to strategic and frontline decisions.

Reporting, Dashboards and Data Integrity

  • Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reporting tools that support timely decision-making by field and senior leadership.
  • Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data used in reporting, analysis, and performance measurement.
  • Partner with enterprise data and analytics teams to strengthen reporting capabilities, improve data quality, and evolve the tools and insights available to business leaders.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Product teams, Field Execution leaders, and enterprise data and analytics partners to align analytical work with key business priorities.
  • Translate business questions and emerging performance challenges into meaningful analysis that supports decision-making and execution.
  • Influence decisions through fact-based recommendations while building strong relationships across a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Qualifications, Education, Certifications and/or Other Professional Credentials

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience analyzing complex business and performance data and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect data, performance trends, and business activity to measurable outcomes.
  • Experience analyzing sales, conversion, productivity, customer, or related performance metrics in a business environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify trends, performance gaps, and root causes and communicate the business implications of those findings.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reporting, executive presentations, or other analytical tools that support business decision-making.
  • Strong communication and data-storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear insights for non-technical and senior audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively across business, sales, product, field, and data or analytics teams.
  • Strong attention to data quality, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and proactively identify opportunities where analytics can improve business performance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Retail Banking, Consumer Financial Services, branch distribution, sales performance, or another large-scale customer-facing business.
  • Experience evaluating sales initiatives, campaigns, lead-management strategies, or other programs tied to measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience establishing KPIs and measuring the effectiveness of strategic or operational initiatives.
  • Experience developing insights for a geographically distributed frontline organization.
  • Advanced experience with business intelligence, visualization, reporting, or analytical tools.

Hours & Work Schedule

  • Hours per Week: 40
  • Work Schedule: 8 AM – 5 PM

Pay Transparency

  • The salary range for this position is $139,000 - $182,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.

  • We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. title: Build Reliability Engineer
description:
Why Castelion, Why Now

Castelion is moving incredibly fast to develop and deliver advanced defense systems at a time when execution matters more than ever. We believe focus, ownership, and excellence are decisive advantages - and we're building a world-class team to turn bold ideas into real capability.

This is a rare opportunity to join at an early stage, where you'll have significant ownership, collaborate with exceptional teammates, and make a direct, measurable impact on our mission and the future of the company - regardless of your function.

About Castelion

Castelion is bringing a new approach to defense development and production: one that focuses on short, iterative design cycles, rapid testing in development, and modern commercial manufacturing strategies for production at scale. We design, build, and test next generation weapon systems to give America and its Allies a definitive edge in defense capabilities.

Build Reliability Engineer

The Build Reliability Engineer will lead initiatives aimed at continuous improvement in the reliability and quality of our products. You will develop and implement internal processes and manufacturing software to optimize development and production workflows and ensure high-quality output. You will guide teams in conducting reliability assessments, implementing preventative measures, and addressing quality issues through root cause analyses and corrective actions, all while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities

Design and Manufacturing

  • Work closely with design, manufacturing, and operations teams to ensure reliability and quality considerations are integrated into all phases of the product lifecycle.
  • Participate in Design and Build Reviews to ensure design for manufacturability and inspectability.
  • Reviews and approves Process Plans, specifications, and build documentation for completeness, accuracy, regulatory compliance, and quality objectives.
  • Support the development and implementation of internal processes and manufacturing software to optimize production efficiency, product quality, and change control.
  • Facilitate the engineering change control process (ECR/ECO) with a focus on traceability and impact alignment to maintain clean configuration genealogy.

Inspection and Test Process

  • Ensure appropriate test validation methods and inspection techniques have been considered to validate design and manufacturing processes.
  • Develop and implement Quality Control Processes, and Standards, and Planning, ensuring compliance with internal and external standards and regulations.
  • Design or procures new measurement equipment as required to achieve required inspections with maximum efficiency.
  • Validates measurement and tests methods using process capability and measurement systems analysis (MSA) statistical tools. Propose solutions to remove the need to verify product conformance through measurement, e.g. poka-yoke.

Evaluates and analyzes production quality landscape

  • Utilize reliability and quality data to generate reports, identify trends, and recommend improvements to enhance product and process reliability and performance.
  • Uses data to make landscape transparent and drive project prioritization. Responsible for ensuring that issues related to product reliability are primary focus.
  • Drives achievement of quality targets through a review hierarchy with appropriate levels of management.

title: IT Staff Auditor II
description:

Sunflower Bank, N.A. is looking for an energetic, highly motivated individual to fill the position of full-time IT Staff Auditor II at our Gilbert, AZ Location.


Summary

The IT Staff Auditor II is an individual contributor within the Internal Audit function, reporting directly to an Internal Audit Manager. This role supports the successful execution of the Internal Audit Plan by performing risk-based testing of IT and integrated controls to assess the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes.


The IT Staff Auditor II is responsible for executing audit test procedures across assigned engagements, including documenting work performed, evaluating control design and operating effectiveness, and identifying control gaps or inefficiencies. The position requires the ability to assess IT risks—such as access management, change management, operations, and data integrity—and to clearly communicate results and observations to audit management. The IT Staff Auditor II applies internal audit standards, departmental methodologies, and regulatory expectations in executing their responsibilities, while maintaining professional skepticism and audit quality.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Execute assigned IT and integrated audit procedures in accordance with the approved audit program, including testing of control design and operating effectiveness.
  • Perform risk-based testing over key IT processes, such as access management, change management, IT operations, and data integrity, to evaluate control effectiveness and identify potential control gaps.
  • Prepare and maintain audit workpapers that clearly document procedures performed, supporting evidence, testing results, and conclusions in accordance with Internal Audit standards and workpaper requirements.
  • Participate in walkthroughs and process discussions with business and IT stakeholders to develop an understanding of systems, processes, and key controls.
  • Identify control deficiencies, process weaknesses, or inefficiencies, and assist in developing well-supported audit observations, including root causes and potential risk impacts.
  • Communicate audit progress, findings, and potential issues to Internal Audit management in a timely and clear manner.
  • Assist in the preparation of audit deliverables, including summaries of testing results, issue documentation, and supporting analysis for audit reports.
  • Perform follow-up and validation procedures on management action plans to confirm remediation efforts have been effectively implemented.
  • Maintain an understanding of applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal policies relevant to IT risk and controls.
  • Adhere to Internal Audit policies, procedures, and professional standards, maintaining independence, objectivity, and quality in all assignments.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple assignments effectively, providing regular status updates and meeting established timelines.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives within the Internal Audit function, including adoption of tools, methodologies, and data analytics techniques where applicable.
  • Perform the job in accordance with applicable industry laws and regulations as well as the policies and procedures established by the company.
  • Responsible for upholding Fair and Responsible Banking practices and Code of Ethics and Conduct guidelines.
  • Understand and participate in the Bank’s Community Reinvestment Act program.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field and a minimum of five (5) years of previous IT internal audit experience within the financial services industry.
  • Audit certification such as CISA, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, CDPSE, etc. is preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, and common sense
  • Strong written and oral Communication skills
  • Excellent Interpersonal skills
  • Strong project management skills
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Strong Customer Focus Skills
  • Must be able to work flexible hours
  • Ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality and objectivity
  • Ability to travel to other locations regularly
  • Must be bondable.

Pay is dependent on knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, and location.


Working Conditions

Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time.


Sunflower Bank Benefits


People choose to “bank” with us, but for those we serve, we’re more than a bank. We strive to be the financial backbone of their lives, and we know that starts with our team.


Our supportive culture empowers team members to grow and seize new opportunities. Like our namesake, the sunflower, we are:

title: 3D Character Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Character Artist at Riot, you will bring champions to life by creating and texturing high and low poly models. You will help craft some of the most iconic characters in the world of gaming. Your sculpting skills, artistic eye and keen understanding of anatomy, form, and color will lead the way in character creation. Working within both technical and design constraints, you will use your knowledge of proportions, anatomy and readability to ensure models are optimized in game. Your craft expertise, high-level execution and attention to detail will enrich the player’s immersive experience.

As a 3D Character Artist on the Unpublished R&D Product, you will translate character concepts into game-ready assets that meet technical and design requirements. You will contribute throughout the character production process, from concept to final implementation, and collaborate with multiple disciplines and external partners to deliver consistently high-quality character assets. You will create appealing, distinctive, and readable characters that help deliver a high-quality player experience. You will report into the Art Director of the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Use your knowledge of stylized character art to create high-quality 3D character models.
  • Interpret and execute character concepts while considering technical and design constraints such as polygon counts, texture memory, and topology.
  • Understand the complete asset creation process, from concept design, modeling, baking, and texturing through successful integration into the game.
  • Review and provide guidance on character content created by external partners, helping maintain stylistic consistency, quality standards, and project budgets.
  • Collaborate with other teams and disciplines to plan and drive the production and delivery of character assets.
  • Help mature character asset pipelines and establish best practices for high-quality and efficient asset creation.
  • Maintain a strong focus on in-game performance, readability, and long-term maintainability while meeting the visual quality bar.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional character modeling experience.
  • Experience with stylized rendering or cel-shaded rendering.
  • Experience shipping game content.
  • Professional experience with modeling, sculpting, baking, and texturing tools such as Maya, ZBrush, Substance, and Photoshop.
  • Strong understanding of stylized shape language, with the ability to represent a wide range of character looks through an economy of form and detail.
  • Understanding of technical constraints, performance requirements, and in-game integration workflows for character assets.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Design, Technical Art, Engineering, and external partners.
  • Strong ownership and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move work forward consistently within clear goals and complex constraints.
  • Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience working closely with Technical Art.
  • Experience using Unreal Engine.
  • A broad 3D skill set including polygon modeling, sculpting, basic rigging and animation, painting, and presentation.
  • Experience on games or projects centered on character experiences.
  • Experience managing external partners, reviewing character assets, or collaborating on outsourcing workflows.
  • Familiarity with character asset optimization, material creation, or real-time rendering workflows.
  • Proficiency in English.

Application Materials

Please provide a portfolio highlighting high-quality 3D character work, stylized characters, character modeling, sculpting, texturing, and final in-game results. Whenever possible, please clarify your responsibilities, tools, technical constraints, and individual contributions to each project.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

title: Senior Automotive System Architect
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

AMD is looking for a Senior Automotive System Architect to help shape our automotive technology strategy and drive customer engagement across North America. This is a high-visibility, customer-facing role at the intersection of cutting-edge semiconductor technology and the rapidly evolving automotive industry. You will work closely with the Automotive Business Segment Senior Director and collaborate across sales, automotive marketing, and global engineering teams to support the long-term growth of AMD's automotive business in North America and across the globe.

You will apply AMD's world-class CPU, GPU, AI, and programmable logic technologies to next-generation automotive platforms, with a primary focus on:

  • Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and Automated Driving
  • Infotainment and Digital Cockpit Systems
  • Driver Information and Instrument Cluster Applications

This role uniquely combines system architecture, market insight, solution development, ecosystem engagement, and technical influence — making it ideal for someone who thrives at the convergence of deep technical expertise and strategic business impact.

THE PERSON:

We are looking for a strategic yet hands-on system architect with deep roots in the automotive semiconductor or embedded systems industry. You bring the technical depth to navigate complex CPU, GPU, AI, and programmable logic architectures, and the business acumen to translate that expertise into compelling solutions that resonate with automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and ecosystem partners. Equally comfortable in a customer briefing room and an engineering design review, you build trusted relationships at all levels, communicate with clarity across technical and business audiences, and thrive in a fast-moving environment where ambiguity is the norm and impact is the expectation. You are a natural collaborator who works seamlessly across regional and global teams, and a self-starter who can turn market insights and customer requirements into practical architecture proposals and demonstrable platforms that win business.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop targeted automotive system solutions for the North America market using AMD CPU, GPU, AI, and programmable logic technologies.
  • Lead system-level architecture analysis and develop customer- and project-specific technical proposals for ADAS and automated driving, infotainment, and driver information applications.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate local market, customer, technology, and competitive trends to relevant AMD stakeholders.
  • Create, maintain, and enhance vehicle-based demonstration platforms that showcase AMD automotive capabilities and customer value.
  • Engage with key automotive customers to understand system requirements, influence architecture decisions, and identify new business opportunities.
  • Build productive relationships with strategic automotive ecosystem partners and support joint solution development and enablement activities.
  • Partner closely with AMD sales, automotive marketing, and engineering teams to define differentiated value propositions and support customer engagements.
  • Develop trusted relationships that encourage transparency, strengthen technical collaboration, and support the long-term growth of AMD's automotive business.

title: HR Assistant
description:
Human Resources Assistant

If you are passionate about Human Resources operations and you would like to give your contribution in creating a great company culture, this is the right position for you. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment where each team member is valued and given the opportunity to grow.


The Allentown Parking Authority is a non-profit municipal Authority incorporated under the laws of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. It was established through legislation passed by the Allentown City Council. The Authority is governed by a five-member Board of Directors appointed by the Mayor of Allentown. The Allentown Parking Authority manages, supervises, and administers an efficient system of both on-street metered parking and off-street parking within the City of Allentown. The on-street program consists of 1500 metered spaces. The off-street parking program consists of six garages and 22 surface lots. Our mission is to operate, monitor, and maintain convenient and accessible parking facilities and on-street parking opportunities within the City of Allentown. The Allentown Parking Authority works to balance the parking needs of residents, employees, business and property owners, and visitors while enforcing parking ordinances and providing appropriate access to parking.


We are seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Human Resources Assistant specializing in recruitment to join our HR team. The ideal candidate will oversee the full recruitment lifecycle, coordinate hiring activities, and support efforts to attract and onboard qualified candidates. This role will also assist with various HR functions, including employee relations, performance management, and compliance.


The Human Resources Assistant will report to the Human Resources Manager.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Policy Implementation:

  • HR Information Systems:

You will communicate with applicants throughout the recruitment process regarding application status, interviews, required documentation, background screenings, pre-employment requirements, and onboarding.

    • Escort employees for random drug testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.
    • Organize, compile, update company personnel records and documentation.
    • Preserve employee confidence and protect operations by keeping human resource information confidential. You will maintain strict confidentiality of applicant and employee information, including personnel, medical, background screening, and other sensitive HR records.
    • Order and maintain office supplies, including materials for meetings, events, and trainings; ensure the supplies are organized and adequately stocked.

title: Bakersfield - American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor/ Trainer
description:
About Us

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

Note: The Instructor Trainer's teaching methods and content must comply with American Red Cross requirements.

License / Certification

  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Certification, r.25 — Required if you are looking for an instructor role
  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Trainer Certification, r.25 — Required﻿ ﻿if you are looking for an instructor trainer role
  • American Red Cross BLS Instructor Trainer Certification — Preferred
  • American Heart Association BLS Instructor Certification — Preferred
  • Other equivalent Instructor Trainer certifications may be considered where an approved bridging pathway is available; we can provide bridging guidance.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.
  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.
  • Monitor and evaluate candidate progress to ensure proficiency.
  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with CPR and AED training best practices.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

  • Current American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor certification.
  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to demonstrate proper CPR and AED techniques.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.
  • Work may be performed primarily during weekends.

Salary and Benefits

Salary: $30.00 - $40.00 per teaching hour, commensurate with experience and length of working relationship with ALLCPR.

Additional Compensation: $10.00 per enrolled student. (Only for instructor trainer role)

Job Classification: 1099 Contractor or Part-Time Employee (Certain States).

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule.

Schedule

  • Day shift.
  • Weekend/Weekday availability.

Ability to Commute / Relocate

Location: Local area as per job post

Reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (Required).

Experience

  • Teaching: 2+ years (Preferred).

Job Type

  • Part-time
  • Contract

Work Location: In person

title: EMT Basic - Clarksville
description:
Team Mobile Health Care


EMTs respond to medical and traumatic emergencies and provide basic life support procedures and transportation to the most appropriate facility. They also provide basic life support services to interfacility transfer patients as required. EMTs carry themselves professionally and assist other company departments where needed.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Responds to select medical and traumatic emergencies along with responding to select hospitals, clinics, and nursing homes to provide inter-facility transfers.
  • Provides emergency medical care at the scene, en route to the hospital, and during transportation from facility to facility. Provides emergency medical care as appropriate to the practice of the registered emergency medical technician. Delivers the patient to the nearest most appropriate medical facility. Adheres to Company, local, regional, and state guidelines regarding patient care.
  • Performs basic (or intermediate) life support procedures based on certification level.
  • Performs other duties related to emergency and non-emergency medical care and development of the emergency medical system and/or Patriot Ambulance.

Specific and Additional Tasks / Duties:

  • At all times, presents an example of professionalism and leadership for others to follow. Places patient care excellence above all else.
  • Demonstrates and ensures knowledge, understanding, and compliance with TMHC Team Mobile Health Care's procedures.
  • Demonstrates continuous effort to improve operations, decrease turnaround times, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly to provide quality customer care.
  • Ensures that the vehicle and equipment are ready for use at the beginning of the shift and after every call.
  • Responds to emergencies and non-emergencies using appropriate care and caution in accordance with Tennessee law, EMS regulations, company policy, and the principles of safe emergency vehicle operation. As per TMHC policy, always wear their seatbelt when in a Company vehicle.
  • Adheres to Universal Precautions/Body Substance Isolation when dealing with patient contacts. Is familiar with and practices infection control policies and procedures for TMHC.
  • When necessary and appropriate, the emergency medical care team leader directs and supervises other members of the team in dealing with emergency and non-emergency situations.
  • Renders emergency and non-emergency medical care in accordance with the rules, regulations, protocols, policies, and procedures of TMHC, the State of Tennessee, DPH/OEMS, and the Regional Office of OEMS, consistent with good judgment and the provision of high-quality medical care. Appropriately and safely deliver the patient to the nearest, most appropriate medical facility.
  • Works professionally with ALS personnel and at their skill level in accordance with the Tennessee DPH/OEMS and company policies. Maintains good relations with all outside staff and services.
  • Acts at all times in the best interests of high-quality patient care, in the best interests of the patient, and in such a manner to reflect credibly on TMHC and the professional reputation of the emergency medical technician.
  • Acts at all times with personal safety in mind as well as the safety of others.
  • Provides high-quality patient care while transporting patients to the receiving facility. Once at the destinations, provides the receiving staff with a comprehensive report regarding the patients’ status.
  • Completes all appropriate documentation, Patient care Records, and any other record-keeping for every patient contact.
  • Performs duties related to public relations and community education programs sponsored by TMHC.
  • Attends appropriate continuing education courses as required. Ensures continuity with all required certifications such as CPR, EMT Card, etc. Files the appropriate paperwork with DPH/OEMS to ensure timely recertification.
  • Provides TMHC a current copy of their EMT certification, CPR card, and Motor Vehicle Driver’s License. Completes training in all Company, state, and federal mandates.
  • Reports to assigned shifts in proper uniform and on time. Remains on duty and in proper uniform until properly relieved.
  • Accommodates and trains third riders for orientation and/or educational purposes. Completes all documentation on behalf of student interns.
  • Consult with supervisor on non-routine matters.
  • Completes various day-to-day assignments (i.e. cleaning, laundry, trash removal, etc.)
  • Completes any other tasks or duties as assigned.

Location, Reporting Structure and Hours:

  • The EMT position can have full time, part time or per diem hours.
  • The position is in the surrounding Manchester, TN area.
  • The position works under the general direction of the daily supervisor.
  • Competitive Nights/Weekend pay

title: Room Inspector
description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

Join our team! Windsor Hospitality thrives in building hospitality careers. We want to design a path of professional growth and give you the keys to that success. We are recognized as a strong partner with warm-hearted hospitality staff nationwide. Windsor Hospitality is looking for their newest Room Inspector!

This position is located at the Embassy Suites by Hilton Convention Center in Las Vegas, NV. We are right in the middle of the action! Our hotel is perfectly situated next to the Las Vegas Convention Center and just three miles from Harry Reid International Airport. With the monorail just steps away and world-class entertainment, dining, and shopping minutes from our door, you will be working in the heart of all that Las Vegas has to offer.


WHAT WE OFFER

Join a team that invests in you! We're proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package to support the well-being and growth of all our eligible employees:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life & Disability Insurance — Quality healthcare plans for eligible employees to stay healthy and protected.
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) — Pre-tax savings for healthcare and dependent care expenses.
  • 401(k) & Roth 401(k) Plans — Plan for your future with employer-supported retirement options.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) — Confidential support services for personal and professional well-being.

  • Complimentary On-Shift Meals (participating hotels) — Enjoy a free meal provided during each scheduled shift.
  • Recognition & Rewards Program — Associates are acknowledged through performance awards, milestone celebrations, and incentive programs.


WHY DO WE NEED YOU?

You're the last set of eyes before the guest walks in. As our Room Inspector, you're the standard-setter — the person who walks a freshly cleaned room and knows in an instant whether it's truly ready. You'll assign rooms to attendants, conduct thorough inspections, document findings, address guest concerns, and support the training and development of the team around you. This role carries real responsibility: your eye for detail and your commitment to quality are what separate a clean room from a guest-ready one. If you thrive in a role where your standards matter and your leadership makes the floor run better, this is where you belong.

  • Assign daily room lists to Room Attendants and manage workload throughout the shift.
  • Conduct thorough inspections of guestrooms, bathrooms, corridors, and lobbies for cleanliness and condition.

  • Write supply requisitions and maintenance work orders; report room redecoration needs.
  • Assist with hands-on cleaning and laundry tasks as workload demands.
  • Distribute new stock items to Room Attendants as directed.


SKILLS & ABILITIES YOU BRING

  • Eye for detail — you notice what others miss and hold the line on quality.
  • Supervisory or housekeeping experience preferred; previous room inspection experience a plus.
  • Team player who's willing to roll up their sleeves when the floor needs it.
  • Clear communicator with guests, management, and teammates.
  • Organized; able to plan and assign work across a team effectively.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish a plus.


SCHEDULE & HOURS

This position is full-time, with schedules that may vary based on business need. Flexibility to work any day of the week, including weekends and holidays, is required. Specific shift details will be discussed during the interview process.
