title: Vice President | Infrastructure and Security Operations
description:
#LI-CM #LI-Hybrid

CBIZ Benefits & Insurance is separating from CBIZ and must stand up its own secure, resilient technology foundation. The VP of Infrastructure and Security Operations will own cloud infrastructure and computing, network, and end-user computing including the service desk, telecommunications, and security operations. You will lead the move off CBIZ-provided infrastructure and the transition services agreements (TSAs), and build a small, nimble team that relies on managed service providers (MSPs and MSSPs) and strong partner relationships. The role puts simplicity, automation, and AI to work to reduce cost while protecting sensitive data.

Essential Functions & Primary Duties

Strategy

  • Set the mission, vision, and strategy for infrastructure and security operations, aligned with the CIO's technology vision and the business plan
  • Define enterprise standards and architecture for cloud, network, end-user computing, and telecommunications
  • Evaluate current and future infrastructure needs and publish a multi-year platform roadmap
  • Use next-generation solutions to reduce costs and increase simplicity, including automation and AI
  • Develop and maintain a disaster recovery and resiliency strategy for critical systems

Carve-Out Execution

  • Lead infrastructure separation from CBIZ, including tenant and domain separation, network and connectivity build, Day-One readiness, and standalone operations
  • Manage TSAs and define exit criteria, so that dependence on CBIZ ends on a commercially bounded schedule
  • Work with the Applications leader on sequencing, data separation, and cutover

Operations and Service Delivery

  • Create and manage the service desk, including the service model, tooling, staffing, and employee experience
  • Create and manage critical operational metrics and SLAs, with regular reporting on availability, incident response, and service quality
  • Oversee monitoring, maintenance, upgrade, and administration of all IT systems, using ITIL-aligned practices
  • Manage contact center and telephony infrastructure in partnership with the business, including the Genesys platform where applicable
  • Implement process improvements and automation to reduce manual work and operating cost

Security and Safe AI Enablement

  • Design and implement zero trust environments, including identity, device, network, and data controls
  • Lead security operations, including endpoint protection, monitoring and response, vulnerability management, and identity and access management
  • Enable the organization to use AI solutions safely and effectively, with governance that protects sensitive data (PII and client and carrier data)
  • Build and maintain controls and audit evidence for SOC 2, and PHI/PII requirements

Partners, Vendors, and Team

  • Select and manage MSP and MSSP services and manage onshore and offshore teams
  • Apply procurement rigor to every vendor decision, including requirements, competitive evaluation, contract terms, and SLAs
  • Build strong, strategic partner relationships that create value and resilience for the company
  • Build and lead a small, nimble team that depends on MSP services, with clear ownership and accountability
  • Support the technology intake process so infrastructure demand is tied to a strong business case and priority

Financial Management

  • Own the infrastructure and security operations budget, including capex and opex

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Benefits, Insurance, or financial services.
  • Private equity or sponsor-backed company experience, including board and sponsor reporting
  • Experience with telecommunications and call center technology, including Genesys
  • Experience with large enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow and Salesforce
  • Relevant certifications (for example CISSP, CISM, ITIL, or cloud certifications)
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field; advanced degree a plus
  • 10+ years leading infrastructure, cloud, and operations teams at a senior level
  • Experience leading a carve-out, divestiture, or TSA-based separation
  • Experience selecting and managing MSP and MSSP services, and managing onshore and offshore teams
  • Experience designing and implementing zero trust environments
  • Experience leveraging next-generation solutions, including automation and AI, to reduce cost and increase simplicity
  • Experience enabling organizations to use AI solutions safely and effectively while protecting sensitive data
  • Experience creating and managing a service desk
  • Experience creating and managing critical metrics and SLAs
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or both) and hybrid environments, with a business-case approach to cloud decisions
  • Strong grasp of resiliency, disaster recovery, and incident management
  • Demonstrated procurement rigor and success building strong partner relationships
  • Experience leading a small, nimble team that relies on MSP services
  • Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical and senior stakeholders

Success Measures

  • Infrastructure separated from CBIZ on schedule and within the TSA window
  • A stable, secure environment with zero trust principles in place and clean audits
  • A service desk and SLA framework that the business trusts, with transparent metrics
  • Lower operating cost and complexity through automation, AI, and disciplined vendor management
  • Safe, governed AI adoption that protects sensitive data
  • A nimble, engaged team and strong partner relationships

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 10 years of experience in related field
  • 5 years supervisory experience
  • Ability to manage deadlines
  • Ability to work on multiple assignments and prioritize accurately
  • Proficient use of applicable technology

title: Information Security Engineer - SOC and Incident Response
description:
About the Team

You will be part of the Enterprise Cyber Security organization responsible for protecting WSI associates, customers, systems, and data. The Security Operations Center (SOC) monitors enterprise security events, investigates suspicious activity, and coordinates response with Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, and technology partners.

About the Role

As an Information Security Engineer - SOC / Incident Response, you will provide Level 2 security operations support through alert triage, event investigation, and coordinated incident response. You will participate in a 24x7 SOC rotation, including weekends, holidays, and on-call coverage as assigned, and use established playbooks and escalation procedures to protect enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Triage, investigate, and document security alerts and events from Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, and other security monitoring platforms.

  • Analyze endpoint, network, identity, and application evidence to distinguish malicious activity from benign events.

  • Execute approved investigation and response playbooks through Cortex XSOAR and/or Google SecOps SOAR.

  • Perform authorized containment actions under established procedures and approval requirements; promptly escalate actions outside delegated authority.

  • Support incident investigations, evidence collection, timeline development, remediation coordination, and post-incident follow-up.

  • Use CrowdStrike, Tanium, MISP, and related tools to enrich investigations and coordinate endpoint response.

  • Escalate significant incidents and complex technical issues to senior responders, Incident Response leadership, and designated incident command roles.

  • Partner with Cyber Threat Intelligence and Detection Engineering on threat hunts, detection feedback, and alert-quality improvements.

  • Maintain accurate case notes, handoff documentation, and operational runbooks for continuous coverage.

  • Participate in 24x7 shift operations, including weekends, holidays, and on-call responsibilities, as assigned.

  • Identify opportunities for safe automation and AI-assisted investigative efficiency while validating results and following response controls.

Criteria

  • 3 years of experience in security operations, incident response, IT security, or a related technical field.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience

  • Foundational knowledge of security monitoring, endpoint security, operating systems, networking, and common attack techniques.

  • Experience triaging alerts, investigating security events, and documenting findings.

  • Familiarity with SIEM, EDR, case management, and escalation procedures.

  • Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 operational environment and communicate clearly during time-sensitive events.

  • Experience with Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, Cortex XSOAR, Google SecOps SOAR, Tanium, or MISP preferred.

  • Experience supporting endpoint containment, evidence handling, threat hunting, or response playbooks preferred.

  • Basic scripting, automation, or AI-assisted analysis experience preferred.

  • This role requires being onsite in the Rocklin, CA, San Jose, CA or Brooklyn, NY office Monday through Thursday.

Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits

  • A generous discount on all WSI brands

  • A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities

  • Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer

  • Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits

  • Tax-free commuter benefits

  • A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health

Continued Learning

  • In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University

WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).

company: Franciscan Missionaries of Our Lady Health System
description:
The Clinical Quality Analyst 2 will play a crucial role in supporting the health system's mission to provide high-quality care through data analysis and reporting. This position involves analyzing clinical and operational data to identify trends, improve patient outcomes, and support strategic decision-making. The Clinical Quality Analyst 2 collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and drives initiatives that enhance overall healthcare quality.

Data Analysis: Collect, analyze, and interpret clinical and operational data to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities for enhancing patient outcomes.

Reporting: Develop, maintain, and distribute regular and ad-hoc reports on key quality indicators and performance metrics to stakeholders.

Team Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.

Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare quality standards, regulatory requirements, and accreditation processes.

title: Sr Software Engineer - Experimentation
description:
About the Role

What we do

The Experimentation team provides cutting edge tooling and methodologies for all teams at Uber to make rapid decisions for their product iterations. Experimentation is an exciting domain that combines multiple disciplines of Software Engineering (Backend, Distributed Systems, Mobile, Web, Data Infra), Data Science, and Product Design.

Every major launch across any of Uber’s Rides, Delivery, Earner, Freight, and Uber For Business (U4B) organizations leverages the Experimentation platform to determine how new features impact key business metrics. Virtually all Engineers, Scientists, and Product Managers at the company use our platform on a daily basis to launch, monitor, test, and make changes to Uber’s ecosystem.

Why it matters

  • Velocity with Confidence: By automating experiment design, rollout, and analysis, we reduce the cost of iteration and let teams validate the impact of features our members love.
  • Company Wide Reach: Virtually every engineer, data scientist, and product manager touches our platform daily to launch, monitor, and refine Uber’s ecosystem.
  • Business Impact at Scale: Decisions backed by our tooling safeguard core metrics while empowering innovators to push boundaries.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience in an engineering related bootcamp
  • 5+ years of experience in professional software development experience, developing and deploying systems in production environments
  • Proven skills writing efficient, clean code in Go, Java, or Python
  • Ability to debug and fix software bugs in a production scale environment
  • Experience with software engineering best practices
  • Strong grasp of distributed-systems fundamentals: caching, sharding, consensus, fault tolerance, observability, and incident response
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document architectures and algorithms

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct ownership of experiment analysis workflows (A/B, quasi-experimental, marketplace simulations) at scale.
    • Python, Pandas, PySpark
    • Data Pipelines (e.g. Spark, Scala)
    • Jupyter Notebooks
  • Professional experience with feature-flag and progressive-delivery systems (e.g. internal rollout platforms)

What You Will Do

  • Own and evolve A/B and Marketplace Experimentation products at Uber.
  • Build and optimize large-scale data pipelines in Spark/Presto to compute experiment metrics, power analyses, and marketplace-level supply-demand insights.
  • Advance monitoring & alerting so product teams spot experiment-driven regressions in minutes—expand real-time dashboards, anomaly detection, and on-call playbooks.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and product managers to translate causal-inference models into robust, production-ready APIs and batch workflows.
  • Continuously raise the engineering bar—deliver comprehensive tests, champion code health, conduct performance profiling, and drive incident retrospectives.
  • Utilize software development best practices to ensure team owned systems, libraries, and microservices are reliable (monitoring, alerting, logging, etc)
  • Design and document architectural solutions to complex engineering problems

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year - USD $224,000 per year.

You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

title: Life Skills Coordinator
description:
Gateway Rehab Center (GRC) is hiring a full-time Life Skills Coordinator for our Halfway House for women, Lighthouse for Women, in Washington, PA! In this rewarding role, you will develop and coordinate life skills programming that supports patients in building the skills, confidence, and resources needed for successful recovery and independent living.


If you're passionate about helping individuals in recovery develop practical life skills and thrive in their communities, keep reading!


Why You'll Love Working at GRC

GRC's Lighthouse for Women team is helping individuals build the foundation for long-term recovery, and as a Life Skills Coordinator, you'll play a vital role in that process. By teaching practical life skills, connecting patients with community resources, and creating opportunities for personal growth and engagement, you'll help individuals develop the confidence and tools needed to live successfully in recovery. This is more than just a job. It's a mission-driven career where you can make a lasting impact every single day!

  • Computer literacy preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to engage and motivate individuals in recovery.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities while maintaining accurate documentation.

The ideal candidate is compassionate, organized, resourceful, and committed to helping individuals develop the practical skills necessary for long-term recovery and successful community living.

title: Senior Director, GCP Quality
description:
Remix Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering a new class of medicines that modulate RNA splicing to address the underlying biology of disease. Our lead program, REM-422, targets pre-mRNA splicing in oncology and represents a fundamentally differentiated approach to drug discovery. Headquartered in Watertown, MA, Remix is advancing its pipeline with the urgency and scientific rigor that patients deserve.

Position Summary:

The GCP Quality Assurance candidate will manage activities related to the development, maintenance and oversight of GCP activities related to the Clinical Trial activities sponsored by company. The primary responsibilities will be to ensure both quality and compliance of company sponsored clinical trials with respect to Standard Operating Procedures, applicable regulatory requirements (US FDA, ICH, and country specific), along with current industry standards and practices.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Write and/or review SOPs to assess consistency and compliance with regulatory requirements/internal standards and determine/ensure effective implementation across the organization.
  • Provide guidance to Clinical Operations staff and other GCP-related departments, as applicable, based on interpretation of current regulations to ensure best practices including risk based management.
  • Provide guidance with the identification and management of risks in clinical trial activities and monitor/evaluate risk management activities.
  • Work closely with Clinical Operations and other GCP-related departments, as applicable, to ensure/coordinate appropriate and complete resolution of findings/non-compliant issues in a timely manner, including approval of corrective action/preventative action (CAPA) plans, as necessary.
  • Participate in the review of drug safety practices for clinical trial compliance.
  • Conduct and/or assist in internal audits (systems, processes, vendors, computer system validation).
  • Identify need for, conduct and/or assist in external audits (includes, but is not limited to, investigator sites, central IRBs, CROs and clinical labs).
  • Oversee the audit response process for the Investigator Site and Contract Research Organization (CRO) audits/inspections and ensure acceptability of actions to address findings through the CAPA process.
  • Provide functional review of clinical protocols, Informed Consent Forms, Clinical Study Reports and other clinical trial related documents.
  • Assist and advise with training QA and clinical staff as necessary for GCP.
  • Collaborate with applicable departmental heads to identify clinical trial and regulatory training needs of Clinical Operations (and other Clinical trial members) based on regulatory changes, process/system changes, audit findings, trends, , and assist in coordinating the training to meet the needs.
  • Identify potential systemic gaps and coordinate with the appropriate stakeholder to ensure timely remediation. As appropriate, escalate issues of critical non-compliance and/or lack of urgency in remediation to senior management.
  • Perform program specific root cause analysis of compliance issues and provide the appropriate metrics for tracking and trending for the overall QA reporting requirements to functional and senior management.
  • Provide guidance with the development and management of key vendor oversight activities for clinical trials and monitor/evaluate the oversight activities.
  • Assist senior staff during regulatory inspections.
  • Ability to travel domestic and international.
  • Other duties, as required.

  • At least 10 years of direct GCP pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience
  • Solid understanding and application of GCP, GLP and ICH requirements, especially ICH E6
  • Excellent written and oral communications skills

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with knowledge of basic negotiation, influencing and conflict management to assure effective interactions within and across departments
  • The ability to simultaneously handle multiple project issues while dealing with time demands, incomplete information, or unexpected events

title: Scientific Computer Engineer, Staff Cloud Infrastructure
description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a Staff Cloud Infrastructure / Scientific Computer Engineer to help build, operate, and improve the infrastructure foundations that support computational science, data engineering, analytics, and enterprise business operations across RevMed. This role will emphasize site reliability engineering, Kubernetes operations, observability, Databricks infrastructure, and cloud financial management (FinOps).

This role will partner with scientific, G&A, data, security, and IT stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, scalable compute and platform services. The ideal candidate brings deep infrastructure experience, strong operational judgment, and the ability to translate scientific and business computing needs into practical, reusable platform patterns. They will balance reliability, performance, security, and cost, using operational data to guide improvements.

  • Design, operate, and improve secure cloud infrastructure for R&D and scientific computing workloads.

  • Build reusable infrastructure patterns for compute, storage, networking, identity, secrets management, and observability.

  • Use Infrastructure as Code, primarily Terraform, to standardize provisioning and change management.

  • Apply SRE practices to critical platform services, including service-level indicators and objectives, actionable alerting, incident response, post-incident reviews, and automation that reduces operational toil.

  • Operate and improve Kubernetes environments, including cluster upgrades, workload deployment, resource allocation, autoscaling, networking, access controls, and troubleshooting.

  • Develop observability across cloud, Kubernetes, and data platforms using metrics, logs, and traces to identify failures, diagnose performance issues, and understand capacity needs.

  • Support high-throughput and scientific compute environments, including HPC and scheduler-based workloads.

  • Enable reproducible compute patterns using Linux, containers, registries, and automated deployment workflows.

  • Partner with data and ML teams on infrastructure for dataset staging, training workflows, batch inference, and platform reliability.

  • Own the operational foundations of Databricks environments, including workspace provisioning, compute policies, networking, identity, secrets, governance integrations, monitoring, and infrastructure automation.

  • Partner with data teams to improve Databricks workload reliability, compute utilization, performance, and cost through appropriate compute sizing, autoscaling, workload isolation, and lifecycle controls.

  • Support data platform infrastructure for scientific, analytics, and G&A use cases, including secure access patterns, governance integrations, and scalable storage.

  • Drive FinOps practices across cloud and Databricks services, including cost allocation and tagging, usage visibility, budgets, forecasting, anomaly detection, and optimization recommendations.

  • Identify and implement cost improvements through rightsizing, idle-resource cleanup, storage lifecycle management, and appropriate purchasing commitments, while preserving workload reliability and performance.

  • Improve operational practices such as monitoring, incident response, runbooks, capacity planning, recovery readiness, and service ownership.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with scientists, data engineers, security, and IT to deliver practical platform solutions.

  • Mentor others and contribute to standards, documentation, and reusable patterns for cloud operations, reliability engineering, and scientific infrastructure.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, systems engineering, DevOps/SRE, scientific computing, or related technical roles.

  • Strong experience operating production infrastructure in AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform.

  • Strong experience with Terraform or comparable Infrastructure as Code practices.

  • Practical experience with Linux, networking fundamentals, system troubleshooting, and operational support.

  • Experience with CI/CD, version control, peer review, testing, and change management practices.

  • Experience supporting containerized workloads using Docker or similar technologies, including hands-on experience operating Kubernetes in production.

  • Experience implementing observability and reliability practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident management, and systematic troubleshooting of distributed services.

  • Experience operating Databricks or comparable managed data platforms, with an understanding of compute, networking, identity, governance, and operational support.

  • Experience analyzing cloud usage and expenditure and implementing cost optimization measures with measurable results.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently on complex technical problems and collaborate across teams.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar agents for cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, systems configuration, operational tooling, AI-native application development, and agentic engineering.

  • Experience with managed Kubernetes services such as Amazon EKS or Azure AKS, and deployment approaches using Helm or GitOps.

  • Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or comparable cloud-native or commercial tools.

  • Experience with Databricks infrastructure automation, Unity Catalog integrations, compute policies, and workload usage and cost reporting.

  • Experience with FinOps processes and tooling, including cost attribution, showback, forecasting, commitment planning, and collaboration with Finance and workload owners.

  • Experience supporting HPC or high-throughput compute environments, including Slurm or similar schedulers.

  • Experience supporting scientific computing, computational chemistry, computational biology, or data-intensive R&D workflows.

  • Experience with cloud security, identity, least privilege access, auditability, and regulated environments.

  • Familiarity with workflow tools such as Nextflow, Snakemake, Airflow, or cloud batch services.

  • Experience building reusable platform patterns, documentation, and self-service infrastructure capabilities.

title: Advanced Specialist, Project Management
description:
Advanced Specialist, Project Management

Summary

The Advanced Specialist, Project Management drives the planning, execution, and delivery of strategic initiatives across multiple squads. They act as the operational bridge between Product Management, Business Analysis, Architecture, Engineering, Quality Engineering, Operations, and executive stakeholders, ensuring squads stay aligned to business priorities, contractual obligations, and platform investments.

This role is accountable for delivery planning, dependency management, risk mitigation, stakeholder communication, release coordination, and execution transparency across a globally distributed onshore and offshore workforce. It leads through program-management expertise, technical fluency, and influence without formal authority.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery for a medium-to-large program or multiple squads.

  • Own cross-squad dependency management, critical-path management, and risk mitigation.

  • Coordinate release planning and execution across squads and platforms.

  • Provide executive-ready delivery transparency — status, risks, and decisions needed — as a single reliable view of what is in flight and at risk.

  • Align squads to business priorities, contractual obligations, and platform investments.

  • Facilitate program ceremonies, planning, and cross-team alignment.

  • Drive delivery process improvements and predictability across squads.

  • Use AI and PM tooling for planning, reporting, and risk intelligence.

People influence (no formal people management)

  • Carries meaningful people-influence responsibilities without direct reports: mentors and coaches project managers, leads cross-team without formal authority, participates actively in interviewing and hiring, and contributes input to performance and development conversations for people they coordinate. These behavioral markers are real and expected at this level even though the role has no people-management authority.

Required skills and competencies

  • Advanced program / delivery management: planning, dependency and risk management, release coordination, and executive reporting.

  • Technical fluency (e.g., cloud, microservices, APIs, CI/CD) sufficient to facilitate decisions — not a hands-on developer.

  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, and conflict resolution.

  • Ability to drive delivery across globally distributed onshore and offshore teams.

  • Leadership and influence without formal authority; mentoring and coaching capability.

  • Ability to resolve ambiguity and balance competing priorities and constraints.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of project, program, or delivery management experience.

  • Experience leading enterprise software delivery and scaled / Agile delivery environments.

  • Demonstrated success managing complex, cross-functional programs and globally distributed teams.

  • PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent certification strongly preferred but not required.

Success measures

  • Multiple squads / a medium-to-large program deliver predictably against plan.

  • Cross-squad dependencies and critical-path risks are managed proactively, not reactively.

  • Leadership has a single, reliable, executive-ready view of what is in flight and at risk.

  • Releases across squads are coordinated with minimal disruption and clear readiness.

  • Raises delivery-management practice across the team through mentoring, interviewing, and standards.

Leadership behaviors

Customer Centricity Keeps delivery aligned to business priorities, contractual obligations, and candidate / client value across squads.

Raise the Performance Bar Sets high standards for delivery predictability and transparency; continuously improves how squads execute.

Exceptional Collaboration for Value Builds alignment across Product, Engineering, Architecture, QE, and Operations, and influences without authority.

title: Conflicts Analyst
description:
The world’s leading organizations and global players choose Proskauer to represent them when they need it the most. With 800+ lawyers in key financial centers around the world, we are known for our pragmatic and business-savvy approach.

Proskauer is the place to turn when a matter is complex, innovative and game-changing. We work seamlessly across practices, industries and jurisdictions with asset managers, private equity and venture capital firms, Fortune 500 and FTSE companies, major sports leagues, entertainment industry legends and other industry-redefining companies.

We are seeking a Conflicts Analyst to join the Firm’s Conflicts Department. This role will assist with conflicts searching and clearances associated with new business intake, lateral hires and business development across the Firm. The Conflicts Analyst is responsible for assisting in the management of procedures related to new business for the firm and working closely with Conflicts Attorneys and other members of the team to facilitate the review, analysis, and processing of conflicts requests to identify legal and business-related issues with accepting new clients and matters under prevailing ethical rules, applicable law and internal policies.

  • Coordinate and assist in the identification, resolution and clearance of potential and actual conflicts of interest in relation to new business intake, lateral legal personnel, new hires, and Business Development/Marketing initiatives.
  • Consult with Partners and Associates, Conflicts Attorneys, Director of Conflicts and General Counsel’s Office as necessary to facilitate clearance and approval on all potential and actual conflicts of interest.
  • Search, analyze, identify and report the existence of actual and potential conflicts of interest to requesting lawyer(s) and/or Firm personnel using a variety of conflict reporting and search tools.
  • Research, retrieve and sort entity relationship and key organizational personnel using entity affiliation/family tree platforms.
  • Generate and circulate conflicts and related reports for use throughout all levels of the Firm.
  • Assist with Know Your Client (“KYC”) functions, including researching, retrieving and sorting data relating to, among other things: fines, sanctions, political exposure/affiliation, adverse media, financial health and other screening considerations.
  • Integrate all findings with the Firm’s conflicts resolution systems, augmenting existing client/matter data.
  • Follow-up with appropriate lawyer(s) and/or Firm personnel as required to perform any and all above functions, including, but not limited to, obtaining conflicts clearances, waivers and engagement letters.
  • Assist in the implementation of Ethical Walls as necessary.
  • Support the maintenance and coordination of overall workflow processes.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • Bachelor’s Degree; J.D. a plus.
  • 2+ years of demonstrated legal conflicts of interest researching, identification and resolution experience in the Conflicts Department of a major law firm or financial institution preferred.
  • Experience with InTapp Open/Conflicts and LegalKey highly preferred.
  • Experience in a major law firm or financial institution environment preferred.
  • Experience with lateral conflicts clearances a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to use other industry standard office software applications including Microsoft Office Suite, Outlook, Adobe, Filesite, Aderant (or similar platform), and other resources required. Internet research proficiency preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to research corporate ownership through public sources and related software like Capital IQ preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to initiate, follow through and complete time sensitive projects with minimal supervision in a fast-paced global law firm environment preferred.
  • Demonstrated excellent oral and written business communication skills necessary to interact with Partners, Counsel, Associates and other Firm personnel throughout the Firm’s international offices required.
  • Attention to detail and strong analytical and organizational skills required.

This position may require periodic physical presence in Proskauer’s offices as business needs require. The anticipated compensation range for this position is $70,000 - $95,000. The actual salary offered will be based on a number of factors including but not limited to the qualifications of the applicant, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Proskauer is committed to providing a work environment that includes equal opportunity without regard to race, color, gender, age, creed, sex, religion, national origin, disability (physical or mental), marital status, citizenship, ancestry, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, or any other legally protected status.

title: Fire Sprinkler Technician
description:
SPECIFIC TO THIS ROLE:

Candidates must have OSFM ITT (WA State Patrol), NICET Level II, and journey-level sprinkler fitter certification. Backflow Assembly Tester (BAT) certification is preferred. Confined space entry, lift, and fall protection training are a bonus.

The responsibility of a Fire Sprinkler Technician is to successfully lay out, fabricate, assemble, install fires sprinkler systems, as well as maintain piping systems, fixtures, sprinklers and industrial processing systems.

  • Install pipe systems and valves
  • Cut, thread, assemble and bond piping and tubes according to specifications
  • Modify, clean and maintain pipe systems, units and fittings
  • Remove and replace worn components
  • Follow blueprints to meet product specifications
  • Calculate material measurements to verify specifications
  • Mentor and coach Fire Sprinkler Fitter Apprentice’s and Helpers on proper installation techniques
  • Ensure company provided vehicle is clean and well maintained in accordance with company policies.
  • Other duties may be assigned.

Education, Training, Certifications:

  • HS Diploma or equivalent, required.
  • Advanced technical school training or related work experience, preferred.
  • Current Fire Sprinkler License, required.

Experience, Knowledge, Skill Requirements:

  • 3-5 years’ experience installing pipe systems and valves, required. 5+ years’ experience, preferred.
  • Must be able to work alone and as part of a team. Basic math skills, mechanical aptitude, problem solving skills, customer service skills, decision making skills, ability to multitask, ability to meet project schedules, ability to plan and organize, troubleshooting skills, and the ability to train other is required.

Communication Skills:

  • Must have the ability to effectively read, write and communicate in English with employees and customers.

Systems and Software Skills:

  • Ability to operate a computer, tablet and read electronic blueprints required. Experience with SalesForce and Microsoft Office is preferred.

Other Qualifications:

  • Valid driver’s license with acceptable driving record required
  • Must be able to comply with SFS’s Drug and Alcohol policy and Background screening requirements, which may also include customer specific requirements based on contractual agreement

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform Essential Job Duties.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to bend, ascend and descend step stools, ladders and stairs, kneel, lift <50lbs, reach above and below shoulders, stand and walk for extended periods of time. Employee is required to see in color, close and far distances, peripheral, depth, and adjust focus. Employee will occasional be required to balance, crouch, drive, kneel, lift >50lbs, sit, stoop, twist, and work at heights.

Frequent local travel and occasional regional and non-regional travel is required. Employee will frequently be required to work inside and outside in hot/cold temperatures and be exposed to loud noises, cramped quarters, dust, fumes and odors, standing on hard surfaces, and electrical hazards frequently. Employees will occasionally be exposed to chemicals, moving machinery, uneven and slippery surfaces. title: QA Tester
description:
Job Overview:

We’re looking for a Manual QA to ensure the quality, functionality, and reliability of websites and web applications. This role involves creating and executing test cases, identifying and documenting bugs, and verifying that websites meet functional, visual, usability, and performance standards before deployment. You’ll conduct manual testing across WordPress, Shopify, and custom web applications, including responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, forms, e-commerce checkout flows, and third-party integrations. You’ll also collaborate with developers, designers, and project managers to resolve issues, maintain QA documentation, and ensure a smooth website launch.

Responsibilities:

  • Taking part in QA processes, reading and analysis of requirements, writing and implementation of test plans/cases, testing of websites/web applications
  • Ensuring the overall quality of the sites delivered functional and non-functional testing
  • Writing, reviewing, and updating document procedures to enable faster troubleshooting and resolution
  • Conduct thorough testing of websites and web applications, including functional, usability, performance, security, and cross-browser testing
  • Identify, document, and track bugs, inconsistencies, and usability issues, providing clear reports to developers and project managers
  • Verify responsive design and mobile compatibility across multiple devices and screen sizes
  • Test third-party integrations such as CRM, e-commerce platforms, email marketing tools, and analytics
  • Ensure SEO best practices and web accessibility (WCAG) compliance
  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and project managers to improve website performance and resolve issues
  • Conduct regression testing to ensure new updates do not introduce errors
  • Monitor and test website speed and performance, recommending optimizations
  • Ensure security compliance and check for vulnerabilities in web applications
  • Perform manual functional, UI, cross-browser, and device testing using staging/local environments before deployments.
  • Review design files (Figma, Adobe XD) against developed pages to verify visual accuracy and layout fidelity.
  • Validate manual forms, lead captures, navigation flows, and e-commerce checkout processes end-to-end.
  • Log, categorize, and track bugs with detailed steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings in ClickUp.
  • Inform the Team Lead and Project Manager of critical blockers or show-stopping issues prior to scheduled site launches.
  • Create and maintain manual test checklists, test-case scenarios, and pre-launch QA sign-off documentation.
  • Bachelor's Degree holder in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or related courses
  • Hands-on experience conducting manual QA for custom WordPress themes, custom plugins, and Shopify stores.
  • Experience using cross-browser and mobile device testing tools (e.g., BrowserStack, real mobile devices).
  • Experience managing bug tickets, reporting issue statuses, and verifying fixes in ClickUp.
  • Proven experience in web quality assurance testing for WordPress, Shopify, Web App etc.
  • Familiarity with manual and automated testing tools (e.g., Selenium, BrowserStack, Lighthouse, GTmetrix).
  • Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and how they affect website functionality.
  • Experience in cross-browser and responsive design testing.
  • Knowledge of SEO, web accessibility (WCAG standards), and security best practices.
  • Experience in using bug tracking tools like Jira, Trello, or Asana.
  • Ability to perform API testing (Postman, RESTful API testing is a plus).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to provide clear, detailed reports.
  • Must be adaptable, flexible and possess a sense of urgency
  • Ability to work independently as well as with a team
  • Amenable to work 9AM – 6PM, Mon - Fri; Onsite

title: Gilbert - American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor/ Instructor Trainer
description:
About Us

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

Note: The Instructor Trainer's teaching methods and content must comply with American Red Cross requirements.

License / Certification

  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Certification, r.25 — Required if you are looking for an instructor role
  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Trainer Certification, r.25 — Required﻿ ﻿if you are looking for an instructor trainer role
  • American Red Cross BLS Instructor Trainer Certification — Preferred
  • American Heart Association BLS Instructor Certification — Preferred
  • Other equivalent Instructor Trainer certifications may be considered where an approved bridging pathway is available; we can provide bridging guidance.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.
  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.
  • Monitor and evaluate candidate progress to ensure proficiency.
  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with CPR and AED training best practices.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

  • Current American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor certification.
  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to demonstrate proper CPR and AED techniques.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.
  • Work may be performed primarily during weekends.

Salary: $30.00 - $40.00 per teaching hour, commensurate with experience and length of working relationship with ALLCPR.

  1. Coordinate and monitor all activities of the purchasing cycle, including but not limited to revision and consolidation of purchase request forms, organization of bidding processes, evaluation, delivery of goods and services, payment to suppliers, filing system and reporting. May authorize purchases in line with Purchase Authorization Matrix.

  2. Work with managers in the development of procurement plans to optimize purchasing power and facilitate the implementation of project activities.

  3. Participate in negotiations of terms and conditions of purchases and resolve issues related to the delivery of goods and services.

  4. Provide technical guidance to requisitioners and all staff in the office on preparation of specifications and interpretation and implementation of procurement instructions and procedures.

  5. Identify local and international suppliers and service providers; participate in their evaluation taking into consideration quality, prices, reliability, and services and the organization’s best interests.

  6. Create and implement administrative tools for tracking and monitoring of contracts, agreements, and progress of activities toward the achievement of the procurement plans and schedules.

  7. Participate in capacity development of staff, providers and partners on IOM’s procurement processes and policies.

  8. Coordinate and monitor supply chain activities related to property and asset management, warehousing, insurance coverage, maintenance, and transportation. Identify challenges and provide recommendations.

  9. Coordinate and monitor the maintenance and repair of office facilities, including preventive maintenance. Contribute to the establishment of maintenance agreements with competent service providers when it is feasible and determined to be cost effective.

  10. Implement internal control mechanisms to safeguard the organization’s assets and prevent fraud.

  11. Coordinate supply chain operations with other UN Agencies, partners, and government authorities.

  12. Participate in the development, evaluation, and updating of systems and procedures for supply chain management, suggest areas for improvement and risk-mitigation measures.

  13. Provide training and guidance to the SCM staff of CO, while supervising, monitoring, evaluating and supporting their professional and career development.

  14. Participate and engage actively in the UN inter-agency meetings and forums related to supply chain management. Collaborate on sharing resources to achieve common goals and implementation of UN global initiatives.

  15. Perform other duties as may be assigned.

EDUCATION

  • University degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or

  • High school diploma with seven years of relevant professional experience;

  • Certification in Procurement, Logistics or Supply Chain Management is an advantage.

EXPERIENCE

  • Experience in procurement and logistics and working with service providers and vendors;

  • Experience with asset management process;

  • Experience working with IOM/UN Procurement and Logistics Rules and Procedures is an advantage;

  • Experience working in an international organisation in a multi-cultural setting an advantage;

  • Experience in training and coordinating teams.

SKILLS

  • High level of computer literacy;

  • Ability to work with national and international institutions;

  • Ability to prepare clear and concise report;

  • Demonstrated ability to and exercise sound judgment;

  • Ability to supervise staff and coordinate administrative activities;

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills;

  • Ability to establish realistic resource requirements to meet IOM needs.

    Languages[1]
    IOM’s official languages are English, French, and Spanish.

    REQUIRED

  • For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written).

    DESIRABLE

  • Marshallese

    Competencies[2]

  • The incumbent is expected to demonstrate the following values and competencies:

VALUES - All IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.

  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.

  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.

  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.

  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

    CORE COMPETENCIES - Behavioural indicators – Level 2

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.

  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.

  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.

  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.

  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

title: Registration Representative I- Outpatient/Gulf Breeze
description:
The Registration Representative performs a variety of data entry and general registration functions for outpatient departments within the facility. This role is responsible for accurately collecting patient demographic and insurance information to ensure appropriate reimbursement and timely claim submission. The registration representative uses available technology to provide clear, accurate estimates of patient financial responsibility and to collect expected out‑of‑pocket amounts. This position is responsible for following all registration and admitting policies and procedures. This role completes a variety of administrative and admitting tasks to facilitate the admission of patients of all ages. As one of the first points of contacts, this role provides exceptional customer service, acting as a resource for patients, families, and visitors and enhancing their experience through professional communication, hospitality, and supportive guidance during stressful situations.

  • Greets all patients and visitors entering the facility, providing a professional, welcoming, and service‑oriented experience. Communicates clearly and effectively with patients, visitors, and leadership.
  • Completes all outpatient registrations accurately and efficiently through consistent monitoring of tracking boards, ensuring timely entry of patient demographics, insurance information, and required documentation in accordance with organizational and regulatory standards.
  • Follows all patient identification policies and procedures.
  • Verifies insurance eligibility and benefits by reviewing insurance or managed‑care identification cards, confirming coverage, and identifying any authorization requirements prior to service.
  • Calculates, communicates, and collects expected patient out‑of‑pocket costs using financial‑estimation technology, including co‑pays, deductibles, and coinsurance amounts.
  • Distributes required handouts and regulatory documents to patients or their representatives, ensuring understanding and compliance with hospital and legal requirements.
  • Operates and troubleshoots registration software and hardware, demonstrating working knowledge of electronic health record systems, insurance verification tools, and related equipment.
  • Provides hospitality and concierge‑level support, assisting patients, families, and visitors with directions, information, and service needs to enhance the overall hospital experience. Acts as a resource for patients and internal teams, addressing questions, resolving registration‑related issues, and promoting a positive, patient‑centered environment.
  • Coordinates with provider offices to secure required clinical documentation including orders, authorizations, and medical necessity details to ensure all information is complete and available on the day of service, preventing delays in patient care.
  • Collaborates proactively with ancillary departments such as Imaging, Lab, and Nursing to resolve registration, documentation, or scheduling issues, supporting smooth patient flow and minimizing service disruptions
  • Engages and resolves registration quality alerts ensuring denial reductions.
  • Works proactively and independently during downtimes or otherwise to ensure all Access function tasks are addressed.
  • May be required to work at another location as needed and team members are responsible for their own transportation.


Minimum Education

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent Required


Minimum Work Experience

  • 6 months relevant revenue cycle or customer service experience Required

Impact lives with Management & Training Corporation (MTC)! At the Walker-Sayle Unit in Breckenridge, Texas, our foundation is based upon the philosophies of caring about others, giving back, and making a social impact. Essential Duties:

  1. Assists in planning chemical dependency counseling programs; and coordinates the delivery of counseling services to offenders with histories of chemical use, abuse, or addiction.

description:
회사 소개

쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다.

쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.

분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡이츠 KAM(Key Account Management)팀은 국내 주요 대형 외식·프랜차이즈 브랜드와의 전략적 파트너십을 통해 브랜드의 성장과 쿠팡이츠의 지속적인 거래액(GMV) 성장을 만들어가는 조직입니다. 브랜드별 비즈니스 성과와 시장·경쟁 환경에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 성장 기회를 발굴하고, 광고·프로모션·신메뉴 등 다양한 성장 전략을 유관 부서와 함께 실행합니다.

본 포지션은 브랜드별 주요 지표 및 데이터 관리, 광고·프로모션 운영, 매장 운영 지원을 담당합니다. 브랜드사와 내부 유관 부서를 연결하는 실무 접점으로서 다양한 요청과 운영 이슈를 조율하고, 브랜드의 성장 계획이 실제 운영으로 원활하게 이어질 수 있도록 실행을 뒷받침합니다.

업무 내용

  • 운영 데이터 추출·분석 및 데이터 정합성 검증
  • 거래액(GMV), 주문 수, 객단가 등 핵심 성과 지표와 광고, 신메뉴, 프로모션 결과에 대한 수익성·운영 지표 관리, 분석 및 리포팅
  • 브랜드별 광고 상품 및 프로모션 제안·운영, 일정 관리, 참여 조건 검토 및 세부 운영 사항 관리
  • 광고·프로모션 관련 계약 관리 및 신메뉴, 매장 온보딩, 메뉴·카탈로그 진행 현황 관리
  • 운영 과정에서 발생하는 브랜드 이슈의 원인 파악 및 유관 부서 협업을 통한 문제 해결과 후속 조치 지원

자격 요건

  • 이커머스, 플랫폼 또는 브랜드·파트너 운영 관련 업무 경험이 있으신 분
  • Excel, Google Sheets 등 업무 도구를 활용하여 데이터를 정확하게 정리·검토·관리할 수 있으신 분
  • 브랜드사 및 다양한 유관 부서와 원활하게 소통하며 요청 사항과 업무 일정을 효과적으로 조율할 수 있으신 분
  • 여러 브랜드와 캠페인을 동시에 관리하며 업무 우선순위를 설정하고 진행 현황 및 세부 사항을 꼼꼼하게 관리할 수 있으신 분
  • 고객 및 파트너 관점에서 운영상의 문제를 파악하고, 해결을 위한 후속 조치를 주도적이고 책임감 있게 수행할 수 있으신 분

우대 사항

  • 배달 플랫폼 또는 외식·프랜차이즈 브랜드 관련 업무 경험이 있으신 분
  • 광고·프로모션 운영 및 관련 계약, 내부 승인 프로세스에 대한 이해와 실무 경험이 있으신 분
  • SQL을 활용한 데이터 추출·분석 및 주요 운영 지표 관리 경험이 있으신 분
  • 다양한 유관 부서와 협업하여 운영 이슈를 해결하거나 프로젝트 운영을 지원한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 반복 업무의 표준화·자동화 또는 AI 도구 활용을 통해 운영 효율을 개선한 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Sr Director, Software Business Transformation
description:
As Sr Director of Software Business Transformation at Honeywell, you will play a critical role in leading and optimizing the Accelerator operating system for the Software Business Model. You will develop and execute the Software Accelerator strategy, working across the end-to-end value chain with functional GDM leadership to deploy and integrate business processes. A successful candidate must be capable of translating business strategic objectives into transformation initiatives to achieve business goals and create a competitive advantage. Your leadership and expertise will help drive commercial and operational excellence, enhance customer experiences, and foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

You will report directly to our VP Accelerator, and you’ll work out of our Charlotte, NC or Atlanta, GA location on a hybrid work schedule.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead and optimize the Software Accelerator Global Design Model (GDM); including Standardized Processes, leading Software Accelerator Day presentations, KPI reporting, deploying and driving maturity of GDMs, and maintaining a strong Management Operating System

• Ensure compliance to GDM partnering with both Controllership and Audit to assess adherence to minimum standards

• Drive transformation and continuous improvement in the software business model end to end with a focus on commercial initiatives, program management, software engineering, R&D, S4 Hana, and customer success

• Develop and implement strategies aligned with business objectives, focusing on sustainable growth

• Provide guidance, support, and mentorship for Software business teams

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive Software and Honeywell Accelerator objectives

• Foster a culture of excellence, collaboration, and innovation throughout the Software business model

BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL:

• Benefits – Medical, Vision, Dental, Mental Health

• Paid Vacation

• 401k Plan & Matching

• Career Growth

• Professional Development

YOU MUST HAVE

• Minimum 10 years of experience in leadership roles, preferably in a matrixed, global organization

• Experience in Software business model

WE VALUE

• MBA Degree

• Program Management experience, and Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

• Experience in leading and delivering complex transformations

• Excellent analytical and financial acumen

• Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders

• Continuous learning mindset

ABOUT HONEYWELL

Honeywell International Inc. (NYSE: HON) invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world’s most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, air travel, productivity, and global urbanization. We are a leading software-industrial company committed to introducing state of the art technology solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, sustainability, and safety in high growth businesses in broad-based, attractive industrial end markets. Our products and solutions enable a safer, more comfortable, and more productive world, enhancing the quality of life of people around the globe. Learn more here:

title: Community Health Worker (FTE, Dayshift, Clearlake)
description:
Located in the metropolitan area of Sacramento, the Adventist Health corporate headquarters have been based in Roseville, California, for more than 40 years. In 2019, we unveiled our WELL-certified campus - a rejuvenating place for associates systemwide to collaborate, innovate and connect.

Adventist Health Roseville and shared service teams have access to enjoy a welcoming space designed to promote well-being and inspire your best work.

Job Summary:

Assists with helping patients and families navigate/access community services and other resources. Advocates for individual and community health needs and assists with providing direct services such as mammogram and diabetes screenings during community outreach activities. Supports staff in helping patients adopt healthy behaviors. Assists with promoting, maintaining and helping to improve the health of community patients and their families. Works under direct supervision.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

  • High School Education/GED or equivalent: Preferred
  • Associate’s/Technical Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred
  • Successful completion of a Community Health Worker formal training program from an accredited college, or other educational institution: Preferred

Essential Functions:

  • Assists in offering interpretation and translation services, provides culturally appropriate health education and information, assists people in receiving needed care, provides informal counseling and guidance on health behaviors. Establishes trusting relationships with patients and their families while providing general support and encouragement. Conducts intake interviews with patients, including enrolling and/or referring patients into local services.
  • Follows-up with patients via phone calls, makes home visits and frequents other settings where patients can be found. Assists patients with completing applications and registration forms. Conducts eligibility determination, enrollment and follow-up with uninsured patients. Helps patients set personal goals and attend appointments. Applies developing/basic working knowledge and experience to the job.
  • Helps patients connect with transportation resources. Exhibits excellent working relations with patients, visitors and staff, effectively communicating the organization's mission. Works on routine assignments within defined parameters, established guidelines and precedents.
  • Works closely with medical provider/s to help ensure patients have comprehensive and coordinated care. Follows patients from initial identification through closure. Follows established procedures and receives daily instructions on work.
  • Provides consistent communication to management to evaluate patient/family status, ensuring provided information and reports clearly describe progress. Attends regular staff meetings, trainings and other meetings as requested.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Organizational Requirements:

Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.

Adventist Health participates in E-Verify. Visit https://adventisthealth.org/careers/everify/ for more information about E-Verify. By choosing to apply, you acknowledge that you have accessed and read the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work notices and understand the contents therein.

title: Barrick - Sr. Exploration Geologist, Cortez District
description:
Position Description:

Would you like to have a career with a collaborative, diverse, and dynamic mining company? We have an exciting opportunity for you!

Barrick is seeking an engaged, Senior Exploration Geologist to support the identification and advancement of high-quality exploration opportunities across its portfolio. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the discovery of world-class ore bodies by supporting both desktop and field-based evaluations, including data compilation, geological modeling, and target generation.

The Senior Geologist will play a key role in shaping and advancing exploration opportunities at various stages of the pipeline. You will collaborate with talented, multidisciplinary exploration teams and technical leaders, contributing to exploration strategies while gaining exposure to a diverse range of geological settings and project types.

At Barrick, our vision is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and operating the best assets with the best people. We are committed to a safe work environment sending every person home safe and healthy every day and leaving a sustainable legacy on our host communities.

Responsibilities:

  • Generate, develop, and lead exploration programs across all stages of the exploration pipeline, with a primary focus on Project Generation and Target Delineation within the company’s Resource Triangle framework.

  • Execute and supervise field-based exploration programs, ensuring best practices in geological data collection and management, as well as strict compliance with safety standards and community relations requirements.

  • Participate with the Project Generation or New Opportunities (NEO) team in the evaluation of properties and/or advanced exploration projects representing opportunities for Tier 1 gold and/or copper discoveries.

  • Prepare internal and external written reports and technical visit presentations, as well as seasonal exploration progress and close-out reports, in both English and Spanish, including conclusions and recommendations.

  • Ensure the timely delivery of technical and geological information generated by exploration projects in accordance with Geoinformatics department standards and systems, and require appropriate reporting from technical site visits conducted by the Technical Team.

  • Maintain direct and timely communication with the Exploration Manager and/or Chief Geologist when technical support or specialized training is required for exploration projects, coordinating through the LATAM Technical Team as needed.

  • Coordinate with the Sustainability team to implement Health & Safety, Environmental, and Community Relations procedures at exploration projects, and monitor and verify compliance.

  • Ensure all required internal and external permits are obtained on time to support planned exploration programs.

  • Promote and support the dissemination of advances in geoscientific knowledge within the exploration team, organizing learning opportunities related to mineral system exploration.

  • Coordinate with Human Resources on people and talent management activities, including recruitment and selection, performance evaluations, development plans, coaching, and mentoring.

  • Stay informed and ensure appropriate communication to project teams regarding community, safety, health, environmental, quality, and risk-related matters as required.

  • Comply with and enforce the Barrick Code of Conduct, Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption Policy, and Human Rights Policy, ensuring internal awareness and adherence.

  • Comply with and enforce all company policies, regulations, and procedures, including Alcohol and Drugs, Discrimination and Harassment, and other mandatory Barrick standards.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Geology or related field required
  • Master's Degree or PhD in related field preferred
  • Minimum 8 years progressive experience with a strong emphasis in exploration, mineral economics, and leadership required
  • A strong foundation of fundamentals of geology, exploration procedures, business acumen, and commercial skills required
  • Ability to work within a team environment and possess excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills required
  • Broad knowledge of geology with experience across multiple terranes required
  • Broad experience across gold and copper deposit types required
  • Experience with a full range of targeting tools including, but not limited to geophysical, geochemical, remote sensing, and geologic field methods required
  • Ability to accurately develop complex 3D geologic models using Leapfrog required
  • Strong computer skills and proficient in ArcGIS and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Access) required
  • Excellent data and business analysis skills - ability to conduct detailed analysis, define milestones, and provide business logic and calculations required
  • Ability to deliver concise technical and business focused presentations and reports in simple to understand format to a broad audience of cross functional peers and stakeholders required
  • Organized, motivated self-starter with high standards expected of themselves and others required
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment required

What We Can Offer You

  • A comprehensive compensation package including a competitive medical, dental, and vision plan with national provider networks, a 401k retirement plan with employer contribution, paid time off, company-sponsored medical clinics, company match share purchase program, and much more!
  • Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team.
  • Opportunities to grow and learn with the industry colleagues are endless.
  • Access to a variety of career opportunities across the organization.

  • Barrick is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

    #LI JB1

title: Patient Navigator | Pediatrics Clinic
description:

This role will serve as a liaison between patients and different healthcare services, fostering trusting relationships focused on connection points within the local community and our system. The position will focus on helping patients overcome barriers to accessing healthcare services across multiple settings. The Patient Navigator's duties will be performed in a manner which promotes a multidisciplinary team concept and displays efficient and effective navigation of complex healthcare systems.

Schedule:

  • Full-time | 64 hours every two weeks | St. Cloud
  • Day shift | 8am-4:30pm | Monday - Friday

Pay & Benefits:

  • Starting pay begins at $22.85 per hour; exact wage determined by years of related experience
    • Pay range: $22.85-$34.25 per hour
  • Tuition reimbursement and college grant programs available
  • Full-time benefits: Medical, dental, PTO, retirement, employee discounts and more!

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • At least 3- 5 years of experience in navigating complex healthcare systems required
  • Awareness of barriers for uninsured and underinsured patients preferred

title: Regional Director (External Wholesaler)
description:
We are seeking dynamic and experienced Regional Directors (External Wholesalers) to join our team at John Hancock. The ideal candidates will be located in Minnesota and will play a crucial role in driving our sales strategies and expanding our customer base in the following region: Minnesota, Nebraska, North Dakota and South Dakota. As a Regional Director (External Wholesaler), you will be responsible for working with a robust team across functional competencies to assure we grow market share and achieve regional sales targets. This role requires a strategic thinker with excellent communication skills and a proven track record in sales. The position offers a sales based incentive with base salary and opportunities for performance bonuses.


Position Responsibilities:


  • Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed regional sales targets.
  • Identify new business opportunities and expand our customer base.
  • Work with the regional sales team to ensure a positive customer experience.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with other departments to support sales initiatives.
  • Provide regular reporting on sales performance, market trends, and forecasts.

How you will create impact:


This role is pivotal in driving the company's growth by expanding market share and enhancing customer engagement. The Regional Director's efforts will directly contribute to the achievement of sales targets and overall business success.


Required Qualifications:


  • 5+ years of experience in insurance/financial services sales.
  • Series 6, 63, Life, Health, and Variable licenses required - within 180 days from the start date.
  • Professional designations such as CLU, ChFC, CFP, CLTC, LUTCF are a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:
