title: Reimbursement Specialist
company: Ronald McDonald House Charities of Tampa Bay
description:
At Ronald McDonald House Tampa Bay, every family stays completely free of charge so they can focus on what matters most - being close to their child during medical care. Making that possible requires a strong and sustainable mix of funding, including charitable support, grants, partnerships, and reimbursement programs. The Reimbursement Specialist plays a critical role in securing and maximizing these essential resources, ensuring eligible services are reimbursed accurately and timely while identifying new opportunities to strengthen revenue. This position is ideal for someone who understands that diligent follow-up, accurate documentation, and successful collections do more than support the bottom line - they help keep our doors open and our services free for every family who needs us.

Employment Overview:
  • Reports to: Senior Accounting Manager
  • Classification: Full Time, Salary - Exempt. Part Time Option Available.
  • Benefits: 100% Employer Covered Medical, Dental, & Life Insurance. Options: Vision, Short Term Disability, and other Voluntary Benefits. 401(k) eligibility after 90 days.
  • Work Location: Tampa House- Business Office - 35 Columbia Dr, Tampa, FL 33606. Must have the ability to travel to our Tampa/St. Pete locations as needed.
  • Schedule: 40 hours a week, typically between 9:00am – 5:00pm Monday – Friday
  • Pay: $50,000 per year minimum - based on experience

Mission Statement:

At Ronald McDonald House Tampa Bay, we provide essential services that remove barriers, strengthen families and promote healing when children need healthcare.

Organization:

Ronald McDonald House Tampa Bay has been working to improve the health and well-being of children and their families since 1980. Our primary program, the Ronald McDonald House, provides a place to stay for families that have children receiving medical treatment at Tampa Bay hospitals and outpatient centers. There are 5 Ronald McDonald Houses in Tampa Bay, 3 located in St. Petersburg and 2 located in Tampa.

Position Overview:

The Reimbursement Specialist serves as Ronald McDonald House Tampa Bay's primary administrator and subject matter resource for Medicaid and other reimbursement programs. The position maximizes reimbursement revenue by managing eligibility reviews, preauthorization's, submissions, payment tracking, collections, denials, grievances, compliance, documentation, reporting, and process improvement. The role collaborates with healthcare providers, managed care organizations, transportation brokers, state agencies, and Ronald McDonald House chapters throughout Florida to expand reimbursement opportunities and cross-trains on key finance and business functions to support operational continuity. As organizational initiatives grow, this role may expand to encompass commercial and private health insurance reimbursement opportunities.

Schedule Flexibility: This position may be structured as either a full-time, benefited role working 40 hours per week or a reduced-schedule, part-time role working 30–35 hours per week. We welcome qualified candidates seeking either arrangement and will determine the final schedule collaboratively based on the selected candidate's availability and organizational needs. The position maintains a consistent Monday–Friday schedule during regular business hours.

Medicaid Reimbursement Administration:

  • Maintain compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements for nonprofit finance, including restricted funds and grant tracking aligned with donor intent.
  • Utilize and maintain organizational financial and administrative systems with accuracy and consistency; identify and escalate system issues or improvement opportunities to leadership.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned in support of the organization's financial and business operations.
  • Manage the complete reimbursement lifecycle for Medicaid lodging reimbursement programs.
  • Review referrals and stays for reimbursement eligibility.
  • Coordinate preauthorizations, authorization renewals, and required supporting documentation.
  • Submit accurate and timely reimbursement requests to approved payers and partners.
  • Monitor reimbursement status, payment activity, outstanding receivables, and aging trends; investigate denied, delayed, underpaid, or missing claims; and coordinate appeals, corrective action, and required follow-up.
  • Maintain reimbursement dashboards, aging reports, forecasts, complaint and grievance logs, resolution timelines, revenue trend analyses, and other performance reporting needed to identify barriers and support leadership decisions.
  • Monitor payer requirements and reimbursement process changes.

AHCA Complaints, Grievances & Escalation Management:

  • Monitor unresolved preauthorization and reimbursement requests. 
  • Prepare, submit, document, and track AHCA complaints and grievances. 
  • Maintain supporting evidence and case files for each escalation.
  • Coordinate communication with AHCA, managed care organizations, transportation brokers, and reimbursement partners.

Strategic Revenue Support: 

  • Identify and pursue opportunities to maximize reimbursement revenue, reduce missed or delayed collections, expand participation in additional Medicaid managed care plans, and strengthen other reimbursement or revenue-generating initiatives that support organizational sustainability.
  • Analyze reimbursement trends and performance data.
  • Support leadership with reimbursement forecasting, planning, and reporting.
  • Assist with legislative, advocacy, and strategic initiatives related to Medicaid reimbursement.
  • Foster productive relationships with hospitals, managed care organizations, transportation brokers, government agencies, and partner organizations.

Business Services Support & Operational Redundancy:

  • Support accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash receipt, vendor, and payment reconciliation activities.
  • Support financial recordkeeping, documentation management, and data verification.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
  • Cross-train on critical finance and operational functions to support business continuity during absences, transitions, or periods of increased workload.
  • Serve as a resource to internal departments requiring reimbursement, finance, reporting, or administrative support.

Compliance & Documentation:

  • Develop, maintain, and share reimbursement standard operating procedures, forms, workflows, training materials, supporting files, and other process documentation to promote consistent practices within Ronald McDonald House Tampa Bay and across collaborating chapters.
  • Ensure reimbursement and related finance records are accurate, complete, secure, properly retained, and audit-ready in accordance with payer, state, contractual, and organizational requirements.
  • Support reimbursement, finance, and compliance audits or reviews.
  • Train internal stakeholders on reimbursement-related processes and documentation expectations.
  • Identify recurring payer issues, reimbursement barriers, root causes, and workflow inefficiencies; recommend and implement corrective actions and process improvements that strengthen reimbursement and Business Services operations.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

Required Knowledge/Experience:

  • Associate degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Accounting, Public Administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be substituted.
  • Three years of progressively responsible experience in Medicaid billing, healthcare reimbursement, insurance claims administration, revenue cycle operations, accounts receivable, finance operations, government program administration, or a closely related area.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Strong organizational, follow-up, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, time-sensitive submissions, and deadlines with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments and with external partners.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive family, financial, and reimbursement information.
Preferred Knowledge/Experience:
  • Experience working with Florida Medicaid Managed Care Organizations (MCOs) (e.g., Sunshine Health, Simply Healthcare, Humana Healthy Horizons) and medical logistics/transportation brokers (e.g., Modivcare, Access2Care).
  • Experience with AHCA complaint processes, managed care grievances, claim appeals, and escalation management.
  • Experience coordinating statewide initiatives, coalitions, or external partnerships.
  • Nonprofit experience, preferably in healthcare, human services, or family-support organizations.

Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Analytical skills and the ability to identify reimbursement discrepancies, determine root causes, analyze financial and performance data, and translate findings into practical recommendations, forecasts, and actionable insights for organizational leadership.
  • Ability to develop, document, and consistently apply efficient workflows, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Ability to remain seated or standing for extended periods and use standard office equipment and technology.
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

PLEASE NOTE: Management reserves the right to change or otherwise modify the functions of this job to meet the needs of the company. Additional duties may also be assigned. Consideration will be given to make reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. The probationary period is 90 days. A review will be conducted by the direct supervisor at 90 days and 1 year; yearly review thereafter with salary consideration.

The successful candidate will be required to meet our pre-employment background screening requirements.

title: Floor Supervisor
description:
Primary Accountability

The Floor Supervisor is responsible for smooth patient flow, access, and the direct supervision of the clinical support staff on the floor during daily operations in the health center.

Description of Primary Responsibilities

  1. Provides support and floor supervision to departmental staff.
    1. Serves as a system matter expert and mentor to the team regarding workflows, procedures, and policies. Assists staff with problem resolution and critical thinking.
    2. Provides and/or ensures employees receive instruction/training needed to successfully complete their assigned job responsibilities while ensuring compliance with training plan.
    3. Provides on-the-job training and recommends remediation to managers when necessary.
    4. Recommends workflow and procedure changes based on observations from the floor.
    5. Gives real time feedback and praise while on the floor.
    6. Addresses staff out of compliance with policy (e.g., dress code). Communicates with Supervisor for higher level follow up with staff.
    7. Gives feedback to Supervisor to aid in effective performance evaluations, and coaching and counseling.
  2. Responsible for facilitating efficient patient flow by coordinating the front and back office and ancillary services throughout the health center.
    1. Functions as a Patient Flow Master by continuously monitoring patient flow.
    2. Is physically on the floor rounding to ensure staff follows operational workflows and remains productive and focused on excellent customer service at all times.
    3. Utilizes the dashboard and other metric tools to ensure adequate staffing is assigned based on real time patient flow needs to reduce wait times and increase patient satisfaction.
    4. Makes real time staffing adjustments accordingly based on operational needs.
    5. Ensures there is communication and coordination between the front office and back office to support patient flow throughput.
    6. Validates that scrubbing of appointments is being completed correctly as this supports patient readiness.
    7. Assists with the initial and annual skills/competency assessments.
  3. Conducts continuous rounding on the floor, within the health center, to ensure compliance with OSHA, and/or accrediting bodies, regulatory agencies, and infection control guidelines.
    1. Addresses workflow issues in real time and reports trends to supervisor.
    2. Ensures daily/weekly and monthly quality controls are accurately completed.
    3. Ensures sterilization process is completed daily and sufficient instruments are available and readily accessible for patient flow.
    4. Ensures weekly and monthly In-house medication inventories are completed and sufficient in-house medications available for patient needs.
    5. Ensures supplies, medication, forms, and equipment are ordered and in stock.
    6. Ensures monthly exam room checklists are completed.
  4. Assists with handling patient complaints including assisting the patient with a viable solution to the problem.
  5. Responsible for adhering to the Attendance and Absenteeism Policy, recognizing that regular attendance is considered an essential function of all FHCN positions. Absenteeism is not being at work or failing to attend a paid workshop, training, or event unless the absence is protected by law.
  6. Ability to present to and work at any FHCN location, both at the beginning of a shift or during a shift, based on business need.
  7. Performs other duties as assigned.

Description of Primary Attributes

General Development:

  1. Requires significant organizational skills, to manage and direct the activities of one or more functional areas of the organization.
  2. Job duties require the ability to provide leadership and motivation to others.
  3. Job responsibilities require individual development of priorities for effective performance of duties, including re-prioritization in response to changes in circumstances.
  4. Ability to devise effective solutions to situations encountered based on the general goals. Duties require drawing conclusions using inference and logic, which may be different than the conclusions that could be drawn by others and objectives of the function.
  5. Have a minimum credit score of 650.

Professional & Technical Knowledge:

Effective June 1, 2026, all individuals hired into the role must:

  1. Possesses work-related skills at a higher level than completion of high school, including formal written and verbal communications skills, computational and computer skills, mathematical, and technical skills.
    1. Have proof of completion of high school with a minimum overall GPA of 2.5 or completion of General Educational Development (GED) with a minimum overall score of 162.5, and health care-related knowledge, typically obtained through on-the-job experience.
    2. If an individual has completed a degree at a higher level than required by the role and had a stronger GPA in that program, they may provide proof of GPA from that degree in lieu of the high school diploma.
  2. Two years of professional growth that demonstrates the acquisition of progressively greater responsibility or significant contributions to projects and initiatives that demonstrate leadership skills.

Technical Skills:

  1. Ability to prepare more complex documents in Microsoft Word, including creating tables, charts, graphs, and other elements.
  2. Ability to use Microsoft Excel to analyze data, including the use of formulas, functions, lookup tables, and other standard spreadsheet elements.
  3. Ability to develop sophisticated presentations in Microsoft PowerPoint, including the use of embedded objects, transitions, and other elements.

Licenses & Certifications: Requires Medical Assistant/LVN Certification.

Communications Skills:

  1. Job duties require the employee to effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, their opinions, and extrapolations of information they collect and synthesize/analyze.
  2. Responsible for the resolution of conflicts that may arise because of disagreements between employees, between employees and customers/clients, or with the public, other legal entities, or governmental authorities.
  3. Compiles, analyzes, and prepares information in an effective written form, including correspondence, reports, articles, or other documentation.
  4. Effectively conveys technical information to non-technical audiences.

Physical Demands: The physical demands described in this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit and type. The employee frequently is required to stand or walk; and occasionally squat, kneel, and reach above and below shoulder height to lift and/or move items up to 20 pounds.

Min Hourly Rate: $26.54

Max Hourly Rate: $31.85

title: Oxnard - American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor/ Instructor Trainer
description:
About Us

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

Note: The Instructor Trainer's teaching methods and content must comply with American Red Cross requirements.

License / Certification

  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Certification, r.25 — Required if you are looking for an instructor role
  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Trainer Certification, r.25 — Required﻿ ﻿if you are looking for an instructor trainer role
  • American Red Cross BLS Instructor Trainer Certification — Preferred
  • American Heart Association BLS Instructor Certification — Preferred
  • Other equivalent Instructor Trainer certifications may be considered where an approved bridging pathway is available; we can provide bridging guidance.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.
  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.
  • Monitor and evaluate candidate progress to ensure proficiency.
  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with CPR and AED training best practices.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

  • Current American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor certification.
  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to demonstrate proper CPR and AED techniques.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.
  • Work may be performed primarily during weekends.

Salary and Benefits

description:

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.

Requirements

  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer


Cosa facciamo in dAirect


Il modo in cui scopriamo informazioni, prodotti e luoghi online sta cambiando.


Sempre più persone non cercano più soltanto su Google: chiedono direttamente a ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity e agli altri AI assistants dove andare, cosa scegliere e cosa comprare.


In dAirect stiamo costruendo la soluzione che permette a hotel e hospitality business di essere trovati, compresi e raccomandati dagli AI assistants.


Ma non stiamo costruendo semplicemente un analytics tool.


Stiamo sviluppando un sistema agentico che osserva, comprende e agisce sul web: monitora come brand e strutture vengono rappresentati dagli AI assistants, raccoglie e interpreta dati provenienti dal web e dagli LLM e utilizza agenti autonomi per migliorare progressivamente la loro presenza digitale, sia on‑site che off‑site.


Questo significa lavorare su problemi di web agents, LLM orchestration, web intelligence, data pipelines, crawling, retrieval, automazione e infrastruttura distribuita.


La nostra ambizione è costruire il layer tecnologico che collega business, web e AI assistants nella nuova generazione di search e discovery.


Chi cerchiamo


Cerchiamo un Senior Full Stack Engineer con 5–7 anni di esperienza, con un forte orientamento a backend, infrastruttura e DevOps, ma con solide competenze full stack.


Cerchiamo una persona che abbia esperienza in startup e che sia abituata a lavorare in contesti veloci, poco definiti e in continua evoluzione.


Una persona che:



  • prende ownership di quello che costruisce;

  • è estremamente curiosa e aggiornata sulle nuove tecnologie;

  • sa quando è necessario alzare la qualità e quando invece è più importante spedire velocemente;

  • è affidabile, precisa e non superficiale;

  • sa muoversi nel caos senza diventare caotica;

  • porta ordine nei problemi complessi;

  • non aspetta semplicemente i task, ma identifica problemi e propone soluzioni.


In poche parole: una persona che voglia spingere il prodotto e la tecnologia insieme al CTO e a tutto il team tech.


Il ruolo


Lavorerai direttamente con CTO e team tech sul core della piattaforma.


Svilupperai funzionalità end-to-end, lavorando principalmente su backend, architettura, infrastruttura e sistemi distribuiti, ma contribuendo anche al frontend quando necessario.


Avrai un ruolo attivo nelle decisioni tecniche e nella definizione di come costruiamo e facciamo evolvere il prodotto.


Non cerchiamo qualcuno che aspetti di sapere esattamente cosa fare.


Cerchiamo qualcuno che veda un problema, lo capisca, proponga una soluzione e la porti in produzione.


Cosa farai



  • Svilupperai funzionalità full stack end-to-end.

  • Progetterai e svilupperai API e servizi backend scalabili.

  • Lavorerai su sistemi data-intensive, workflow AI e integrazioni con LLM.

  • Lavorerai su database, sistemi asincroni e architetture event-driven.

  • Gestirai deployment, monitoring, observability e infrastruttura cloud.

  • Migliorerai performance, affidabilità e sicurezza della piattaforma.

  • Contribuirai alle decisioni architetturali e tecnologiche.

  • Migliorerai tooling, developer experience e processi del team.

  • Porterai nuove tecnologie e approcci che possano migliorare velocità e qualità di sviluppo.


Stack


TypeScript · React · Next.js · Vite · Node.js · Hono · Python · Bun · Turborepo · PostgreSQL · Redis · RabbitMQ · Kubernetes · Google Cloud · Pulumi · Prometheus · Grafana


Non è necessario conoscere tutto lo stack. Ci interessa soprattutto la capacità di imparare rapidamente e capire quando e perché utilizzare una determinata tecnologia.


Cosa cerchiamo



  • 5–7 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software.

  • Esperienza in startup.

  • Ottima conoscenza di TypeScript / JavaScript.

  • Forte esperienza backend e con sistemi in produzione.

  • Esperienza con database, API, caching e sistemi asincroni.

  • Esperienza con cloud, deployment e infrastruttura.

  • Capacità di lavorare autonomamente su problemi complessi e poco definiti.

  • Forte senso di ownership e responsabilità.

  • Mentalità pragmatica e orientata all’impatto.

  • Curiosità tecnica e voglia di sperimentare continuamente.

  • Capacità di bilanciare qualità, velocità e technical debt.


Nice to have



  • Kubernetes e Infrastructure as Code.

  • Observability e monitoring.

  • Sistemi event-driven e message queues.

  • AI / LLM integration.

  • Data pipelines e scraping.

  • Performance e scalabilità.

  • Esperienza nel costruire prodotti da zero.

  • Side projects, open source o progetti personali tecnici.


Come lavoriamo


Siamo una startup: non tutto sarà definito e spesso dovrai lavorare su problemi ancora poco chiari.


Ci aspettiamo che tu sappia trasformare un problema in una soluzione concreta, prendendo decisioni e assumendoti la responsabilità del risultato.


Non vogliamo né costruire tutto come se fossimo una grande enterprise, né accumulare continuamente debito tecnico perché \"siamo una startup\".


Cerchiamo persone che sappiano capire quando serve qualità, quando serve velocità e perché.


Il contesto può essere caotico. Il tuo modo di lavorare no.


Cosa offriamo



  • Full-time

  • RAL: €50.000–€60.000

  • Stock options

  • Hybrid / remote-friendly

  • Sede: Milano

  • Forte autonomia e ownership

  • Contatto diretto con CTO e team tech

  • Possibilità di influenzare concretamente prodotto e tecnologia


Entrerai in una fase molto early, con la possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla costruzione del prodotto, dell'architettura e del team tecnico.


Non cerchiamo qualcuno che voglia semplicemente lavorare su un prodotto. Cerchiamo qualcuno che voglia costruirlo insieme a noi.

title: Commercial Finance Lead
description:
Ejerskab af tallene. Sparring om strategien. Vækst med forretningen.

**Mover er en profitabel scale-up inden for logistikteknologi med hovedkontor i København og IKEA som medejer og global partner. Vi har opbygget et solidt finansielt fundament hvor bogføring, rapportering og den daglige drift ligger hos en stærk ekstern partner. Den interne finansfunktion skal derfor skabe værdi gennem FP&A, kommerciel sparring og styring af ekstern partner.

Vi søger en skarp og ambitiøs finansprofil, der vil have ansvaret for finansområdet tæt på CEO og den øvrige ledelse. Du får to Junior Finance Controllers, du skal udvikle, og en ekstern partner, du skal styre. Rollen er bevidst holdt lille, men eksponeringen er stor, og funktionen forventes at vokse i takt med forretningen.

**Om rollen

**Du er bindeleddet mellem tallene og beslutningerne. Den eksterne partner står for rapportering, controlling og månedsafslutning. Du har ansvaret for indsigten, for antagelserne bag og for dialogen med ledelse og bestyrelse. Du omsætter data til retning og tør tage diskussionen, når retningen skal udfordres.

Du arbejder direkte med CEO og den øverste ledelse fra dag ét. Lander vi de kommercielle sager, vi har i pipelinen, vokser funktionen, og du er først i køen til at vokse med den.

**Dine opgaver

**

  • Ansvar for forecasts, budgetter og de forretningsmæssige antagelser bag
  • Ansvar for likviditet, cash flow og treasury i samarbejde med den eksterne partner
  • Kommerciel sparring med CEO og ledelsen om prissætning, investeringscases, enhedsøkonomi og performance
  • Skabe P&L-transparens, der forankrer finansiel indsigt og performance i forretningen
  • Styring af eksterne partnere i Danmark og i udlandet, så tallene er rigtige og kommer til tiden
  • Udvikling af to Junior Finance Controllers ved at sætte retning, følge op og korrigere adfærd
  • Ansvar for transfer pricing og den finansielle opsætning af vores nye selskaber i udlandet i tæt samarbejde med vores revisorer hos BDO

**Om dig

**Vi søger en dygtig og dreven finansprofil, der er klar til at træde ind i en rolle med bredt ansvar. Vi lægger mere vægt på adfærd end på cv, så du passer godt ind, hvis du:

  • Er arbejdsom og selv tager initiativ
  • Søger åben dialog og tør tage diskussioner frem for at give ret
  • Kan lede mennesker ved at sætte retning, følge op og korrigere adfærd
  • Selv har haft ansvaret for finansielle processer, ikke kun rådgivet om dem
  • Kan balancere operationelle opgaver med strategisk overblik
  • Kommunikerer indsigter klart til ledelse og beslutningstagere (erfaring med kommunikation på direktions- og bestyrelsesniveau er et stærkt plus, men ikke et krav)
  • Trives i spændingsfeltet mellem C-suiten og den øvrige ledelse
  • Kommunikerer overbevisende på både dansk og engelsk

Fagligt har du sandsynligvis en relevant kandidatgrad inden for finans, økonomi eller lignende og solid erfaring fra finans eller FP&A. Erfaring fra en scale-up eller et operationelt komplekst miljø er et plus. Det samme er erfaring med at automatisere finansielle arbejdsgange med agentisk AI.

**Det tilbyder vi

**

  • Kommercielt ansvar tæt på den øverste ledelse og bestyrelse
  • En rolle, hvor din indsigt påvirker retning, prissætning og investeringer
  • En funktion, der kan vokse med forretningen, og du med den
  • En stærk kultur bygget på sunde skandinaviske værdier, samarbejde og ambition
  • Konkurrencedygtig løn med en fast og en variabel del

**Movers værdier

**

  • Lead with integrity – We believe that integrity is a reciprocal value – it means treating others as we wish to be treated. With respect, honesty, and sound ethics.
  • Be accountable – We embrace freedom in decision-making, initiative, and actions while accepting full responsibility for outcomes and results.
  • Push boundaries – We challenge norms, innovate, and move fast to drive changes to continuously improve things for everyone affected by our products and services.
  • Play, as a team – We are serious without taking ourselves too seriously, and balance having fun with achieving great things, together.

**Klar til at rykke?

**Hvis ovenstående giver dig energi og du er klar til at påtage dig en central rolle i en voksende international virksomhed, så hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

title: SENIOR SCHEDULER

title: Montgomery - American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor/ Instructor Trainer
description:
About Us

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

Note: The Instructor Trainer's teaching methods and content must comply with American Red Cross requirements.

License / Certification

  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Certification, r.25 — Required if you are looking for an instructor role
  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Trainer Certification, r.25 — Required﻿ ﻿if you are looking for an instructor trainer role
  • American Red Cross BLS Instructor Trainer Certification — Preferred
  • American Heart Association BLS Instructor Certification — Preferred
  • Other equivalent Instructor Trainer certifications may be considered where an approved bridging pathway is available; we can provide bridging guidance.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.
  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.
  • Monitor and evaluate candidate progress to ensure proficiency.
  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with CPR and AED training best practices.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

  • Current American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor certification.
  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to demonstrate proper CPR and AED techniques.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.
  • Work may be performed primarily during weekends.

Salary and Benefits

Salary: $30.00 - $40.00 per teaching hour, commensurate with experience and length of working relationship with ALLCPR.

Additional Compensation: $10.00 per enrolled student. (Only for instructor trainer role)

Job Classification: 1099 Contractor or Part-Time Employee (Certain States).

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule.

Schedule

  • Day shift.
  • Weekend/Weekday availability.

Ability to Commute / Relocate

Location: Local area as per job post

Reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (Required).

Experience

  • Teaching: 2+ years (Preferred).

Job Type

  • Part-time
  • Contract

Work Location: In person

title: Barkhausen Institut gGmbH: PhD Position in Secure and Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning / AI (m/f/ (Machine Learning Engineer)
description:
The Barkhausen Institut performs research on the latest hardware, software and communication technologies and demonstrates their application in tomorrow's society. Our goal is to build a flexible and trustworthy IoT platform based on reliable electronics and secure communication methods.

The Trustworthy Data Processing group at the Barkhausen Institut is seeking a highly motivated candidate to pursue a PhD in secure and privacy-preserving machine learning and AI.

At the earliest possible date we are looking for a

PhD Position in Secure and Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning / AI (m/f/d)

The position will initially be filled for a period of 2 years and will be remunerated in line with TV-L E-13. The position aims at supporting further academic qualification (e.g. PhD).
Your responsibilities will include

- Conduct research in secure and privacy-preserving machine learning and AI towards a PhD.

- Contribute to collaborative research projects, including preparing project deliverables and reports.
- Present research findings at conferences, workshops, and project meetings.
We expect the following

- Programming experience and an interest in developing research prototypes;

- Very good written and spoken English skills

- Privacy-enhancing technologies, such as homomorphic encryption, trusted execution environments, and secure computation;
- Machine learning and AI

You are interested, but you don’t think you meet all the requirements of the job posting? Then you should know: We don’t hire resumes, we hire people. We are looking for potential and want to actively foster it. That’s why we encourage you to apply!
What we provide

If you have passion for new technologies and the desire to develop the connected world of tomorrow with us, we are looking for you.

Life and science are compatible at our institute. We offer a range of recognised family-friendly measures, such as part-time work, mobile working and flexible working hours that take family needs into account. We also offer support for arriving in Dresden (all formalities, apartment etc.).

title: Senior Build Reliability Engineer
description:
Why Castelion, Why Now

Castelion is moving incredibly fast to develop and deliver advanced defense systems at a time when execution matters more than ever. We believe focus, ownership, and excellence are decisive advantages - and we're building a world-class team to turn bold ideas into real capability.

This is a rare opportunity to join at an early stage, where you'll have significant ownership, collaborate with exceptional teammates, and make a direct, measurable impact on our mission and the future of the company - regardless of your function.

About Castelion

Castelion is bringing a new approach to defense development and production: one that focuses on short, iterative design cycles, rapid testing in development, and modern commercial manufacturing strategies for production at scale. We design, build, and test next generation weapon systems to give America and its Allies a definitive edge in defense capabilities.

Senior Build Reliability Engineer

The Senior Build Reliability Engineer will lead initiatives aimed at continuous improvement in the reliability and quality of our products. You will develop and implement internal processes and manufacturing software to optimize development and production workflows and ensure high-quality output. You will guide teams in conducting reliability assessments, implementing preventative measures, and addressing quality issues through root cause analyses and corrective actions, all while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities

Design and Manufacturing

  • Work closely with design, manufacturing, and operations teams to ensure reliability and quality considerations are integrated into all phases of the product lifecycle.
  • Participate in Design and Build Reviews to ensure design for manufacturability and inspectability.
  • Reviews and approves Process Plans, specifications, and build documentation for completeness, accuracy, regulatory compliance, and quality objectives.
  • Support the development and implementation of internal processes and manufacturing software to optimize production efficiency, product quality, and change control.
  • Facilitate the engineering change control process (ECR/ECO) with a focus on traceability and impact alignment to maintain clean configuration genealogy.

Inspection and Test Process

  • Ensure appropriate test validation methods and inspection techniques have been considered to validate design and manufacturing processes.
  • Develop and implement Quality Control Processes, and Standards, and Planning, ensuring compliance with internal and external standards and regulations.
  • Design or procures new measurement equipment as required to achieve required inspections with maximum efficiency.
  • Validates measurement and tests methods using process capability and measurement systems analysis (MSA) statistical tools. Propose solutions to remove the need to verify product conformance through measurement, e.g. poka-yoke.

Evaluates and analyzes production quality landscape

  • Utilize reliability and quality data to generate reports, identify trends, and recommend improvements to enhance product and process reliability and performance.
  • Uses data to make landscape transparent and drive project prioritization. Responsible for ensuring that issues related to product reliability are primary focus.
  • Drives achievement of quality targets through a review hierarchy with appropriate levels of management.

Corrective Action Preventive Action

  • Utilize reliability and quality data to generate reports, identify trends, and recommend improvements to enhance product and process reliability and performance.
  • Leverage tools like FMEA and statistical analysis to identify and prevent quality and reliability issues.
  • Leads, facilitates, and participates in root cause investigations and ensure appropriate action to prevent recurrence.

Nonconformance Management

  • Support review of all nonconformance conditions for adequate resolution and rationale prior to closure.
  • Lead containment functions to include impact and risk analysis.
  • Oversee control of all non-conforming hardware

Compliance and Training

  • Support efforts to implement and adhere to Quality Management System policies and other regulatory requirements.
  • Facilitate creation of training plans and materials for technician and inspector competency.
  • Develop training materials and provide support to end-users to ensure effective utilization of manufacturing and management system software.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing product reliability and risk mitigation.

Requirements and Skills

  • Minimum 4+ years in reliability and/or quality engineering role

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in aerospace or defense/government programs is highly desirable.
  • Experience with implementation and enhancement of Manufacturing Enterprise Software.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical information to diverse audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of implementing effective solutions to complex reliability and quality challenges.
  • Experience supporting diverse, high volume, production teams during production ramp-up.
  • Knowledge of quality tools such as Lean principles, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis and Corrective Action, Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Metrology, Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Control Plans, and various problem-solving approaches.
  • Dedicated to adopting a Lean approach to quality without compromising safety or reliability.

Leadership Qualities

  • Bias to Action and Creative Problem Solving. Desire and experience questioning assumptions in ways that lead to break through ideas that are ultimately implemented. Successfully bring in applicable processes/concepts/materials from other industries to achieve efficiency gains. Ability to personally resolve minor issues in development without requiring significant support.
  • High Commitment, High Initiative. A successful candidate will have a genuine passion for Castelions mission and consistently look for ways to contribute to the companys technical goals and prevent hardware blockers. Ability to work in a fast paced, autonomously driven, and demanding atmosphere. Strong sense of accountability and integrity.
  • Clear Communicator. Proactively communicates blockers. Trusted in previous roles to be voice of company with regulators, suppliers, gate keepers and customers. Capable of tactfully managing relationships with stakeholders to achieve company-desired outcomes without compromising relationships. Emails, IMs and verbal interactions are logical, drive clarity, and detailed enough to eliminate ambiguity.

ITAR Requirements

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

All employees are granted long-term stock incentives as part of their employment at Castelion. All employees receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental insurance, and the company offers four weeks of paid time off per year.

Castelion offers a generous benefits package. Please refer to the bottom of our Careers page for more details.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

This position may require access to classified information or restricted U.S. Government sites, systems, or information, as determined by the Company and/or applicable U.S. Government requirements. If the position is so designated, your employment in the role may be contingent upon your ability to obtain and maintain the required U.S. Government security clearance or other government authorization, and to satisfy any citizenship or other eligibility requirements imposed by applicable law, regulation, executive order, or government contract requirements. title: Electrical Manufacturing NPI Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Electrical Manufacturing New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineer to lead the manufacturing readiness and transfer for our most complex data center networking equipment, including high-speed switches, routers, and optical transport gear. This role requires deep technical expertise in high-speed signal integrity (SI), high-density electronics, exceptional cross-functional leadership, and a proven track record of successfully bringing multiple high-volume, high-quality products from design concept to mass production within aggressive data center deployment schedules.

Who You’ll Work With

As an Electrical NPI Engineer, you will partner with the HW/Mech/Thermal Engineering team on new product development, manufacturing readiness for the high performance network equipment.

What You’ll Do

You will serve as a critical link between Design, NPI, and full scale production, ensuring seamless transition through the product lifecycle. You will collaborate with cross functional teams to develop manufacturing processes, perform DFX review, manage product lifecycle activities, and provide sustaining support for the Arista products.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic NPI Leadership & Network Readiness:

  • Lead and own the entire manufacturing readiness process for complex, next-generation data center networking products (e.g., core/spine switches, specialized line cards).
  • Drive strategic planning for production line layout, capacity modeling, and capital equipment procurement, ensuring rapid ramp-up to support hyperscale demand.
  • Define and maintain the manufacturing technology roadmap, identifying and implementing new processes and equipment required for advanced packaging of ASICs/FPGAs, high-current components, and extremely high-layer count PCBs critical for signal integrity.

Advanced Design for X (DFX) & Optical/Thermal Solutions:

  • Function as the DFX expert, leading in-depth design reviews (DFM, DFA, DFT) and influencing product architecture to maximize yield, quality, and cost-efficiency at high volume.Drive specialized DFX considerations for high-speed interconnects (400G/800G+), optical modules (QSFP/OSFP), and sensitive RF paths.
  • Expertise in managing the manufacturing and testing of complex thermal solutions is essential, particularly advanced water cooling/liquid cooling systems (e.g., cold plates, manifolds) necessary for high-TDP network processors.
  • Drive component selection and supplier process audits with a focus on high-reliability components and precise clocking/timing circuits.

Process and Functional Test System Robustness (Specialized):

  • Architect and implement robust manufacturing processes and System-Level Functional Test (FT) strategies (e.g., traffic generation and analysis, full line-rate testing, high-temperature burn-in) that achieve Six Sigma-level quality standards.
  • Oversee the full lifecycle of Automated Test Equipment (ATE) development, ensuring precise measurement of BER (Bit Error Rate) and signal quality while aligning with fleet deployment requirements and system diagnostics.
  • Provide expert-level Sustaining Engineering guidance to resolve persistent, complex issues related to signal integrity degradation, optical module failures, and system-level performance loss post-launch.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in a manufacturing engineering role, with a minimum of 3 years dedicated to NPI and successful high-volume product launches specifically within the data center networking equipment industry (e.g., switches, routers, accelerators)
  • Technical Mastery:
    - Expert-level knowledge of high-layer count PCBA manufacturing, specialized soldering/rework for BGA/FC-BGA components, and process control for large-format electronic boards.
    - Proven track record in designing and qualifying production Functional Test (FT) systems and managing test coverage for complex network systems.
    - Demonstrated expertise in applying advanced statistical and quality tools (PFMEA, SPC, DOE).

Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Direct experience managing manufacturing processes at global Contract Manufacturers (CMs) or ODMs specializing in complex networking/telecom equipment.
  • Practical, hands-on experience in manufacturing and testing of systems incorporating water cooling, liquid cooling, or immersive cooling solutions for network processors.
  • Experience with specialized test equipment and analysis techniques related to Signal Integrity (e.g., TDR, VNA), optical power, and high-speed data transmission.
  • Fluency in advanced data analysis tools (e.g., JMP, Python for statistical analysis).
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders in a fast-paced technology environment.
  • Direct experience managing manufacturing processes at global Contract Manufacturers (CMs) or ODMs specializing in complex networking/telecom equipment.

Compensation information

The new hire base pay for this role has a salary range of $140,000 to $175,000 and in addition certain roles may also be eligible for discretionary Arista bonuses and equity. Arista offers different pay ranges based on work location, so that we can offer consistent and competitive pay appropriate to the market. The actual base pay offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and work location. US-based employees are also entitled to benefits including medical, dental, vision, wellbeing, tax savings and income protection. The recruiting team can share more details during the hiring process specific to the role and location.

title: Health Information Systems Developer/Analyst - Australia Fiji Health Program
description:
Fiji Program Support Platform (FPSP)

  • Long Term Role – commencing November 2026 to 31 December 2027
  • Reserved for Fiji Nationals only
  • Based in Suva, Fiji
  • Civil Service Band G Steps 1-4
  • Please apply online by submitting a cover letter addressing how you meet the selection criteria of this role and up-to-date comprehensive CV.


FPSP Overview:

The Fiji Program Support Platform (FPSP, or the ‘Platform’) is an Australian Government investment that contributes to the delivery of Fiji’s national development priorities, in line with Australia’s International Development Policy, the Fiji-Australia Vuvale Partnership and the Development Partnership Plan.

The Platform supports DFAT to deliver key bilateral programs, such as health, education, scholarships, social infrastructure, governance, climate and emergency preparedness and response. Platform activities identify and address climate risks, promote climate action, and gender equality, disability and social inclusion (GEDSI) across and beyond the sector programs.

The Platform has three functional outcomes:

  1. The Platform has delivered its sector program outcomes, including through supporting strategic coherence, planning, partnerships management, data and learning across the portfolio of investments.
  2. The Platform has prioritised gender equality and disability-inclusive development, and climate and disaster resilience, in its systems and practices. This includes how it undertakes sector programming and its engagement with selected Government of Fiji (GoF) agencies.
  3. The Platform administers timely and efficient programming that is: value for money; maximises use of local supply chains; and supports good governance and public diplomacy, effective decision making and risk management.


AFHP Overview:

The Fiji Program Support Platform (the Platform) implements over fifty percent of Australia’s bilateral development support to Fiji across a range of sector programs in education, health, Australia Awards, disaster response, cyclone recovery, social infrastructure and technical assistance to improve public sector governance in Fiji.

The Platform integrates cross-cutting themes, including gender equality, disability and social inclusion (GEDSI), climate and disaster resilience, across sectoral programs. In particular, the Platform seeks to strengthen program outcomes by better addressing the needs of targeted beneficiaries including those who are often marginalised.

The Australian Government is supporting Fiji’s health sector through the Australia Fiji Health Program (AFHP, the Program) working with the Ministry of Health and Medical Services (MHMS).

The program’s high-level End of Program Outcomes (EOPOs) are:

  • Improved systems are used by MHMS and health workers for evidence-based planning and resource allocation (workforce and budget), clinical care, digital health and medical supply chains; and
  • Targeted healthcare facilities equitably deliver improved primary health services, with a focus on sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) and non-communicable disease (NCD) services.


The funding for the program is approximately AUD 45million over 9 years (5 years, with an option to extend a further 4 years) and delivered through a range of activities (interventions) to achieve the program’s objectives where implementation modalities include technical advice, procurement of technical services and goods, minor works and infrastructure upgrades, capacity building and training support, support to Ministry led initiatives and innovations, and grants to civil society organisations (CSOs).

AFHP is designed to support the MHMS achieve the goals and objectives in its Strategic Plan and Annual Operational Plans, and AFHP’s workplans are targeted to support specific components of the Ministry’s plans.

Recent natural disasters such as cyclones, and public health emergencies in Fiji including COVID-19 have highlighted major challenges for pandemic preparedness and response during epidemics and other health emergencies. In this context, around 10% of program funding will be allocated for MHMS to assign to emerging needs and priorities as they arise. Funding may be allocated toward preparedness and responses to public health emergencies, or related opportunities for reform and innovation.

Position Summary:

The Health Information Systems (HIS) Developer/Analyst will design, develop and maintain software solutions and digital applications that support MHMS operational, administrative and service delivery needs.

Reporting to the Manager Applications and Projects (MHMS) and accountable to Project Manager Digital Health, the position will be based at the Digital Health Unit within the Ministry of Health and Medical Services (MHMS).

The HIS Developer/Analyst will prepare and implement action plans and provide technical and administrative support for system development, maintenance and optimisation activities across MHMS.

The role will work closely with MHMS IT team and relevant stakeholders to perform analytical, development, maintenance and system administration tasks. This includes tracking system issues and ensuring they are resolved in a timely manner, requirements gathering, software development and programming, system integration and interoperability, testing and quality assurance, system maintenance and support, documentation, training, compliance and security.

To succeed in this role, the candidate will need excellent application development, time management, stakeholder management and communication skills, and the ability to deliver results within agreed deadlines.

Key Responsibilities:

The position will achieve its purpose through the following key responsibilities:

title: Advanced Hardware Engineer
description:
Building Management Systems (BMS) are integrated solutions that monitor, control, and optimize critical building functions such as HVAC, lighting, energy management, security, and fire safety. Our business delivers intelligent automation technologies that help customers improve operational efficiency, reduce energy consumption, enhance occupant comfort, and support sustainability goals across commercial, industrial, and institutional facilities. Through innovative software, connected devices, and engineering expertise, we enable smarter, safer, and more sustainable buildings.

As an Advanced Hardware Value Engineer, you will drive the design and delivery of cost down initiatives without compromising quality, performance, or customer requirements. Working closely with engineering, and operations teams, you will analyze project specifications, optimize system designs, identify value-added alternatives, and support successful project execution. Your role is key to improve competitiveness, and ensuring efficient project delivery.

You will report directly to our Engineering Manager, and you’ll work out of our Northford, CT location on a Hybrid work schedule.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


• Drive cost reduction initiatives through product redesign, BOM optimization, component rationalization, and production process improvements
• Support product lifecycle management process: ECNs, EOL and product lifecycle transitions.
• Perform rigorous hardware testing and validation to ensure reliability and performance.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
• Stay current with emerging hardware technologies and industry trends to drive innovation.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across R&D, Offering Management, and Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) to ensure alignment, effective collaboration, and successful execution of business objectives.

YOU MUST HAVE


• 6+ years of experience in hardware design and development with a strong understanding of hardware design principles and methodologies
• Ability to assess engineering changes, evaluate component obsolescence impacts, and support the implementation of approved updates across projects and product portfolios
• Demonstrated experience in a highly regulated environment (e.g., building automation, aerospace, medical devices, automotive, or industrial controls).
• Proven track record of driving cost reduction initiatives through BOM optimization, component rationalization, and production process improvements, delivering measurable savings.
• Experience in hardware testing and validation to ensure product performance and reliability.
• Ability to provide technical guidance and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.


WE VALUE


• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
• Proven track record of successful hardware design projects and leadership in hardware engineering with measurable impact on product cost reduction.
• Strong understanding of industry standards and best practices.
• Experience mentoring junior engineers and leading hardware design initiatives.
• Knowledge of emerging hardware technologies and passion for continuous learning and innovation.

title: Advanced AI Software Engineer
description:
As an Advanced AI Software Engineer at Honeywell, you will design, develop, deploy, and own advanced AI/ML and Generative AI capabilities that power enterprise software applications and products. You will apply deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, and software engineering to build secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions.

You will provide technical leadership across the AI software development lifecycle, from architecture and experimentation through evaluation, deployment, observability, optimization, and production support. You will collaborate closely with software, product, data, cloud/platform, cybersecurity, and architecture teams to translate complex business requirements into robust AI-powered solutions.

You will report directly to our Director of Engineering, and you’ll work out of our Phoenix, Arizona location on a hybrid work schedule.

Note: For the first 90 days, new hires must be prepared to work onsite 100% M-F.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, develop, and deploy production-grade applications and software platforms using Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and agentic AI technologies.
  • Design and implement advanced architectures, prompt and context-management strategies, embeddings, vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, reranking, and knowledge-retrieval pipelines.
  • Build AI agents and multi-step AI workflows, including tool/function calling, orchestration, memory/context management, and integration with enterprise applications and data sources.
  • Optimize AI workloads for latency, throughput, scalability, token consumption, infrastructure utilization, and cost.
  • Design and implement cloud-native AI solutions and integrate AI services with existing enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and software architectures.
  • Provide technical leadership in architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, technical trade-off analysis, and engineering best practices.
  • Drive engineering standards for software quality, automated testing, CI/CD, security, scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate business problems into technically feasible AI solutions and measurable outcomes.
  • Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on AI/ML architecture, software engineering practices, troubleshooting, and production deployment.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 4+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, including designing, developing, deploying, and supporting AI/ML and Generative AI solutions in production environments.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with modern AI/ML technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, agentic AI prompt/context engineering, embeddings, vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, Transformers, and AI/ML frameworks.
  • 4+ years of experience architecting and delivering production AI/ML applications, including APIs/microservices, cloud deployment, model/LLM evaluation, automated testing, observability, performance optimization, security, scalability, and cross-functional technical delivery.
  • 5+ years of software engineering/programming experience, with strong hands-on proficiency in Python and experience with at least one additional programming language such as C++ or Java, developing scalable, maintainable, production-quality software.


WE VALUE

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced experience with AI/ML frameworks and ecosystems such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with enterprise-grade vector databases and search technologies such as Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with Azure AI services/Azure AI Foundry and/or Google Gemini/Vertex AI and cloud-based AI infrastructure.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience building automated deployment pipelines using CI/CD, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.
  • Experience with AI observability, model/application telemetry, prompt and model versioning, evaluation pipelines, and production quality monitoring.
  • Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI security, data privacy, model risk, prompt-injection mitigation, content safety, and enterprise AI governance.

BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. title: Fire Sprinkler Technician
description:

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education, Training, Certifications:

  • HS Diploma or equivalent, required.
  • Advanced technical school training or related work experience, preferred.
  • Current Fire Sprinkler License, required.

Experience, Knowledge, Skill Requirements:

  • 3-5 years’ experience installing pipe systems and valves, required. 5+ years’ experience, preferred.
  • Must be able to work alone and as part of a team. Basic math skills, mechanical aptitude, problem solving skills, customer service skills, decision making skills, ability to multitask, ability to meet project schedules, ability to plan and organize, troubleshooting skills, and the ability to train other is required.

Communication Skills:

  • Must have the ability to effectively read, write and communicate in English with employees and customers.

Systems and Software Skills:

  • Ability to operate a computer, tablet and read electronic blueprints required. Experience with SalesForce and Microsoft Office is preferred.

Other Qualifications:

PHYSICAL & WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform Essential Job Duties.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to bend, ascend and descend step stools, ladders and stairs, kneel, lift <50lbs, reach above and below shoulders, stand and walk for extended periods of time. Employee is required to see in color, close and far distances, peripheral, depth, and adjust focus. Employee will occasional be required to balance, crouch, drive, kneel, lift >50lbs, sit, stoop, twist, and work at heights.

Work Environment:

Frequent local travel and occasional regional and non-regional travel is required. Employee will frequently be required to work inside and outside in hot/cold temperatures and be exposed to loud noises, cramped quarters, dust, fumes and odors, standing on hard surfaces, and electrical hazards frequently. title: Harvest Supervisor
description:
Position Summary

The Harvest Supervisor oversees daily harvest operations to ensure product is harvested at the right time, quality, and volume while maintaining safe, efficient harvest practices. This position works closely with the Commodity Manager, growers, harvest crews, and other operational teams to execute the weekly harvest plan and respond to changing field and market conditions.

Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Coordinate closely with the Commodity Manager regarding harvest estimates, timing, quality, supply, and field conditions.
  • Execute the weekly harvest plan and make daily adjustments based on crop conditions, customer requirements, labor availability, and product quality.
  • Determine when, where, and how much product should be harvested each day.
  • Monitor harvest crews to ensure product is harvested, handled, and packed to Bonipak quality standards.
  • Communicate with growers regarding irrigation needs, field conditions, and harvest timing.
  • Inspect fields and evaluate quality, maturity, yield potential, and harvest readiness.
  • Monitor and record key production information, including:
    • Quality
    • Supply
    • Timing
    • Yield
    • Lost acres
    • Harvest performance
    • Field conditions
  • Identify potential quality or production issues early and communicate them to the appropriate personnel.
  • Work with harvest crews to improve efficiency, quality, and consistency.
  • Ensure harvest operations are conducted safely and that all company safety policies and procedures are followed.
  • Maintain clear and timely communication with Commodity Managers, growers, crew leadership, and other departments.
  • Assist with problem-solving and make operational decisions in the field when conditions change.

Yuma Responsibilities

  • Travel to Yuma, Arizona, to oversee leafy green harvest operations.
  • Approximately November through March, depending on seasonal needs.
  • Coordinate harvest activities and ensure the Yuma operation meets Bonipak standards for quality, timing, yield, safety, and efficiency.
  • Work closely with local growers, harvest crews, and Commodity Managers to execute the seasonal harvest plan.

Additional Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Coordinate re-pack activities with the Commodity Manager.
  • Print and deliver PTI stickers when needed.
  • Assist with other harvesting and production-related projects as assigned.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to harvest efficiency, quality, labor, and yield.

Qualifications

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish required.
  • Previous agricultural, harvesting, or produce industry experience preferred.
  • Strong ability to lead, develop, and manage people.
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple priorities and projects while meeting expected results.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Good problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions in a fast-paced field environment.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, weekends, and holidays as needed during harvest.
  • Valid California Driver's License with a clean driving record.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.

description:
Title: Park Management Planner
Department: Environment
Community: Iqaluit and Rankin Inlet

Closing date: November 6, 2026 @ 11:59 p.m. eastern time


An eligibility list may be created to fill future vacancies.

This employment opportunity is restricted to all Nunavut Inuit.

In accordance with the Government of Nunavut’s Nunavut-Wide Hiring Policy, this position is being advertised with a flexible community of work, as indicated above.

The Parks & Special Places (P&SP) Division is the lead Territorial agency responsible for the protection of natural and cultural heritage landscapes and recreation opportunities in Nunavut. The Division is also obligated under the Nunavut Agreement (NA) and the Umbrella Inuit Impact and Benefits Agreement for Territorial Parks (IIBA) to achieve its mandate by working closely with the Nunavut Joint Planning and Management Committee (NJPMC) and Community Joint Planning and Management Committees (CJPMCs).

Reporting to the Manager Park Planning and Establishment, the Park Management Planner is responsible for the establishment of a system of territorial parks and special places that are representative of Nunavut’s natural and cultural heritage. This position also develops and implements consultation strategies in support of parks planning and management initiatives, as well as coordinating or otherwise undertaking background and other research in support of park planning and management. These activities include travelling to communities of Nunavut, research and writing, fieldwork, community consultation, project management and budgeting.

The Park Management Planner’s main responsibilities are but are not limited to:

  • Acting as the Planning Team Leader for management planning projects.

  • Developing policy and legislative options for implementing management plans within the current and future classes of legislation.

  • Working to define opportunities for local training; and develops training plans to involve local residents in park planning and management.

  • Coordinating consultation processes involving communities; Inuit organizations and other stakeholders;

  • Preparing Briefing Notes, letters, and speaking notes for both Deputy Minister and Minister as required and responding to letters and general inquiries.

  • Reviewing development applications, environmental assessments and screening, and land use permit application reviews.

  • Working with Community Joint Planning and Management Committees (CNJPMC), Inuit Associations, Hunters and Trappers Association and other Inuit organizations and their designates to ensure compliance with specific NA/IIBA Articles in relation to P&SP.

  • Assisting in implementation of the IIBA and co-management activities.

  • Collaborating with Manager Park Program Development and Parks: Geospatial & Information Technology Specialist, to collect natural, cultural and environmental data for inclusion in departmental Geospatial Information database.

The knowledge, skills, and abilities required for this position are usually acquired through:

  • Undergraduate Degree in Environmental Studies, Landscape Architecture, Environmental Planning and Design, Physical Geography, or related field from a post-secondary institution.

  • At least two (2) years of wide-ranging experience in coordinating and organizing within one or more natural resource management or environmental planning agencies, specifically including park management planning and related tourism initiatives in a variety of both individual and committee settings.

In keeping with Article 6.3 of the Inuit Impact and Benefits Agreement (IIBA), special consideration will be given to candidates who fulfill these criteria:

  • Fluency in Inuktitut; and

  • Relevant northern experience.


The job entails travelling long distances by canoe, raft, boat or snow machines to reach worksites or walking long distances is required. Due to the Arctic’s harsh nature, these activities may be conducted under severe climatic conditions, and the incumbent must be in very good physical condition. Work may be done in field camps. This means being away from home for extended periods and irregular or long hours, including weekends. Considerable travel is required, perhaps a trip every 3-4 weeks.

The Official Languages of Nunavut are Inuktut, English and French. Applicants may submit their resume in any of the official languages of Nunavut. Fluency in more than one of Nunavut’s official languages would be considered an asset. Knowledge of Inuit communities, culture, land, Inuit Qaujimajatuqangit, Inuktut and experience working in a northern cross-cultural environment are also considered assets.

Acceptable combinations of education and experience may be considered for this position. We encourage you to apply if you have equivalent years of education and/or experience equal to the education and experience requirements listed above.

This is only a requirement for positions that require a satisfactory criminal record or vulnerable sector check.
