title: Senior Salesforce Engineer
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Salesforce Engineer to join our team full-time in Poland.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Salesforce Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

The company is on an incredible journey to become the universal symbol of trust. As the world's largest independent consumer review platform, they bring consumers and businesses together to foster transparency and improvement. With over 300 million reviews and 64 million monthly active users, the work we do together has a massive global impact, helping millions of people make better choices every day. In this role, you will join the Go To Market department within the Technology organization. You will be pivotal in delivering large strategic projects and change requests across the Salesforce platform, supporting commercial, marketing, ops, and customer service teams. You will work as a key link with the business-wide team responsible for the entire company’s Salesforce ecosystem, working with a proactive approach to operational excellence, system architecture, code quality, and process automation.

Responsibilities:

  • Salesforce Development & Architecture: Design, develop, and implement custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and platform automation (Flows)
  • Integrations & APIs: Build and maintain secure integrations between Salesforce and internal/external systems using REST, SOAP, and various API integration patterns
  • Declarative & Automated Solutions: Develop and maintain complex Salesforce Flows and process automations, balancing programmatic capabilities with declarative best practices for optimal performance and scalable architecture
  • Collaborative Engineering & Peer Review: Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, unit testing, and quality assurance alongside the cross-functional GTM Tech team and broader Salesforce engineering ecosystem
  • DevOps & Delivery: Apply change management via standard CI/CD pipelines, using version control tools (e.g., GitHub) and deployment workflows for smooth project delivery
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, system auditing evidence, and integration/customization processes
  • Team Growth & Support: Collaborate closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders, provide support and guidance to junior team members/administrators, and contribute to an inclusive knowledge-sharing environment

Requirements:

  • We are looking for engineers with a strong background in Salesforce development and apassion for high-quality, scalable code
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Developer & Administrator, specifically with Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Core Declarative & Programmatic Skills: Expert proficiency in Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and platform automation tools (Salesforce Flows)
  • Web Fundamentals: Solid understanding of web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Integrations & Security: Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP, Bulk) and understanding of Salesforce security models (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, roles)
  • Quality & QA: Strong focus on unit testing, debugging, and familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Provar)
  • DevOps & Developer Tools: Salesforce CLI, version control (GitHub), and CI/CD tools

Desirable:

  • Certifications: Advanced Administrator or Platform Developer, or System/Application Architect certifications are a strong plus
  • Exposure to Salesforce Community Cloud (Experience Cloud) or other collaboration platforms
  • Hands-on experience or familiarity with Agentforce
  • Knowledge of highly distributed system architectures and integration architecture patterns

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Flexibility: Enjoy flexibility – full remote working possibilities
  • Care: We've got you covered with company-paid premium medical package through Luxmed
  • Benefits: Access the MyBenefit cafeteria platform, allowing you to choose perks that best suit your lifestyle and needs

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

With delivery centers in Wrocław and Gdańsk, our 300+ professionals in Poland drive forward-thinking solutions for global clients. Join a community where collaboration sparks innovation—and your impact reaches millions.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

Teaching Equipment

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.

  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.

  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.

  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

  • Current American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor certification.
  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Principal Data Engineers at Mayo Clinic are expected to be subject matter experts in building ETL pipelines, working with heterogenous data using different technologies, and database design and optimizations. The data they work with are required to support a different analyses and applications that serve both internal and external partners. As the position requires strong data, technical, and functional skills, the right candidate must be able to understand business requirements, translate them into information needs, and implement those requirements using available data. The hire will be responsible for creating new data architecture, optimizing existing databases, designing data collection and flows for cross functional teams. The ideal candidate is an data engineer who has extensive experience working with clinical data and collaborating across diverse teams to ensure the data provided is accurate, the data pipelines reliable, and the resulting databases are fit for a variety of purposes.

The Principal Data Engineer will work with informaticists, clinicians, software engineers, and data scientists to serve as a subject matter expert in data engineering best practices and will ensure optimal data delivery architecture is consistent throughout ongoing projects. The position will also be responsible for the management of data related projects and oversee the tasks of other team members when relevant.

Core job duties:

  • Expert in data modeling concepts,
  • Responsible for designing, implementing, documenting and testing databases containing clinical data.
  • Leverage SQL, Python and other programming languages

  • Build ETL pipelines from varying data sources and technologies using cloud technologies such as Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure and implemented with Apache Airflow or similar products
  • Problem solving with the initiative to think critically to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Provide direction on best practices for data transformation, structure, and workflows.
  • Ability to effectively participate in multiple, concurrent projects
  • Research new and existing data sources in order to contribute to new development, improve data management processes, and make recommendations for data quality initiatives.

A Master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, mathematics, computer science, health science, or other analytical/quantitative and a minimum of five years of professional or research experience in data science

The successful candidate will need to have both technical and business background/experience along with strong leadership skills. Good written and oral communication skills are required. Deep expertise in the use of scientific computing and data management packages. Ability to prioritize, organize, and delegate various tasks on projects. Demonstrated initiative in administration, education (seminars, training), software development, and technical reports. Demonstrated success in project management and communication skills. Demonstrated ability to develop predictive and prescriptive models on large-scale datasets to address various business problems through leveraging advanced statistical modeling, machine learning, or data mining techniques. Demonstrated ability to provide consultative services at an institutional or enterprise level to departments/divisions and committees from any Mayo entity requesting assistance is preferred. Demonstrated application of several problem-solving methodologies, planning techniques, continuous improvement methods, project management methods, and analytical tools and methodologies (e.g. machine learning, statistical packages, modeling, etc.) required. Incumbent must have ability to independently manage a varied workload of projects with multiple priorities and stay current on healthcare trends and enterprise changes. Excellent interpersonal skills to include presentation, negotiation, persuasion, and written communications skills are required. Exceptional time management is required. In addition, requires excellent analytical skills, consulting skills, ability to identify and recommend solutions, advanced computer application skills and a commitment to customer service. Experience with data modeling and date exploration tools.

As a Senior Salesforce Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

As the world's largest independent consumer review platform, they bring consumers and businesses together to foster transparency and improvement.   • Salesforce Development & Architecture: Design, develop, and implement custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and platform automation (Flows)

Requirements:

  • We are looking for engineers with a strong background in Salesforce development and apassion for high-quality, scalable code

  • Core Declarative & Programmatic Skills: Expert proficiency in Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and platform automation tools (Salesforce Flows)

  • DevOps & Developer Tools: Salesforce CLI, version control (GitHub), and CI/CD tools

Desirable:

  • Certifications: Advanced Administrator or Platform Developer, or System/Application Architect certifications are a strong plus
  • Exposure to Salesforce Community Cloud (Experience Cloud) or other collaboration platforms
  • Hands-on experience or familiarity with Agentforce
  • Knowledge of highly distributed system architectures and integration architecture patterns

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door culture that values initiative and empowers its people to succeed
  • Fast-paced & agile environment: Be part of a dynamic, fast-moving organization that champions efficiency and innovation
  • Global exposure: Collaborate with international, cross-functional teams and contribute to large-scale initiatives
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Flexibility: Balance office and remote work to fit your rhythm
  • Care: Take advantage of our extensive benefits offering, aligned with the best market standards

The salary starts from 3700 Eur gross. The final salary depends on the previous experience and professional knowledge of the candidate.

The California Department of Public Health (CDPH) Office of Data Strategy is recruiting for a Clinical Informatics Specialist III’s to join an innovative team advancing CDPH’s enterprise data modernization efforts. The incumbent will apply advanced data engineering and informatics expertise within a cloud-native data environment (primarily Databricks, leveraging Apache Spark and Delta Lake for big-data processing and storage) to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and enterprise data marts that support public health program operations, analytics, and strategic decision-making.

The incumbent will serve as a core member of a cross-functional team, collaborating closely with data scientists, analysts, informaticians, and public health program partners to deliver high-quality, well-governed, and interoperable data products.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and enterprise data marts in Databricks using SQL, Python, and PySpark.

  • Supporting the development, implementation, and maintenance of enhanced public health surveillance and operational data systems.

  • Creating standardized, reusable data models and curated datasets that serve multiple programmatic and analytical use cases.

  • Improving interoperability and alignment across CDPH data systems and integrating solutions with local health jurisdictions (LHJs) and other partners.

  • Ensuring efficient, secure, and automated ingestion, transformation, storage, and distribution of data from diverse surveillance and non-surveillance sources.

  • Participating in complex data architecture, data modeling, and data quality assurance and improvement activities.

UCSF Institute for Global Health Sciences (IGHS) is dedicated to improving health and reducing the burden of disease in the world’s most vulnerable populations. It integrates UCSF expertise in all of the health, social, and biological sciences, and focuses that expertise on pressing issues in global health. IGHS works with partners in countries throughout the world to achieve these aims. IGHS seeks to improve health worldwide, especially in developing countries, through research that informs policy.

ODS collaborates with internal CDPH programs, Local Health Jurisdictions (LHJs), and external partners to ensure efficient data integration, governance, and quality. Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Hands-on experience supporting AWS production environments, particularly IAM, EC2, S3, and CloudWatch
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including connectivity, routing, and security groups
  • Experience investigating production incidents using logs and metrics, troubleshooting technical issues, and implementing changes safely
  • Familiarity with Git, peer review, change approvals, incident management, service request workflows, and monitoring or alerting tools
  • Foundational SQL skills and the ability to read and safely modify scripts in at least one language, such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience providing proactive customer or stakeholder updates and preparing status or performance reports using Microsoft Word or PowerPoint
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and exercise sound judgment when escalating issues

  • Willingness to participate in a compensated after-hours and weekend on-call rotation following onboarding and confirmation of readiness

NICE TO HAVE

title: Laboratory Technician
description:

title: Guest Relations Officer
description:

At Kimpton, be 100% you, lead with heart, and spark joy that inspires lasting memories.

title: Information Security Engineer - Cyber Threat Intelligence
description:
About the Team

You will be part of the Enterprise Cyber Security organization responsible for protecting WSI against emerging cyber threats. The Cyber Threat Intelligence team collects, analyzes, and operationalizes threat information to support proactive threat hunting, detection engineering, and incident response.

About the Role

As an Information Security Engineer - Cyber Threat Intelligence, you will independently investigate emerging threats, manage indicators of compromise (IOCs), conduct threat hunts, and provide actionable intelligence to the SOC and Detection Engineering teams. You will work across intelligence research and hands-on security investigations to help improve enterprise defenses.

Responsibilities

  • Collect, validate, enrich, document, and distribute indicators of compromise and relevant threat intelligence.

  • Research threat actors, campaigns, tactics, techniques, and procedures affecting retail, eCommerce, and enterprise systems.

  • Conduct independent, hypothesis-driven threat hunts using endpoint, identity, network, and SIEM telemetry.

  • Partner with SOC and Detection Engineering to translate intelligence into detection use cases, hunting queries, and response guidance.

  • Use Google SecOps, MISP, CrowdStrike, Feedly, VirusTotal, and Any.Run to investigate, correlate, and operationalize threat information.

  • Monitor emerging vulnerabilities, exploitation activity, and relevant threats; communicate actionable prioritization to security and technology teams.

  • Map relevant adversary behavior and hunting findings to MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Produce concise intelligence reports, threat briefings, and investigative summaries for technical and leadership audiences.

  • Support incident investigations with IOC enrichment, campaign context, and related-activity analysis.

  • Develop repeatable workflows and appropriate automation or AI-assisted analysis while validating intelligence quality.

Criteria

  • 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, threat intelligence, threat hunting, or related security engineering.

  • Experience analyzing security telemetry, IOCs, attacker behaviors, and investigation evidence.

  • Working knowledge of SIEM, EDR, threat intelligence platforms, and MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Ability to develop investigative hypotheses, document conclusions, and collaborate with SOC and Detection Engineering.

  • Strong written communication, analytical thinking, and technical troubleshooting skills.

  • Hands-on experience with Google SecOps, MISP, CrowdStrike, Feedly, VirusTotal, or Any.Run preferred.

  • Experience developing threat-hunting queries, enrichment scripts, or automated intelligence workflows preferred.

  • Familiarity with retail/eCommerce threat patterns and intelligence-led vulnerability prioritization preferred.

  • This role requires being onsite in the San Francisco, CA office Monday through Thursday.

Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

  • A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities

  • Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer

title: ED Technician (Per Diem, Night Shift)
description:
Centrally located within the heart of California, Adventist Health Tulare has been serving the Central Valley since 2018. We are comprised of a 108-bed acute care hospital, emergency department and provide primary and specialty care services to best serve our community. Tulare is situated in a delightful and geographically diverse region. Job Summary:

Assists the Registered Nurse (RN) and physician with assessments, examinations and treatments. Performs a variety of technical and patient care duties under the supervision of a Registered Nurse (RN). Performs essential functions of the Unit Secretary.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Intuit Business Credit Card Platform
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced, results-oriented Staff Software Engineer to join the Intuit Business Credit Card (IBCC) Platform Team. In this role, you will own the architecture and development of our business-critical systems — including Cardholder Repayments, Portfolio Billing, Customer Notifications, Business Flow Monitoring, and the IBCC AI Agent for Customers. You are a seasoned backend engineer who is passionate about clean code, Test-Driven Development (TDD), Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and leveraging advanced technologies like AI orchestration to solve challenging financial and business problems.

You will also lead the design, development, and delivery of two game-changing AI orchestration systems (PRD Creation and IBCC Dev Workflow) that transform our product development lifecycle. If you have a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail (especially with financial data), and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, this is the role for you.


Responsibilities

  • Core Platform Ownership & Architecture: Lead the architecture, design, and development of IBCC’s business-critical systems (Cardholder Repayments, Portfolio Billing, Customer Notifications, and Business Flow Monitoring). Approve every significant design and implementation change, holding final technical accountability for production correctness.

  • AI-Driven Product Development Systems: Architect 'PRD Creation' a Spec-Driven Development framework, and build/maintain 'IBCC Dev Workflow,' our agentic workflow platform. Drive adoption of these frameworks across other Intuit teams and define integration standards.

  • AI Agent Engineering: Design, build, and deliver the conversational IBCC AI Agent to serve customers against live financial data, integrating with ChatGPT, Claude Code, and our web application while ensuring strict safety and audit controls.

  • Backend Software Development: Write high-quality, testable, maintainable, and efficient code in backend languages (primarily Python, Java, Kotlin) and associated frameworks (e.g., Django, FastAPI, Spring Boot).

  • Requirement Analysis & Specification: Gather functional requirements, develop technical specifications, and manage end-to-end project and test planning.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Leadership teams to align on feature development, overall service functional goals, and translate business decisions into robust platform logic.

  • Production Support & Incident Management: Diagnose and resolve production-critical, customer-impacting issues. Participate in on-call rotations, lead post-incident analysis, and drive architectural remediation and system hardening.

  • Financial Integrity & Reconciliation: Maintain daily reconciliation checks to verify settlement against processors and issuing bank records to the cent, ensuring a detailed audit trail is preserved.

  • Technical Leadership: Set engineering standards for how the team builds, reviews, and ships changes. Serve as the final technical authority on architectural decisions, and use Agile Development, SCRUM, or Extreme Programming methodologies to drive execution.


Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience building robust, scalable, and high-performance backend systems and APIs, preferably within fintech or financial platforms.

  • Technical Skills: Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or Kotlin, and event-driven cloud service architectures (specifically AWS).

  • Software Engineering Fundamentals: Solid grasp of software engineering fundamentals, microservices style of service development, and practical application of transactional guarantees (ACID).

  • Engineering Practices: Strong passion for clean code, unit testing, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

  • Domain Expertise:

    • Proven experience designing and operating AI orchestration workflows that transform the software development lifecycle.

    • Deep experience with payment authorization, processing, and ledger reconciliation (including failed, reversed, and returned transactions).

    • Hands-on experience reconciling daily settlement against issuing bank files.

    • Experience building highly reliable notification systems meeting regulatory disclosure requirements.

    • Track record of setting platform observability/logging standards and building end-to-end monitoring.

    • Direct experience designing customer-facing AI agents operating on live financial data with robust safety controls.

  • Soft Skills & Ownership:

    • A helpful, can-do attitude with a willingness to take absolute ownership of complex problems.

    • Exceptional attention to detail, particularly when working with highly sensitive financial data.

    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate complex technical ideas to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

Mountain View $202,500 - $274,000

title: F P & A Analyst
description:
CRS is a Phoenix-based company that helps insured families recover after unexpected home damage (fire, water, storm, earthquake, etc.) by providing temporary housing and relocation support. Working closely with insurance carriers, CRS manages everything from emergency hotel stays to long term housing, furniture, and necessities. In addition to housing placement services, we also streamline the repair and restoration process for damaged homes by tapping into our national network of general contractors. Since 1989, the company has built a reputation for reliability and world class, compassionate customer care powered by a team of professionals dedicated to supporting people during critical moments. Our goal is to make a difficult situation easier by coordinating housing solutions that fit the policyholder’s needs while also working within the guidelines of their insurance coverage.

Our office is in North Phoenix, off the North 101 Loop and 19th Ave. in Deer Valley.

As part of our commitment to a safe and trusted workplace, CRS requires all new hires to complete a pre-employment background check and drug screening.

CRS is an equal opportunity employer. We hire, develop, and promote individuals based on job-related qualifications and abilities. We offer a welcoming and inclusive environment in service to one another, our diverse clients, and the communities we call home. We do this with kindness, empathy and respect for each other.

About the Role

CRS is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and commercially minded Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Analyst to support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and business performance analysis within the temporary housing and insurance claims industry.

In this role, the FP&A Analyst will partner cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Claims, Account Management, and Vendor Relations to provide actionable financial insights that support strategic decision-making, operational efficiency, and profitable growth.

The ideal candidate combines strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities with an understanding of the unique cost drivers associated with temporary housing placements, additional living expense (ALE) claims, insurance carrier programs, housing inventory, and vendor relationships. This individual will help CRS translate complex financial and operational data into meaningful insights, identify trends and risks, and recommend opportunities to improve financial performance while maintaining a high standard of service for policyholders and insurance partners.

  • Compensation: $75k salary (+annual bonus based on company performance)
  • Training: Based on experience, in-office
  • Regular Schedule: Monday-Friday, active business hours
  • Hybrid: Based on experience, 1-2 days in office per week
  • Computer and phone equipment will be provided. You must have reliable high-speed internet service and a suitable workspace at your residence.

Duties/Responsibilities:

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Assist in the development, preparation, and maintenance of annual budgets, financial plans, and rolling forecasts.
  • Analyze actual financial results against budget, forecast, and prior-period performance, identifying variances, trends, and underlying business drivers.
  • Develop financial models to evaluate revenue, operating expenses, gross margin, contribution margin, and profitability across business units, insurance carrier programs, and customer accounts.
  • Support scenario planning and sensitivity analyses to evaluate changes in housing demand, claim volume, average length of stay, rental rates, and other key business assumptions.
  • Prepare monthly financial reporting packages and management presentations that communicate performance, risks, and opportunities.

Temporary Housing & Claims Financial Analysis

  • Analyze financial performance associated with temporary housing placements resulting from covered property losses and insurance claims.
  • Monitor key cost drivers, including nightly and monthly housing rates, length of stay, extensions, utilities, property management fees, furnishing costs, and other placement-related expenses.
  • Evaluate revenue and cost trends associated with additional living expense (ALE) claims and other applicable temporary housing arrangements.
  • Assess placement-level and portfolio-level profitability, identifying opportunities to improve cost efficiency and financial outcomes.
  • Analyze claim duration, placement volume, occupancy, housing utilization, and average cost per placement to identify operational and financial trends.
  • Partner with Claims and Operations teams to understand the financial impact of claim complexity, placement delays, housing availability, and extended stays.
  • Support financial analysis related to insurance carrier agreements, service fees, reimbursement structures, and contractual pricing arrangements.

Operational Performance & KPI Reporting

  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting tools that provide visibility into financial and operational performance.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs), including:
    • Revenue growth and gross margin.
    • Cost per housing placement and average cost per day.
    • Average length of stay and extension rates.
    • Housing utilization and occupancy, where applicable.
    • Revenue and profitability by insurance carrier, client, and program.
    • Vendor costs, pricing variances, and cost savings.
    • Forecast accuracy and operating expense performance.
  • Identify performance trends, investigate material variances, and communicate findings to business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Operations leaders to evaluate productivity, process efficiency, and opportunities to reduce unnecessary costs without compromising policyholder experience.

Financial Reporting & Business Intelligence

  • Prepare recurring financial reports, management summaries, and ad hoc analyses to support leadership decision-making.
  • Consolidate and analyze financial and operational data from accounting systems, claims platforms, housing management systems, and other business applications.
  • Improve reporting accuracy, consistency, and timeliness through standardized reporting processes and automation.
  • Develop financial models and analytical tools to support business planning, resource allocation, pricing decisions, and strategic initiatives.
  • Present complex financial information in a clear, concise, and actionable format for both financial and non-financial audiences.

Cross-Functional Business Partnership

  • Work closely with Accounting to support monthly financial close analysis, expense accruals, financial reconciliations, and reporting accuracy.
  • Partner with Operations, Claims, Account Management, and Vendor Relations to understand business performance and develop data-driven recommendations.
  • Support analyses of new insurance carrier relationships, client programs, vendor contracts, and potential business expansion opportunities.
  • Evaluate the financial implications of changes in housing demand, vendor pricing, client requirements, and service delivery models.
  • Assist with special projects, process improvements, and strategic financial initiatives as assigned by Finance leadership.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, corporate finance, accounting, or a related analytical role.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, pivot tables, lookup functions, and data analysis.
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting.
  • Strong and proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret financial and operational data.
  • History of high attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, data integrity, and meeting reporting deadlines.
  • Demonstrated excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present financial findings to cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment.

Strong Candidates Will Possess:

  • Experience in temporary housing, insurance claims, property and casualty insurance, additional living expense (ALE), relocation services, hospitality, property management, or a related industry.
  • Above-average experience in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas); familiarity with financial modeling a plus
  • Familiarity with insurance carrier programs, claims-related housing expenses, vendor billing, and housing placement operations.
  • Experience analyzing unit economics, customer or account profitability, service delivery costs, and vendor performance.
  • Proficiency in financial reporting and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with ERP systems, financial planning software, and data visualization tools.
  • Knowledge of SQL or other data analysis tools is a plus.
  • Familiarity with financial controls, accrual accounting, and month-end close processes.
